title.zh-TW: 既有提醒掛鉤支援版本比對，過期腳本主動換新不留舊版
title.en: Existing reminder hooks upgrade automatically instead of staying stale

body.zh-TW: 升級 usage 後，既有的 Token Saver 提醒掛鉤（hook，事件發生時觸發的小程式）現在會自動同步最新版。過去 `installer/session_hooks.py` 裡的自我修復函式 `_self_heal_terse_reminder()` 僅在腳本或註冊遺失時重新補上，已安裝的舊版腳本則原樣保留。現在系統透過 `TERSE_REMINDER_HOOK_VERSION` 與 `_installed_terse_reminder_version()` 比對版號並主動替換過期副本，記錄 `update_terse_reminder_hook` 供診斷。⟦恰似大樓巡檢廣播設備：以前檢查員只在設備遺失時才補裝，裝好的舊款從不更換；現在會核對型號主動換新，並在檢修日誌登記換裝明細以供備查。⟧
body.en: After upgrading usage, existing Token Saver reminder hooks now update themselves to the latest version automatically. Previously, `_self_heal_terse_reminder()` in `installer/session_hooks.py` only intervened when a script file or its registration was entirely missing, leaving older installed scripts untouched on stale wording. The system now uses `TERSE_REMINDER_HOOK_VERSION` and `_installed_terse_reminder_version()` to compare version numbers and actively replace outdated script copies, logging an `update_terse_reminder_hook` event for future diagnostics. ⟦It is like a building inspector checking public address speakers: previously only replacing a unit if it was missing while leaving obsolete speakers in place, but now verifying serial numbers, actively replacing aged hardware, and logging the maintenance in service records.⟧

items.original: **Existing Token Saver reminder hooks now update instead of staying stale.** `_self_heal_terse_reminder()` in `installer/session_hooks.py` previously restored only a missing script or registration, leaving an installed older script unchanged. `TERSE_REMINDER_HOOK_VERSION` and `_installed_terse_reminder_version()` now compare versions and replace stale copies, recording `update_terse_reminder_hook` for diagnosis.

entries: **Panels that are too tall for the screen now scale down instead of clipping.** `clamp_content_height()` used the visible frame as its ceiling, leaving rows beyond that height unreachable. `panels/panel_scale.py` now calculates a fit scale, no lower than `MIN_PANEL_SCALE`, and macOS's `PopoverViewController.applyPanelScale()` and Windows's `_WindowsTrayController._apply_panel_zoom()` apply it to the whole panel through `window.usageApplyPanelZoom()`.

**Codex status lines now install and remove correctly when `config.toml` has no bare `[tui]` header.** Configurations that declare `tui` only through `[tui.*]` subtables or top-level dotted keys previously made the setup and unsetup paths silently write nothing while reporting success. `_insert_table_line()`, `_remove_table_line()`, and `_replace_table_line()` now handle both forms, validate every candidate with `tomllib.loads`, and report failure when no change can be safely made.

**Windows builds now point their hidden imports at the installer modules' current paths.** The v0.29.37 fix restored the missing `wintray.app` and `tui.app` entry points; after a separate refactor, `scripts/build_windows.ps1` still named `session_hooks` and `setup_hook` as obsolete top-level modules. The bundle was never broken — `main.py` imports both statically — but the flags were dead configuration of exactly the kind that shipped the unusable v0.29.34–36 builds. They now name `installer.session_hooks` and `installer.setup_hook`, so PyInstaller can diagnose a future omission.

**Toggling the macOS login item no longer fails when the app was opened by double-clicking.** Without `LANG`, `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` used ASCII and could raise `UnicodeDecodeError` while reading `launchctl` or `gh` output containing non-ASCII text. Those reads now explicitly use UTF-8 with replacement for invalid bytes.

**Claude cost totals now include advisor iterations and one-hour cache writes.** The Claude parsers now read `usage.iterations` and `usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens`; only `advisor_message` iterations get separate entries, avoiding double-counting ordinary messages. One-hour cache writes are priced at twice the base input rate, and the history cache schema is bumped so existing entries are reparsed.

**Dragging the Grok card no longer moves the panel differently from the other three on Windows.** The tray's WebKit shim turns a quota card's empty area into a native `pywebview` drag region, but its selector listed only Claude, Codex and Antigravity. Grok fell through to the shared card-reorder handler instead, so the same gesture that moved the window from the first three cards did something else from the fourth. The selector now matches all four, as `panel_core.js` already did on macOS.
Moved public contribution and security guides to `.github/` and localized README and changelog files to `docs/`, cleaning up the repository root and updating all links.
Backfilled the Grok CLI card into the Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean READMEs, which had missed the feature list entry, the Hide Sections list and the comparison-table row.
Bumped PyObjC to 12.2.2 and ruff to 0.16.4, closing five separately raised dependency updates in a single lockfile change.

title.zh-TW: 過高面板自動等比縮放，畫面完整呈現不被截斷
title.en: Oversized panels scale down to fit screen instead of clipping

body.zh-TW: ⟦像用相機拍攝高聳建築時自動切換廣角，把整棟大樓等比縮進觀景窗，而不是直接裁掉屋頂。⟧ 當螢幕直向空間不足而面板（popover）內容過長時，視窗現在會等比縮小而非裁切畫面。過去 `clamp_content_height()` 直接以可見畫面高度為上限，超出高度的資料列完全無法看見也點不到。新模組 `panels/panel_scale.py` 會計算適應螢幕的縮放比例，且不低於保底的 `MIN_PANEL_SCALE`；macOS 的 `PopoverViewController.applyPanelScale()` 與 Windows 的 `_WindowsTrayController._apply_panel_zoom()` 則透過 `window.usageApplyPanelZoom()` 將比例套用至整個面板，確保所有列完整呈現。
body.en: ⟦Like a camera automatically zooming out to wide-angle when capturing a tall skyscraper, fitting the entire building proportionally into the viewfinder instead of slicing off the roof.⟧ When a popover grows too tall for the screen, it now scales down proportionally rather than getting clipped. Previously, `clamp_content_height()` capped height strictly to the visible screen frame, leaving any lower rows unreachable and invisible. The new `panels/panel_scale.py` module computes a fit scale that stays above `MIN_PANEL_SCALE`, and macOS's `PopoverViewController.applyPanelScale()` together with Windows's `_WindowsTrayController._apply_panel_zoom()` apply it across the entire panel using `window.usageApplyPanelZoom()`.

items.original: **Panels that are too tall for the screen now scale down instead of clipping.** `clamp_content_height()` used the visible frame as its ceiling, leaving rows beyond that height unreachable. `panels/panel_scale.py` now calculates a fit scale, no lower than `MIN_PANEL_SCALE`, and macOS's `PopoverViewController.applyPanelScale()` and Windows's `_WindowsTrayController._apply_panel_zoom()` apply it to the whole panel through `window.usageApplyPanelZoom()`.

title.zh-TW: Codex 狀態列支援點記法設定，安裝與移除不再靜默失敗
title.en: Codex status lines install cleanly on dotted and subtable configs

body.zh-TW: 在 Codex 設定檔 `config.toml` 未使用獨立 `[tui]` 區段標頭時，安裝與移除狀態列（status line，終端機最底下的即時資訊列）的功能現在能正確運作。以前若設定檔僅透過 `[tui.*]` 子表格或頂層點記法鍵值宣告，設定與解除流程會靜默跳過寫入卻回報成功。現在 `_insert_table_line()`、`_remove_table_line()` 與 `_replace_table_line()` 同時支援這兩種結構，每次修改皆透過 `tomllib.loads` 驗證語法，並在無法安全變更時明確回報失敗。⟦這好比水電師傅查驗配電箱：不論總標籤寫在總開關還是分路子面板上都能正確接線，送電前以電表驗證，無法安全施工時便明確告知而非假裝完工。⟧
body.en: Codex status lines now install and remove reliably even when `config.toml` lacks a bare `[tui]` header. Configurations declaring `tui` solely through `[tui.*]` subtables or top-level dotted keys previously caused setup and removal routines to write nothing while falsely claiming success. Helper functions `_insert_table_line()`, `_remove_table_line()`, and `_replace_table_line()` now support both config structures, parse and validate every proposed edit with `tomllib.loads`, and raise a clear failure when no change can be made safely. ⟦It is like an electrician inspecting a breaker box: wiring connections correctly whether the label sits on the main switch or individual branch circuits, testing voltages before power-up, and flagging faults instead of pretending everything is installed.⟧

items.original: **Codex status lines now install and remove correctly when `config.toml` has no bare `[tui]` header.** Configurations that declare `tui` only through `[tui.*]` subtables or top-level dotted keys previously made the setup and unsetup paths silently write nothing while reporting success. `_insert_table_line()`, `_remove_table_line()`, and `_replace_table_line()` now handle both forms, validate every candidate with `tomllib.loads`, and report failure when no change can be safely made.

title.zh-TW: Windows 建置校正隱藏匯入路徑，清除無效模組設定
title.en: Windows builds point hidden imports to current installer modules

body.zh-TW: Windows 建置腳本修復了打包設定中的過期模組路徑。先前 v0.29.37 修復了遺漏的 `wintray.app` 與 `tui.app` 進入點；但在獨立重構後，`scripts/build_windows.ps1` 仍將 `session_hooks` 與 `setup_hook` 列為舊版頂層模組。雖然 `main.py` 靜態匯入了兩者而未影響執行檔運作，但這些旗標屬於無效設定，正是過去導致 v0.29.34 至 v0.29.36 版無法啟動的同類隱患。現在旗標已更正為 `installer.session_hooks` 與 `installer.setup_hook`，讓 PyInstaller 未來能及早診斷遺漏。⟦宛如物流清單上的備忘地址：將舊門牌更新為正確路徑，才能在未來漏載時第一時間示警。⟧
body.en: Windows build scripts now direct their hidden import flags to the current installer module paths. The v0.29.37 update restored the missing `wintray.app` and `tui.app` entry points; after a separate code refactor, `scripts/build_windows.ps1` still pointed to `session_hooks` and `setup_hook` as obsolete top-level modules. The packaged executable was never broken because `main.py` imports both statically, but the outdated flags were dead configuration of the exact kind that previously caused broken v0.29.34–36 builds. They now properly specify `installer.session_hooks` and `installer.setup_hook`, enabling PyInstaller to diagnose any future omissions. ⟦It is like updating warehouse addresses on a shipping checklist: keeping the registry accurate ensures the system catches a missing crate before trucks leave the dock.⟧

items.original: **Windows builds now point their hidden imports at the installer modules' current paths.** The v0.29.37 fix restored the missing `wintray.app` and `tui.app` entry points; after a separate refactor, `scripts/build_windows.ps1` still named `session_hooks` and `setup_hook` as obsolete top-level modules. The bundle was never broken — `main.py` imports both statically — but the flags were dead configuration of exactly the kind that shipped the unusable v0.29.34–36 builds. They now name `installer.session_hooks` and `installer.setup_hook`, so PyInstaller can diagnose a future omission.

title.zh-TW: macOS 雙擊啟動改用萬國碼讀取，切換開機項目不再崩潰
title.en: Double-clicked macOS app toggles login items safely with UTF-8

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像快遞員開箱驗貨：以前若沒人提醒語言就預設只認純英文字母，遇上外文標籤便當場罷工；現在一律配備萬國碼字典，遇到損壞字元自動替換並繼續派送。⟧ 在 macOS 上透過滑鼠連點開啟 App 時，切換開機啟動項目不再無預警失敗。雙擊啟動時環境中常缺少 `LANG` 變數，導致子行程（subprocess，由主程式分支出來處理特定任務的背景程序）呼叫 `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` 時預設採用 ASCII 編碼，讀取 `launchctl` 或 `gh` 產生的非 ASCII 文字時會拋出 `UnicodeDecodeError` 錯誤。現在這些讀取動作一律明確指定使用 UTF-8 編碼，並對無效位元組進行容錯替換。
body.en: ⟦Like a customs inspector who once defaulted to English-only and rejected any foreign package, now equipped with a universal dictionary to replace unreadable symbols and keep shipments moving.⟧ Toggling login items on macOS no longer fails when the app is launched via double-click. Without the `LANG` environment variable, `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` defaulted to ASCII, causing a `UnicodeDecodeError` whenever `launchctl` or `gh` outputs contained non-ASCII characters. These process outputs are now explicitly parsed using UTF-8 encoding, safely substituting replacement characters for any invalid byte sequences.

items.original: **Toggling the macOS login item no longer fails when the app was opened by double-clicking.** Without `LANG`, `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` used ASCII and could raise `UnicodeDecodeError` while reading `launchctl` or `gh` output containing non-ASCII text. Those reads now explicitly use UTF-8 with replacement for invalid bytes.

title.zh-TW: Claude 費用納入顧問迭代與 1 小時快取，歷史紀錄重算更精準
title.en: Claude cost totals add advisor iterations and one-hour cache writes

body.zh-TW: 查看 Claude 的花費總額時，現在已完整納入顧問迭代與 1 小時快取寫入費用。解析器新增讀取 `usage.iterations` 與 `usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens` 欄位；其中僅有 `advisor_message` 迭代會拆分為獨立資料列，避免重複計算普通訊息。1 小時快取（cache，將資料暫存以加速讀取的機制）寫入則依基礎輸入費率的 2 倍計價，且歷史快取架構版本已同步更新，讓過往既有紀錄能自動重算。⟦這如同會計事務所升級審計帳本：把特別顧問的諮詢與專用保鮮費列入報銷，依雙倍費率計價並重審舊單據，避免多算也絕不漏計。⟧
body.en: Claude cost totals now accurately capture advisor iterations and one-hour cache write expenses. Claude usage parsers now inspect `usage.iterations` and `usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens`, creating separate breakdown rows solely for `advisor_message` iterations to avoid double-counting regular turns. One-hour cache writes are priced at twice the base input token rate, and the history cache schema version has been bumped so past sessions are reparsed automatically. ⟦It is like an accounting firm updating its audit ledgers: billing special advisor consults and short-term secure storage at double rates, while auditing archived receipts to guarantee nothing is missed or duplicated.⟧

items.original: **Claude cost totals now include advisor iterations and one-hour cache writes.** The Claude parsers now read `usage.iterations` and `usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens`; only `advisor_message` iterations get separate entries, avoiding double-counting ordinary messages. One-hour cache writes are priced at twice the base input rate, and the history cache schema is bumped so existing entries are reparsed.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣拖曳 Grok 卡片修正，視窗移動行為全數統一
title.en: Dragging Grok card on Windows moves panel consistently with others

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統匣（tray，工作列右下角常駐圖示區）拖曳 Grok 額度卡片時，視窗移動行為不再與其他三家卡片不同步。系統匣的 WebKit 墊片原先會將額度卡片的空白區域轉為 `pywebview` 原生拖曳區，但其選取器過去僅列出 Claude、Codex 與 Antigravity。這導致 Grok 卡片掉入共用的卡片排序處理器，在第四張卡片上做出與前三張相同的拖曳手勢時卻引發不同反應。現在選取器已涵蓋全部四家服務商，與 macOS 上的 `panel_core.js` 保持一致。⟦如同控制台上的四組手把：前三組能平移整座台面，第四組因未貼標籤而只能移動自身；補齊設定後，四組操作手感完全一致。⟧
body.en: Dragging the Grok card in the Windows tray now moves the entire panel smoothly, just like the other three provider cards. The tray's WebKit shim converts empty space on quota cards into native `pywebview` drag handles, but its element selector previously named only Claude, Codex, and Antigravity. As a result, dragging Grok fell through to the shared card-reordering logic, causing the fourth card to reorder itself rather than moving the window. The drag selector now includes all four providers, matching behavior already established in `panel_core.js` on macOS. ⟦It is like a control board with four grab handles: three shifted the entire deck while the fourth slipped because it missed a grip pad; outfitting all four ensures consistent handling everywhere.⟧

items.original: **Dragging the Grok card no longer moves the panel differently from the other three on Windows.** The tray's WebKit shim turns a quota card's empty area into a native `pywebview` drag region, but its selector listed only Claude, Codex and Antigravity. Grok fell through to the shared card-reorder handler instead, so the same gesture that moved the window from the first three cards did something else from the fourth. The selector now matches all four, as `panel_core.js` already did on macOS.

title.zh-TW: 指南移至專屬目錄且整理說明文件，專案根目錄全面整潔
title.en: Contribution guides and localized docs move to dedicated folders

body.zh-TW: ⟦像圖書館整頓大廳：將讀者規約歸檔至管理處，把各語系導覽手冊移入閱覽室，讓大廳井然有序且指示牌一目了然。⟧ 專案根目錄進行了結構整理與檔案搬移。公開的貢獻指南與安全政策文件已移至 `.github/` 資料夾。各語言版本的說明文件（README，專案首頁介紹檔）與更新日誌 changelog 則統一集中至 `docs/` 目錄。這項整理清空了專案根目錄的雜亂檔案，並同步更新了所有相互參照的超連結。
body.en: ⟦Like a library tidying its lobby: filing reader policies into administrative offices and shelving multilingual guides in study rooms so the entrance stays clutter-free with clear signposts.⟧ The repository root has been cleaned up and reorganized. Public contribution guidelines and security policies have been relocated into `.github/`. Multilingual README documentation and changelog history files are now consolidated under `docs/`. This housekeeping cleans up the root directory and updates all internal navigation links across the project.

items.original: Moved public contribution and security guides to `.github/` and localized README and changelog files to `docs/`, cleaning up the repository root and updating all links.

title.zh-TW: 簡中日韓說明文件補齊 Grok 介紹，功能清單與比較表全面同步
title.en: Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean READMEs backfill Grok CLI

body.zh-TW: 查閱非英文的專案說明文件時，各語言讀者現在都能獲得完整的 Grok CLI 功能介紹。先前在簡體中文、日文與韓文的說明文件（README，專案首頁介紹檔）中，遺漏了 Grok CLI 卡片於功能清單、「隱藏區塊」設定項目以及跨工具比較表中的資料列。本次更新將這三處缺漏逐一回填至三種語言的說明文件中，確保不同語系的使用者都能查閱到一致的規格與選項說明。⟦這恰似多國語言的商品目錄改版：為簡中、日語及韓語版本補印新產品的特色條目、選配開關與規格比較表，使所有語系的型錄內容完全同步。⟧
body.en: Readers consulting localized documentation will now find complete coverage for the Grok CLI card. The Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean README files previously missed mentions of the Grok card in their feature lists, the Hide Sections toggle documentation, and the provider comparison tables. This update backfills all three missing entries across all three translations, ensuring readers across every supported language have access to the exact same feature overviews and settings details. ⟦It is like updating international product catalogs: reprinting feature summaries, accessory switches, and comparison charts for localized editions so every market receives identical documentation.⟧

items.original: Backfilled the Grok CLI card into the Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean READMEs, which had missed the feature list entry, the Hide Sections list and the comparison-table row.

title.zh-TW: 升級 PyObjC 與 ruff 工具，單次鎖定檔結案五項相依更新
title.en: Bump PyObjC to 12.2.2 and ruff to 0.16.4 across dependency updates

body.zh-TW: 專案相依套件與程式碼檢查工具進行了例行升級。本次將 macOS 系統橋接套件 PyObjC 升級至 12.2.2，並將靜態檢查工具 ruff 更新至 0.16.4。這項調整在單次鎖定檔（lockfile，記錄精確套件版本的設定檔）變更中，一次結案了先前分別提出的 5 項相依套件更新提案，確保建置環境與開發工具鏈維持在最新穩定狀態。⟦這宛若工廠保養時彙整五張零件更換單，統一升級操作面板元件與校準測量尺，一次鎖定新版規格而無須分批停機。⟧
body.en: Project dependencies and linting toolchains have been upgraded to their latest releases. This update bumps the macOS system bridge PyObjC to 12.2.2 and the static analysis linter ruff to 0.16.4. By consolidating these version bumps into a single lockfile commit, the release cleanly resolves five separate dependency update requests at once, keeping the development environment and automated checks current. ⟦It is like factory maintenance consolidating five separate work orders into one shift, upgrading control circuits and calibrating measurement tools in a single scheduled pass without recurring downtime.⟧

items.original: Bumped PyObjC to 12.2.2 and ruff to 0.16.4, closing five separately raised dependency updates in a single lockfile change.

entries: **Cloud Observation's Grok staleness notice no longer swallows the card.** The Grok stale row was copy-pasted into `cloud_observation.html` carrying `codex-stale` / `codex-stale-info` / `codex-stale-tooltip`, but that panel defines `.stale` / `.stale-info` / `.stale-tooltip`. Nothing matched, so the hover tooltip rendered as inline body text, and the unstyled row lost `flex: none` / `white-space: nowrap` and squeezed the `Grok` heading to zero width. Cloud Observation was the only affected theme; the other twelve already resolved their classes.

title.zh-TW: 「Cloud Observation」主題修正 Grok 過期提示，標題不再被擠壓至寬度歸零
title.en: Cloud Observation theme fixes Grok staleness notice without squeezing the header

body.zh-TW: 切換至「Cloud Observation」面板主題查看 Grok 額度時，卡片標題不再被過期提示擠壓消失。該主題範本 `cloud_observation.html` 貼入 Grok 過期提示列時誤帶了 `codex-stale`、`codex-stale-info` 與 `codex-stale-tooltip`，但該面板定義的是 `.stale`、`.stale-info` 與 `.stale-tooltip`。因名稱不符，懸停提示掉成一般內文，未排版的列失去 `flex: none` 與 `white-space: nowrap`，將「Grok」標題擠成零寬度。修正後該主題已恢復正常，其餘 12 款主題先前早已正確對應。⟦這好比標籤貼錯代碼致使樣式失效，隱藏說明攤在門面把「Grok」招牌擠到看不見；更正後版面即恢復整齊。⟧
body.en: When viewing Grok usage under the Cloud Observation panel theme, the card heading will no longer be squeezed out of sight by the staleness notice. The Grok stale row was previously pasted into `cloud_observation.html` carrying `codex-stale`, `codex-stale-info`, and `codex-stale-tooltip`, but that panel defines `.stale`, `.stale-info`, and `.stale-tooltip`. Because nothing matched, the hover tooltip rendered as plain inline body text, and the unstyled row lost its `flex: none` and `white-space: nowrap` layout properties, squeezing the `Grok` heading down to zero width. This release updates the template's class names, bringing Cloud Observation in line with the other twelve themes that already resolved their classes. ⟦It is like pasting an inventory label with the wrong department code onto a display plaque, causing the styling rules to miss it so that the hidden note sprawled across the front and crushed the "Grok" store sign down to nothing; aligning the class names restores the neat layout and floating popup.⟧

items.original: **Cloud Observation's Grok staleness notice no longer swallows the card.** The Grok stale row was copy-pasted into `cloud_observation.html` carrying `codex-stale` / `codex-stale-info` / `codex-stale-tooltip`, but that panel defines `.stale` / `.stale-info` / `.stale-tooltip`. Nothing matched, so the hover tooltip rendered as inline body text, and the unstyled row lost `flex: none` / `white-space: nowrap` and squeezed the `Grok` heading to zero width. Cloud Observation was the only affected theme; the other twelve already resolved their classes.

entries: **Grok CLI is now available as a fourth local quota card.** Reads the weekly credit percentage Grok CLI already writes to its own local debug log (`~/.grok/logs/unified.jsonl`), so the card needs no network call and starts/spawns nothing. No session/burn-rate data is available from that source, so unlike Claude, Codex, and Antigravity, the card shows a single weekly bar. Wired into the macOS popover, all 13 compatible panel themes (with per-theme icon styling matched to each theme's existing badge conventions), Windows tray, and i18n across all five languages.

**Grok CLI's per-request tokens now count toward today's cost and spend.** Grok CLI already writes per-turn prompt/completion/cached/reasoning token counts to its local debug log (`shell.turn.inference_done` events), correlated by session id with model-changed and session-created events for model and project attribution. This adds a loader that turns those into `UsageEntry` rows, so Grok activity now counts toward the popover's "today" cost/token total and project rows, same as Claude and Codex already do — still zero network calls. Also added Grok's log to the history fingerprint's always-restat file sources, so a Grok-only session between refreshes doesn't go stale.

**Codex CLI now auto-starts a 5-hour session keeper.** $20 plans hit a 5-hour rate limit window; $100/$200 plans don't. The keeper only pings when the local rate-limit data has ever reported a `five_hour_window_minutes` value, so unlimited plans stay untouched.

**Grok's icon sizing is fixed on WebKit and it is added to the Hide Sections toggle.** Five panel themes (`classic`, `catppuccin`, `origami`, `stained_glass`, `prism_arcade`) only scoped their SVG icon sizing/color rules to Antigravity's card, so the unscoped Grok icon rendered at WebKit's default intrinsic size of zero — invisible in the real app despite looking fine under Chromium-based testing. Extended those rules to cover Grok's own icon container. Also wires Grok into the "Hide Sections" menu (macOS and Windows) so it can be manually hidden like the other three providers, not just auto-hidden when no data is available.

**Grok now uses its own monochrome accent instead of Antigravity's purple.** Grok's brand is black and white, but its cards shipped with a hardcoded purple hex in all 13 themes — close enough to Antigravity's blue that the two providers read as variants of one another. Replaced with a per-theme `--grok` token (mirroring Antigravity's existing per-theme accent structure), matched to each theme's own visual language.

**Grok is now included in the demo panels so README screenshots no longer omit it.** The panel demo generator never got a Grok row when the card shipped, so every theme screenshot in the README showed three providers instead of four. Added the demo row and regenerated all panel screenshots.

**The yearly Wrapped card has a new glow, badge, and overflow fix.** Adds a radial-gradient glow behind the beast art in the HTML report's "年度 Wrapped" section, gives the WRAPPED badge a layered gradient with an inset highlight, and lets the art spill past its grid column so it doesn't read as dead space. Pure CSS, no functional change.

title.zh-TW: Grok CLI 支援本機額度卡片，讀取每週進度零網路請求
title.en: Grok CLI joins as a fourth local quota card with zero network calls

body.zh-TW: 想掌握 Grok CLI 的使用額度，現在打開面板就能直接看見每週進度條。⟦這就像看自家牆外的瓦斯表指針，不必打電話給瓦斯公司詢問，瞄一眼就知道本週用了多少。⟧ 系統直接讀取 Grok CLI 寫在本機記錄檔（`~/.grok/logs/unified.jsonl`）中的每週信用額度百分比，全程不需要任何網路請求，也不會啟動任何背景行程。由於該記錄檔未提供工作階段或消耗速率數據，因此不同於 Claude、Codex 與 Antigravity，本卡片只顯示單一每週進度條。這項功能已完整整合至 macOS 面板與 Windows 系統匣（tray，工作列右下角常駐圖示區）。介面同時支援五種語言，且全部 13 款主題的圖示風格皆比照既有徽章規範。
body.en: When checking your Grok CLI usage, you can now see a weekly progress bar right inside the popover. ⟦It is like glancing at the gas meter on the outside wall: you know this week's total at a glance without calling the utility company.⟧ The card directly reads the weekly credit percentage Grok CLI already writes to its local debug log (`~/.grok/logs/unified.jsonl`), requiring zero network requests and spawning no extra background processes. Because this log file contains no session or burn-rate information, the card displays a single weekly bar unlike Claude, Codex, and Antigravity. This new card is fully integrated into the macOS popover and Windows tray. It supports all five languages, and its icon styling across all 13 panel themes strictly follows each theme's badge conventions.

items.original: **Grok CLI is now available as a fourth local quota card.** Reads the weekly credit percentage Grok CLI already writes to its own local debug log (`~/.grok/logs/unified.jsonl`), so the card needs no network call and starts/spawns nothing. No session/burn-rate data is available from that source, so unlike Claude, Codex, and Antigravity, the card shows a single weekly bar. Wired into the macOS popover, all 13 compatible panel themes (with per-theme icon styling matched to each theme's existing badge conventions), Windows tray, and i18n across all five languages.

title.zh-TW: Grok CLI 每次請求納入今日花費，專案與模型歸屬精準核算
title.en: Grok CLI token usage now feeds today's cost totals and project attribution

body.zh-TW: 頻繁使用 Grok CLI 產出內容的開發者，今日花費面板現在能如實反映你的每一次呼叫。Grok CLI 原先就會在本地記錄檔寫入每輪提示、完成、快取與推論的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計數事件 `shell.turn.inference_done`。系統新增載入器將這些事件轉換為 `UsageEntry` 資料列，並透過工作階段識別碼串接模型變更與建立事件，精準歸屬模型與專案。這讓 Grok 的活動與 Claude、Codex 一樣計入面板的「今日」總花費、token 總量與專案明細，全程維持零網路請求。此外，該記錄檔已加入歷史指紋的重算清單，避免兩次重新整理之間純用 Grok 的工作階段數據過期。⟦這有如會計櫃檯將新收銀機的每筆明細單直接匯入當日帳冊，各專案開銷一清二楚，無須額外向銀行查帳。⟧
body.en: Developers frequently using Grok CLI will now see every call reflected in the daily spend panel. Grok CLI already writes prompt, completion, cached, and reasoning token counts to its local debug log as `shell.turn.inference_done` events. A new loader converts these events into `UsageEntry` rows, correlating them by session id with model-changed and session-created events for model and project attribution. This allows Grok activity to feed into the popover's "today" cost, token total, and project rows just like Claude and Codex, while maintaining zero network calls. Grok's log has also been added to the history fingerprint's always-restat file sources, ensuring Grok-only sessions do not go stale between refreshes. ⟦It is like a cashier importing receipt slips from a new register directly into the daily ledger, tracking project costs clearly without external bank inquiries.⟧

items.original: **Grok CLI's per-request tokens now count toward today's cost and spend.** Grok CLI already writes per-turn prompt/completion/cached/reasoning token counts to its local debug log (`shell.turn.inference_done` events), correlated by session id with model-changed and session-created events for model and project attribution. This adds a loader that turns those into `UsageEntry` rows, so Grok activity now counts toward the popover's "today" cost/token total and project rows, same as Claude and Codex already do — still zero network calls. Also added Grok's log to the history fingerprint's always-restat file sources, so a Grok-only session between refreshes doesn't go stale.

title.zh-TW: Codex 20 美元方案自動啟動保活器，無限制方案不受影響
title.en: Codex CLI auto-starts a 5-hour session keeper for $20 plans

body.zh-TW: ⟦這好比隨身攜帶的定時鬧鐘：只在停車單註記了限時停車規則時才會輕聲提醒，若是全天暢停的通行證則保持靜默。⟧ 使用 Codex CLI 的 20 美元方案訂閱者，常會遇上 5 小時限流時間窗，而 100 美元與 200 美元方案則不受此限制。現在系統會為 20 美元方案自動啟動 5 小時工作階段（session，單次持續連線的工作週期）保活器。該保活機制極為謹慎，只有在本機限流資料曾回報過 `five_hour_window_minutes` 數值時才會發送探測訊號，確保無限制方案完全不被干擾。
body.en: ⟦It is like a smart parking timer that only beeps if your ticket has a time limit, staying completely silent for unlimited day passes.⟧ Subscribers on Codex CLI's $20 plan face a 5-hour rate limit window, while $100 and $200 plans do not. The app now automatically starts a 5-hour session keeper for eligible accounts. To keep things clean, the keeper only pings when local rate-limit data has actually reported a `five_hour_window_minutes` value, leaving unlimited plans completely untouched.

items.original: **Codex CLI now auto-starts a 5-hour session keeper.** $20 plans hit a 5-hour rate limit window; $100/$200 plans don't. The keeper only pings when the local rate-limit data has ever reported a `five_hour_window_minutes` value, so unlimited plans stay untouched.

title.zh-TW: 五款主題修正 Grok 圖示，WebKit 不再隱形
title.en: Grok icon no longer vanishes in WebKit across five themes

body.zh-TW: 在 `classic`、`catppuccin`、`origami`、`stained_glass` 與 `prism_arcade` 五款面板主題查看 Grok 時，實際 App 不會再出現圖示缺席、Chromium 測試卻看似正常的落差。原本 SVG 圖示（可縮放的向量圖）的尺寸與色彩規則只套用於 Antigravity 卡片。Grok 圖示容器不在範圍內，WebKit（App 繪製畫面的引擎）便以預設原生尺寸零繪製，於是圖示隱形。現在五款主題都將同一套規則延伸到 Grok 圖示容器。⟦像印刷廠替舊版標誌備妥尺寸版型，新標誌漏了版型而印不出來；補上同一規格後，它也能正常出現在成品上。⟧
body.en: In the five panel themes `classic`, `catppuccin`, `origami`, `stained_glass`, and `prism_arcade`, Grok's icon no longer vanishes in the real app while Chromium tests appear normal. The sizing and color rules for SVG icons previously applied only to the Antigravity card. Grok's icon container was outside those rules, so WebKit rendered it at its default intrinsic size of zero and the icon became invisible. The same rules now also cover Grok's icon container in all five themes. ⟦It is like a print shop that had a size template for an older logo but none for the new one, leaving it off the finished page until the same template was added.⟧

items.original: **Grok's icon sizing is fixed on WebKit and it is added to the Hide Sections toggle.** Five panel themes (`classic`, `catppuccin`, `origami`, `stained_glass`, `prism_arcade`) only scoped their SVG icon sizing/color rules to Antigravity's card, so the unscoped Grok icon rendered at WebKit's default intrinsic size of zero — invisible in the real app despite looking fine under Chromium-based testing. Extended those rules to cover Grok's own icon container. Also wires Grok into the "Hide Sections" menu (macOS and Windows) so it can be manually hidden like the other three providers, not just auto-hidden when no data is available.

title.zh-TW: Grok 加入隱藏區塊選單，可在桌面版手動收起
title.en: Grok joins Hide Sections for manual hiding on desktop

body.zh-TW: 當面板上已有資料，卻想暫時收起 Grok 卡片時，macOS 與 Windows 的「隱藏區塊」選單現在也可手動選它。以前 Grok 只會在沒有資料時自動隱藏；選單已能控制其他三家服務商，卻沒有 Grok。它現已列入選項，因此能像其他三家一樣自行決定顯示或隱藏。⟦像展場原本只有三個展櫃的遮簾可拉，第四個展櫃只會在空著時自動關燈；現在也有自己的遮簾，展示與收起都由你安排。⟧
body.en: When a Grok card has data but you want to put it away temporarily, the "Hide Sections" menu on macOS and Windows now lets you choose it manually. Grok previously auto-hidden only when no data was available. The menu already controlled the other three providers, but not Grok. It is now an option too, so you can choose whether it is shown or hidden like the other three. ⟦It is like an exhibition with curtains for only three display cases: the fourth switched off by itself only when empty, and now it has its own curtain for you to open or close.⟧

items.original: **Grok's icon sizing is fixed on WebKit and it is added to the Hide Sections toggle.** Five panel themes (`classic`, `catppuccin`, `origami`, `stained_glass`, `prism_arcade`) only scoped their SVG icon sizing/color rules to Antigravity's card, so the unscoped Grok icon rendered at WebKit's default intrinsic size of zero — invisible in the real app despite looking fine under Chromium-based testing. Extended those rules to cover Grok's own icon container. Also wires Grok into the "Hide Sections" menu (macOS and Windows) so it can be manually hidden like the other three providers, not just auto-hidden when no data is available.

title.zh-TW: Grok 換上專屬黑白單色強調色，不再與 Antigravity 混淆
title.en: Grok gets its own monochrome theme accent, ending purple color clash

body.zh-TW: Grok 現在改用符合其黑白品牌、依主題調整的專屬單色強調色。Grok 官方品牌一向採用黑白單色風格，但先前版本在全部 13 款主題中皆寫死了紫色十六進位色碼；這與 Antigravity 的藍色過於接近，容易讓使用者誤以為兩者是同一品牌的系列變體。本次更新比照 Antigravity 現有的主題強調色結構，改用各主題專屬的 `--grok` 變數標記，讓每款主題下的 Grok 卡片都能呈現與該主題視覺語言高度融合的單色強調效果。⟦這宛如為新品牌換上原廠訂製的黑白徽章，不再借用隔壁專櫃的紫色標籤，界線分明且和諧一致。⟧
body.en: Grok now uses its own per-theme monochrome accent, matched to its black-and-white brand and each theme. Grok's official branding is strictly black and white, but its cards initially shipped with hardcoded purple hex values across all 13 themes, looking close enough to Antigravity's blue that the two appeared related. This release replaces the hardcoded values with a per-theme `--grok` token, mirroring Antigravity's theme structure and matching the visual language of each design. ⟦It is like outfitting a new department with its own tailored black-and-white insignia instead of borrowing a purple label from the neighboring rack.⟧

items.original: **Grok now uses its own monochrome accent instead of Antigravity's purple.** Grok's brand is black and white, but its cards shipped with a hardcoded purple hex in all 13 themes — close enough to Antigravity's blue that the two providers read as variants of one another. Replaced with a per-theme `--grok` token (mirroring Antigravity's existing per-theme accent structure), matched to each theme's own visual language.

title.zh-TW: 範本產生器加入 Grok，說明文件截圖完整展示四卡
title.en: Demo panels add Grok row, updating all README screenshots

body.zh-TW: 查閱說明文件與預覽主題效果時，讀者能看見四家服務商齊聚的完整畫面。面板範本產生器在先前 Grok 卡片釋出時未同步加入 Grok 範本列，導致專案說明文件（README，專案首頁的介紹文件）裡展示的所有主題截圖都只出現三家服務商而非完整的四家。這次更新補齊了 Grok 範本資料列，並重新產生了全部主題的面板展示截圖，確保每張截圖都能忠實呈現包含 Grok 在內的四卡版面。⟦這恰似型錄攝影師重拍全系列商品宣傳照，補上新發表的第四款產品，讓買家翻開目錄就能看清所有陣容。⟧
body.en: When browsing project documentation and previews, readers will now see all four providers displayed together. The panel demo generator was not updated with a Grok row when the card originally shipped, meaning theme screenshots in the README mistakenly showed three providers instead of four. This update adds the missing demo row and regenerates every theme screenshot, ensuring all visuals accurately represent the four-card layout. ⟦It is like a product catalog photographer reshooting the entire collection to include the newly launched fourth model, showing customers the complete lineup at a glance.⟧

items.original: **Grok is now included in the demo panels so README screenshots no longer omit it.** The panel demo generator never got a Grok row when the card shipped, so every theme screenshot in the README showed three providers instead of four. Added the demo row and regenerated all panel screenshots.

title.zh-TW: 年度 Wrapped 卡片樣式升級，光暈與徽章更精緻且改善留白
title.en: Yearly Wrapped card receives visual polish with glows and badges

body.zh-TW: ⟦這有如為紀念證書重新打光：在神獸主角身後打上柔和光環，搭配多層次高光徽章，並讓畫作邊緣自然延伸破格，整體氣勢更為生動。⟧ 匯出的 HTML 報表在「年度 Wrapped」視覺區塊獲得了純 CSS 樣式升級。怪獸插圖背後新增了放射狀漸層（radial-gradient，由中心向外發散的漸層光暈）背景光；WRAPPED 徽章採用多層漸層搭配內陰影高光效果；同時放寬版面限制，讓怪獸插圖能自然溢出其網格欄位邊界，避免留白處顯得生硬空曠。本次調整全為純樣式優化，未改動任何功能邏輯。
body.en: ⟦It is like refining a commemorative plaque: casting a soft glow behind the mascot, adding layered highlights to the emblem, and letting the illustration gently break outside its frame for a richer look.⟧ The exported HTML report received a pure CSS styling refresh in its "年度 Wrapped" section. A radial-gradient glow now illuminates the background behind the beast illustration, while the WRAPPED badge features a layered gradient with an inset highlight. The artwork is also allowed to overflow past its grid column, preventing awkward empty margins. These changes are entirely visual and introduce no functional modifications.

items.original: **The yearly Wrapped card has a new glow, badge, and overflow fix.** Adds a radial-gradient glow behind the beast art in the HTML report's "年度 Wrapped" section, gives the WRAPPED badge a layered gradient with an inset highlight, and lets the art spill past its grid column so it doesn't read as dead space. Pure CSS, no functional change.

entries: **Windows crashed on startup in v0.29.34 through v0.29.36.** The 0.29.34 refactor moved `wintray.py` to `wintray/app.py` and `tui.py` to `tui/app.py`, but `scripts/build_windows.ps1` still hidden-imported the old top-level module names. Both packages' `__init__.py` are empty, so PyInstaller packaged only empty shells and dropped the whole `wintray` dependency tree (`panels.*`, `updates.*`, and more) along with it — every downloader hit `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'wintray.app'`, and the TUI fallback failed the same way since `tui.app` was missing too. macOS was unaffected; `setup_app.py` collects the whole package by name via py2app, and the names still matched after the rename.

**The Windows build script now verifies the packaged exe actually contains `wintray.app` and `tui.app`.** It previously only checked that an exe file existed, which is why the three broken releases above shipped without anyone noticing — the file was there, just missing the modules users needed. `build_windows.ps1` now reads the PyInstaller archive contents with `archive_viewer` and throws if either entry-point module is missing, so a future regression fails the release job instead of shipping a broken artifact.

title.zh-TW: Windows 啟動崩潰已修復，打包不再遺漏模組
title.en: Windows startup crash is fixed, and packaging no longer drops modules

body.zh-TW: Windows 在 v0.29.34 至 v0.29.36 啟動時當機。⟦這好比搬家沒改通訊錄，按舊地址找去只見空屋。⟧ 0.29.34 重構把 `wintray.py` 與 `tui.py` 移入 `wintray/app.py` 和 `tui/app.py`，`scripts/build_windows.ps1` 仍隱藏匯入舊模組名。兩套件 `__init__.py` 皆為空，PyInstaller 因而只打包空殼，遺漏 `wintray` 依賴樹（`panels.*` 與 `updates.*` 等）；下載者遇 `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'wintray.app'`，TUI 備援也因缺 `tui.app` 失敗。macOS 未受影響，`setup_app.py` 經 py2app 依名稱收集套件，改名後仍相符。
body.en: Windows crashed on startup in v0.29.34 through v0.29.36. ⟦It is like moving house without updating the address book: anyone looking at the old address only finds an empty building.⟧ The 0.29.34 refactor moved `wintray.py` and `tui.py` to `wintray/app.py` and `tui/app.py`, but `scripts/build_windows.ps1` still hidden-imported the old top-level module names. Because `__init__.py` in both packages is empty, PyInstaller only packaged empty shells and dropped the `wintray` dependency tree (`panels.*`, `updates.*`, and more). Every downloader hit `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'wintray.app'`, and the TUI fallback failed because `tui.app` was also missing. macOS was unaffected because `setup_app.py` collects the whole package by name via py2app, which still matched after the rename.

title.zh-TW: 建置腳本檢查打包內容，防止釋出損壞的 Windows 執行檔
title.en: Build script inspects archive contents to prevent shipping broken Windows executables

body.zh-TW: ⟦這像品管檢查出貨包裹：以前只看箱子是否存在就放行，現在會用透視掃描確認核心零件真的裝在箱內。⟧ 過去 Windows 建置腳本 `build_windows.ps1` 只檢查 `.exe` 檔案是否存在，才讓前述三個損壞版本在無人察覺下釋出——檔案確實存在，卻缺少使用者需要的模組。現在 `build_windows.ps1` 會以 `archive_viewer` 讀取 PyInstaller 保存庫內容；若遺漏 `wintray.app` 或 `tui.app` 任一進入點模組便直接拋出錯誤。這確保未來若發生退化，會在發布任務中直接失敗，不再釋出損壞的產物。
body.en: ⟦It is like package inspection in a factory: instead of merely checking that a box exists on the shelf, an inspector now scans inside to verify key parts are present.⟧ The Windows build script `build_windows.ps1` previously only checked that an `.exe` file existed, which is why the three broken releases shipped without anyone noticing — the file was there, but missing the modules users needed. `build_windows.ps1` now reads the PyInstaller archive contents with `archive_viewer` and throws if either `wintray.app` or `tui.app` entry-point module is missing. This ensures any future regression fails the release job instead of shipping a broken artifact.

items.original: **The Windows build script now verifies the packaged exe actually contains `wintray.app` and `tui.app`.** It previously only checked that an exe file existed, which is why the three broken releases above shipped without anyone noticing — the file was there, just missing the modules users needed. `build_windows.ps1` now reads the PyInstaller archive contents with `archive_viewer` and throws if either entry-point module is missing, so a future regression fails the release job instead of shipping a broken artifact.

entries: **Antigravity quota now raises notifications, the way Claude Code and Codex already did.** The `agy_session` and `agy_weekly` channels were missing from the notification allow-list, so the two Antigravity rows could run to the floor without ever saying so. Antigravity quota is the one source that comes from a network endpoint behind a local cache rather than a file on disk, so `QuotaRowState.available` is hard-coded to `True`; a stale snapshot now passes `available=False` instead, so an expired cache can no longer announce that the quota has run out.

**The Antigravity rows now warn before the quota is gone, not after.** They had never been wired to the burn-rate forecast, so their `warning` flag was permanently `False` — Claude and Codex warned ahead of a reset and Antigravity stayed silent until it hit the floor. Both rows now register their own tracker. Samples are timestamped with the snapshot's own `fetched_at` rather than the wall clock, because the Antigravity snapshot only changes every five minutes and polling would otherwise read the same payload again and invent a slope out of it. Both rows use a 3600-second window: at one sample per five minutes the default ten-minute window never collects `MIN_FORECAST_SAMPLES`, which is the same as not forecasting at all. A stale snapshot suppresses the forecast entirely, matching what `agy_window_keeper` already does.

**`usage doctor` now catches a Codex history migration that would silently zero the token counts.** Codex has begun writing tables such as `rollout_migration_state`, and if that migration lands and the `.jsonl` files stop being written, `loaders/codex_loader.py` returns zero without an error anywhere. The check warns when the session `.jsonl` files hold no entry from the last seven days while `thread_history_1.sqlite` does hold `thread_turns` from that window.

**`usage doctor` now reconciles its own Claude cost against the official one.** It compares `cost.total_cost_usd` from `usage-status.json` with the figure usage calculates itself and warns when they differ by more than 20% and more than $1. On the machine this was written on they differed by 46.4%, because the price table listed `claude-opus-5` at half its real rate — exactly the kind of drift the offline fallback table is known to hide.

**The project usage card no longer clips its rows on the WIN95 and Newspaper panels.** A panel measures its own natural height by releasing the whole `height: 100%` chain to `auto`. Both panels write their project card as `flex: 1`, which means a flex basis of zero, and the card's own `overflow: hidden` — the retro window chrome depends on it — suppresses the automatic content-based minimum size that would otherwise hold the card open. The card therefore collapsed to its title bar during the measurement, and the reported height was short by exactly the project rows: 877 pixels for WIN95 and 876 for Newspaper against 923 for the structurally identical Classic. The measurement now pins such stretching children to `flex: 0 0 auto` while it measures and restores them afterwards, so no panel's visual design changes.

**Eight more modules moved out of the repository root.** `quota/` took `burn_rate`, `usage_rate`, `window_keeper`, and `agy_window_keeper`; `usage_common/` took `time_utils`, `usage_logging`, `usage_lang`, and `usage_dir_sweeper`. The shared-utility package is named `usage_common` rather than `common` because the `uvx usage-cli` entry point installs top-level packages into a shared `site-packages`, where `common` is about the most collision-prone name available. No compatibility shims were left behind — every import in the repository was updated in one pass, `pyproject.toml` dropped the eight `py-modules` entries and added the two packages, and `setup_app.py` followed. Behavior is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 額度會提醒，也能提早預警
title.en: Antigravity quota now notifies and warns ahead

body.zh-TW: ⟦把 Antigravity 額度想成油表：油用完才亮燈已經太晚，舊讀值更不能冒充油箱已空。⟧ 現在 `agy_session` 和 `agy_weekly` 兩列會發通知，不再因為漏列在通知允許清單而一路耗盡卻沒消息。它們也接上各自的用量追蹤器，會在額度歸零前顯示警告，而不是等到底才沉默。Antigravity 的資料來自經過快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）的網路端點；快取過期時，快照會標成不可用，因而不會誤報額度已用完。預測採用快照自己的 `fetched_at` 時間，而非輪詢當下的時鐘，避免同一份每五分鐘才變動的資料被重複讀取後憑空算出趨勢。兩列使用 3600 秒視窗；原本十分鐘的預設視窗湊不齊 `MIN_FORECAST_SAMPLES`，等同根本無法預測。過期快照也會完全停用預測，與 `agy_window_keeper` 一致。
body.en: ⟦Think of Antigravity quota as a fuel gauge: a light that comes on after the tank is empty is too late, and an old reading must not pretend the tank is empty.⟧ The `agy_session` and `agy_weekly` rows now send notifications instead of being omitted from the notification allow-list and running down silently. Each row also has its own usage tracker, so it can warn before quota reaches zero rather than stay quiet until then. Antigravity data comes from a network endpoint behind a local cache, which stores a previously fetched result for reuse. When that cache is stale, its snapshot is marked unavailable, so it cannot announce that quota has run out. Forecasting uses the snapshot's `fetched_at` time instead of the polling clock, preventing repeated reads of a payload that changes only every five minutes from inventing a trend. Both rows use a 3600-second window because the default ten-minute window cannot gather `MIN_FORECAST_SAMPLES`. A stale snapshot also suppresses forecasting, matching `agy_window_keeper`.

items.original:
**Antigravity quota now raises notifications, the way Claude Code and Codex already did.** The `agy_session` and `agy_weekly` channels were missing from the notification allow-list, so the two Antigravity rows could run to the floor without ever saying so. Antigravity quota is the one source that comes from a network endpoint behind a local cache rather than a file on disk, so `QuotaRowState.available` is hard-coded to `True`; a stale snapshot now passes `available=False` instead, so an expired cache can no longer announce that the quota has run out.
**The Antigravity rows now warn before the quota is gone, not after.** They had never been wired to the burn-rate forecast, so their `warning` flag was permanently `False` — Claude and Codex warned ahead of a reset and Antigravity stayed silent until it hit the floor. Both rows now register their own tracker. Samples are timestamped with the snapshot's own `fetched_at` rather than the wall clock, because the Antigravity snapshot only changes every five minutes and polling would otherwise read the same payload again and invent a slope out of it. Both rows use a 3600-second window: at one sample per five minutes the default ten-minute window never collects `MIN_FORECAST_SAMPLES`, which is the same as not forecasting at all. A stale snapshot suppresses the forecast entirely, matching what `agy_window_keeper` already does.

title.zh-TW: usage doctor 能抓出 Codex 歷史搬遷後的歸零
title.en: usage doctor catches Codex history migrations that zero counts

body.zh-TW: ⟦這像記帳員同時翻閱收據盒與總帳；收據盒空了、總帳卻有交易，便知道資料沒有真的消失。⟧ `usage doctor`（用來檢查使用資料異常的指令）現在會檢查 Codex 的歷史搬遷。Codex 開始寫入 `rollout_migration_state` 這類資料表後，若搬遷完成、工作階段的 `.jsonl` 檔不再寫入，`loaders/codex_loader.py` 會毫無錯誤地回傳零 token（AI 計費與計量的文字單位）數。現在只要 `.jsonl` 在最近七天沒有任何項目，但 `thread_history_1.sqlite` 裡的 `thread_turns` 卻有同一時段資料，檢查便會警告你。這能指出原本悄悄把計數歸零的落差。
body.en: ⟦It is like an accountant opening both the receipt box and the ledger: if the box is empty but the ledger has transactions, the records have not truly vanished.⟧ `usage doctor`, a command that checks for problems in usage data, now looks for a Codex history migration. After Codex began writing tables such as `rollout_migration_state`, a completed migration could stop the session `.jsonl` files from being written while `loaders/codex_loader.py` silently returned zero token counts. It now warns when `.jsonl` files contain no entry from the last seven days while `thread_history_1.sqlite` has `thread_turns` from that same window. That exposes a mismatch that used to zero counts without an error.

items.original: **`usage doctor` now catches a Codex history migration that would silently zero the token counts.** Codex has begun writing tables such as `rollout_migration_state`, and if that migration lands and the `.jsonl` files stop being written, `loaders/codex_loader.py` returns zero without an error anywhere. The check warns when the session `.jsonl` files hold no entry from the last seven days while `thread_history_1.sqlite` does hold `thread_turns` from that window.

title.zh-TW: usage doctor 會核對 Claude 費用是否偏離官方數字
title.en: usage doctor compares Claude costs with the official figure

body.zh-TW: 帳單對不上時，問題可能不在你，而在離線價目表已經過時。⟦這次的 `usage doctor` 像把兩把尺靠在同一塊木板上，讀數差距超過門檻就亮起警示燈。⟧ 它會把 `usage-status.json` 的 `cost.total_cost_usd` 與 usage 自行算出的金額相比。差距同時超過 20% 與 $1 時便會警告。撰寫這項功能的那台機器上，兩者相差 46.4%，原因是價目表把 `claude-opus-5` 標成真實費率的一半。這正是離線備援價目表可能掩蓋的價格漂移。
body.en: When a bill does not match, the problem may be an outdated offline price table rather than you. ⟦Here `usage doctor` is like placing two rulers against the same board and lighting a warning when their readings exceed a threshold.⟧ It compares `cost.total_cost_usd` in `usage-status.json` with the amount usage calculates itself, then warns when the gap is both over 20% and over $1. On the machine where this feature was written, the figures differed by 46.4% because the price table listed `claude-opus-5` at half its real rate. That is the kind of price drift an offline fallback table can hide.

items.original: **`usage doctor` now reconciles its own Claude cost against the official one.** It compares `cost.total_cost_usd` from `usage-status.json` with the figure usage calculates itself and warns when they differ by more than 20% and more than $1. On the machine this was written on they differed by 46.4%, because the price table listed `claude-opus-5` at half its real rate — exactly the kind of drift the offline fallback table is known to hide.

title.zh-TW: WIN95 與 Newspaper 的專案用量卡不再截掉資料列
title.en: WIN95 and Newspaper project cards no longer clip rows

body.zh-TW: WIN95 與 Newspaper 面板上的專案用量卡，現在不會只露出標題列，把底下資料列截掉。面板量自然高度時會暫時把整條 `height: 100%` 改成 `auto`。但兩個面板都把專案卡寫成 `flex: 1`，其彈性基準是零；卡片自己的 `overflow: hidden` 是復古視窗外框所需，卻壓掉可撐開內容的自動最小尺寸。量測時，卡片因此縮成標題列，WIN95 報出 877 像素、Newspaper 報出 876 像素，而結構相同的 Classic 是 923 像素。⟦像量布料時先把被拉緊的橡皮筋鬆開，才不會把整件衣服量短。⟧ 現在量測會暫時把這類可拉伸子項固定為 `flex: 0 0 auto`，量完再還原，因此面板的視覺設計不會改變。
body.en: Project usage cards on the WIN95 and Newspaper panels no longer show only their title bar while clipping the rows below. To measure natural height, a panel temporarily releases the `height: 100%` chain to `auto`. Yet both panels write the project card as `flex: 1`, whose flex basis is zero, while the card's `overflow: hidden`, needed by retro window chrome, suppresses the automatic content-based minimum size that would keep it open. During measurement the card therefore collapsed to its title bar: WIN95 reported 877 pixels and Newspaper 876, versus 923 for structurally identical Classic. ⟦It is like loosening a stretched elastic before measuring cloth, so the whole garment is not measured too short.⟧ Measurement now temporarily pins stretching children to `flex: 0 0 auto` and restores them afterward, leaving each panel's visual design unchanged.

items.original: **The project usage card no longer clips its rows on the WIN95 and Newspaper panels.** A panel measures its own natural height by releasing the whole `height: 100%` chain to `auto`. Both panels write their project card as `flex: 1`, which means a flex basis of zero, and the card's own `overflow: hidden` — the retro window chrome depends on it — suppresses the automatic content-based minimum size that would otherwise hold the card open. The card therefore collapsed to its title bar during the measurement, and the reported height was short by exactly the project rows: 877 pixels for WIN95 and 876 for Newspaper against 923 for the structurally identical Classic. The measurement now pins such stretching children to `flex: 0 0 auto` while it measures and restores them afterwards, so no panel's visual design changes.

title.zh-TW: 八個模組搬進新套件，專案根目錄少了雜物
title.en: Eight modules move into packages, clearing repository root

body.zh-TW: 八個模組搬離根目錄，行為不變。`burn_rate`、`usage_rate`、`window_keeper`、`agy_window_keeper` 搬進 `quota/`；`time_utils`、`usage_logging`、`usage_lang`、`usage_dir_sweeper` 搬進 `usage_common/`。⟦這像把工作桌上八樣零件分別收進兩個標籤清楚的抽屜，零件不變，不再散在桌面。⟧ 共用工具套件叫 `usage_common`，不用 `common`，`uvx usage-cli` 的進入點會把頂層套件裝進共用的 `site-packages`，`common` 易撞名。未留相容墊片：所有 import 一次更新，`pyproject.toml` 移除八個 `py-modules` 項目並加入兩個套件，`setup_app.py` 也更新。
body.en: The repository root has eight fewer loose modules, while behavior stays unchanged. `burn_rate`, `usage_rate`, `window_keeper`, and `agy_window_keeper` moved into `quota/`; `time_utils`, `usage_logging`, `usage_lang`, and `usage_dir_sweeper` moved into `usage_common/`. ⟦It is like putting eight loose parts from a workbench into two clearly labeled drawers: the parts are unchanged, but no longer scattered across the surface.⟧ The shared utility package is called `usage_common`, not `common`, because the `uvx usage-cli` entry point installs top-level packages into shared `site-packages`, where `common` can easily collide with another package. No compatibility shims remain: every repository import was updated in one pass, `pyproject.toml` dropped eight `py-modules` entries and added the two packages, and `setup_app.py` followed.

items.original: **Eight more modules moved out of the repository root.** `quota/` took `burn_rate`, `usage_rate`, `window_keeper`, and `agy_window_keeper`; `usage_common/` took `time_utils`, `usage_logging`, `usage_lang`, and `usage_dir_sweeper`. The shared-utility package is named `usage_common` rather than `common` because the `uvx usage-cli` entry point installs top-level packages into a shared `site-packages`, where `common` is about the most collision-prone name available. No compatibility shims were left behind — every import in the repository was updated in one pass, `pyproject.toml` dropped the eight `py-modules` entries and added the two packages, and `setup_app.py` followed. Behavior is unchanged.

entries: **Migration is the fourteenth visual theme.** Its dusk sky carries a latitude-and-longitude grid while three V-shaped flocks cross at different speeds, their wings moving as route labels such as `ROUTE. 7` identify the journeys. It follows the Lepidoptera panel's illustrated field-guide approach.

**The README theme galleries are rebuilt from synthetic data and now line up.** All five READMEs listed ten screenshots under a heading that said thirteen — `stained_glass` and `origami` had never been photographed, `catppuccin` only in Chinese. The old images were also hand-captured from a real machine, so they carried actual project names and dollar amounts onto a public page, and predated the Antigravity card entirely. Every shot is now regenerated by `scripts/make_panel_shots.py` from the same synthetic payload the website uses. The galleries place three images per row, so a panel that is shorter than its neighbours pushes the whole grid out of line; the shots are therefore all captured at the tallest panel's height, and `world_cup` — a wide HUD that is genuinely 243 pixels shorter than the rest — sits this gallery out. Twelve images, four even rows. All thirteen are still on the website, where each one is shown alone at its own size. GitHub strips scripts and iframes from Markdown, so the README stays static images.

**The website now shows all thirteen panels, live, instead of ten screenshots.** The gallery held ten static images; `origami` and `stained_glass` had never been photographed at all, and `catppuccin` only in Chinese — so the page showed ten themes under a heading that said thirteen. It now renders the real panel HTML in a frame with a hand-written demo payload, and the theme list comes from `panels.all_panels()`, so a fourteenth panel appears on the site by running `scripts/make_panel_demo.py` rather than by remembering to take two more screenshots. Picking a language on the site switches the panel too, in all five languages, because the site's existing `applyLang()` forwards to it. The panel is display-only — its Switch Panel and Quit buttons have no native side to answer them on a web page. The old screenshots stay in `docs/`; the READMEs still link to them.

**Stained Glass now turns like a kaleidoscope.** The existing `sunlightSweep` remains, while layered fragments counter-rotate through `kaleidoscopeTurn` and the light sweep follows through `kaleidoscopeSweep`; its id and name stay the same, so this is a visual upgrade to the existing panel rather than a new theme.

**Seven more modules moved out of the repository root.** `panel_window` and `panel_window_state` joined `panels/`, `critter_frames` joined `menubar/`, and a new `installer/` package took `setup_hook`, `session_hooks`, `statusline_settings`, and `login_item` — the four modules that install usage into the user's system. The root is down to 28 Python files. The package is named `installer` rather than `setup` because the repository root is on `sys.path` and a top-level `setup` package would shadow the bare `import setup` that setuptools and py2app perform during a build — a failure that only surfaces when packaging, never in the test suite. The four modules that resolve the hook scripts by walking up from `__file__` now walk up one extra level, since those scripts stay at the root to run under the system Python.

title.zh-TW: 七個模組搬進分區，打包時避開 `setup` 撞名
title.en: Seven modules move into packages to avoid a `setup` naming collision at build time

body.zh-TW: 根目錄少七模組，剩 28 個 Python 檔。⟦拍片前分工：窗戶交場景組、選單列交道具組，安裝交後勤組。⟧`panel_window`、`panel_window_state`→`panels/`，`critter_frames`→`menubar/`；`setup_hook`、`session_hooks`、`statusline_settings`、`login_item` 四模組將 usage 安裝到使用者系統，移入新 `installer/`。`installer/` 不叫 `setup`：根目錄列入 `sys.path`（找模組清單），同名頂層套件會遮住 setuptools、py2app 打包的 `import setup`。僅打包出錯，測試不會發現。四模組循 `__file__` 往上找掛鉤腳本；腳本留根目錄由系統 Python 執行，故多找一層。
body.en: Project root moves out seven more modules and now holds only 28 Python files. ⟦It is like assigning film crew before a shoot: window work goes to set team, menu-bar work to props team, and installation work to logistics team.⟧`panel_window` and `panel_window_state` join `panels/`; `critter_frames` joins `menubar/`; four modules `setup_hook`, `session_hooks`, `statusline_settings`, and `login_item` install usage into user's system and join new `installer/` package. It cannot be called `setup`: repository root sits on Python's `sys.path` (list of places Python searches for modules), and a top-level package of that name would shadow `import setup` used by setuptools and py2app during packaging. Failure surfaces only when packaging, not in test suite. Four modules used to walk upward from `__file__` for hook scripts; scripts remain at root to run under system Python, so they now walk up one extra level.

The root is down to 28 Python files. The package is named `installer` rather than `setup` because the repository root is on `sys.path` and a top-level `setup` package would shadow the bare `import setup` that setuptools and py2app perform during a build — a failure that only surfaces when packaging, never in the test suite. The four modules that resolve the hook scripts by walking up from `__file__` now walk up one extra level, since those scripts stay at the root to run under the system Python.

entries: **The menu bar percentages are now bold.** They were drawn at the menu bar's own point size in regular weight, which left them lighter than everything around them — hard to read at a glance over a light wallpaper. Same size, bold weight; the strip grows by about 5 points.

**The provider marks in the menu bar are now monochrome and follow the menu bar's own appearance.** The color art had to work against whatever wallpaper was behind it, and the Codex mark in particular collapsed into an indistinct blob at menu bar size because its detail came from color rather than shape. The marks are now template images — the system tints them black on a light menu bar and white on a dark one, so they stay legible everywhere, and they match the critters, which have always been drawn this way. They are also 14 to 16 points now.

**The 77 modules that sat loose in the repository root are now grouped into packages.** `menubar/`, `loaders/`, `wintray/`, `discussion/`, `tui/`, and `updates/` absorbed 42 of them; the root is down to 35. Nothing moved that runs outside the virtualenv — the status line hooks are still plain files at the top level, because `usage setup` copies them into the user's home directory to run under the system Python. Behavior is unchanged; only import paths moved.

**A test now guards the modules that `main.py` loads by name.** Those loads are plain strings, so no search finds them and a moved module leaves the string pointing at nothing while the whole suite still passes and the app fails to launch. The test reads `main.py` and checks every attribute it calls on such a module against that module's actual contents.

title.zh-TW: 選單列數字與供應商標記更容易辨認
title.en: Menu bar numbers and provider marks are easier to read

body.zh-TW: ⟦把選單列（menu bar，畫面頂端顯示資訊的一條列）想成放在不同牆色前的指示牌：文字和標記得靠粗細與輪廓看清楚，不能只靠原本顏色。⟧百分比維持原有點數，但改為粗體，整條列約增加 5 點；在淺色桌布前也較容易一眼讀到。供應商標記（provider marks，標示服務來源的小圖樣）則改成單色範本影像，會跟著選單列外觀變化：淺色時顯黑，深色時顯白。它們不再倚賴顏色細節，Codex 標記不會在選單列大小縮成模糊一團；也與一向採同樣畫法的 critters 相符。標記大小現在為 14 至 16 點。
body.en: ⟦Think of the menu bar as a sign against changing wall colors: both letters and marks need weight and shape, not color alone, to stay readable.⟧Percentages keep their point size but are now bold, making the strip about 5 points taller and easier to read over light wallpaper. Provider marks, the small images that identify a service, are now monochrome template images. They turn black on a light menu bar and white on a dark one. Shape now does the work that color detail once did, so the Codex mark does not collapse into a blur at menu-bar size; the marks also match the critters, which have always been drawn this way. They are now 14 to 16 points tall.

items.original:
**The menu bar percentages are now bold.** They were drawn at the menu bar's own point size in regular weight, which left them lighter than everything around them — hard to read at a glance over a light wallpaper. Same size, bold weight; the strip grows by about 5 points.
**The provider marks in the menu bar are now monochrome and follow the menu bar's own appearance.** The color art had to work against whatever wallpaper was behind it, and the Codex mark in particular collapsed into an indistinct blob at menu bar size because its detail came from color rather than shape. The marks are now template images — the system tints them black on a light menu bar and white on a dark one, so they stay legible everywhere, and they match the critters, which have always been drawn this way. They are also 14 to 16 points now.

title.zh-TW: 程式搬進分區後，也逐項核對啟動清單
title.en: Moved modules now come with a launch-list check

body.zh-TW: ⟦整理倉庫，搬盒子進分區後仍得核對出貨清單與新架位，否則開門後才發現找不到貨。⟧散在 repository root 的 77 個模組，歸進 packages（套件，程式的可匯入資料夾）。`menubar/`、`loaders/`、`wintray/`、`discussion/`、`tui/`、`updates/` 六個資料夾收進 42 個，root 剩 35 個。這只改 import paths（匯入路徑，程式尋找其他程式碼的位置）。行為不變。虛擬環境外的檔案沒搬；狀態列 hooks（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）仍留頂層，因為 `usage setup` 會複製到家目錄，由系統 Python 執行。`main.py` 以字串載入模組，搜尋找不到；搬走後，字串可能指向空處，測試仍通過，App 卻無法啟動。新增測試讀取 `main.py`，比對呼叫的模組屬性與內容。
body.en: ⟦Tidying a warehouse takes more than moving boxes from the doorway into sections: the shipping list must also be checked against each new shelf, or opening day reveals missing stock.⟧The 77 modules that had been loose in the repository root are now grouped into packages, folders that hold related importable code. `menubar/`, `loaders/`, `wintray/`, `discussion/`, `tui/`, and `updates/` absorbed 42 of them, leaving 35 at the root. Only import paths, where code looks for other code, changed; behavior did not. Files that run outside the virtualenv stayed put: status-line hooks, files called at particular moments, remain at the top level because `usage setup` copies them to the user's home directory for the system Python. `main.py` names modules with plain strings, which search cannot find. A moved module could leave one pointing nowhere, while the test suite still passes and the app fails to launch. A new test reads `main.py` and checks every module attribute it calls against that module's contents.

items.original:
**The 77 modules that sat loose in the repository root are now grouped into packages.** `menubar/`, `loaders/`, `wintray/`, `discussion/`, `tui/`, and `updates/` absorbed 42 of them; the root is down to 35. Nothing moved that runs outside the virtualenv — the status line hooks are still plain files at the top level, because `usage setup` copies them into the user's home directory to run under the system Python. Behavior is unchanged; only import paths moved.
**A test now guards the modules that `main.py` loads by name.** Those loads are plain strings, so no search finds them and a moved module leaves the string pointing at nothing while the whole suite still passes and the app fails to launch. The test reads `main.py` and checks every attribute it calls on such a module against that module's actual contents.

entries: **The Claude Code status line is now verified on Linux.** The hook is stdlib-only and `usage setup` never gated the Claude path on macOS or Windows, so it already worked there — nothing tested it, so it went undocumented. CI now installs the hook against a throwaway `HOME` on Ubuntu and feeds it a real statusLine payload.

**`uvx usage-cli` runs the terminal interface without installing anything.** The CLI is now published to PyPI as `usage-cli`, so Linux and Windows users can try `usage status --json`, the dashboard, and the reports without downloading the macOS app; uv prepares Python 3.13 on its own. `uv tool install usage-cli` keeps the command around as `usage`. The distribution name is `usage-cli` because `usage` was already taken on PyPI in 2016; both `usage` and `usage-cli` are installed as commands. This path ships the CLI only — the menu bar and system tray apps are unchanged and still come from the release downloads.

**Antigravity (agy) usage is now attributed to the project you were actually working in.** Every agy entry previously recorded a fixed `"Antigravity"` project name, so the project usage ranking couldn't show which folder the tokens were spent in. Entries now resolve the working directory from the session's recorded shell commands, falling back to `"Antigravity"` only when none is found.

title.zh-TW: Linux 支援狀態列驗證，標準函式庫掛鉤正式納入測試
title.en: Claude Code status line is verified on Linux with real test payloads

body.zh-TW: 想在 Linux 環境藉由 usage 掌握 Claude Code 的用量與狀態，過去常因文件未提及而不敢確定是否支援。事實上，負責串接的 hook（事件發生時觸發的自動處理程式）僅依賴 Python 標準函式庫，且 `usage setup` 在 macOS 與 Windows 上從未設下系統限制，在 Linux 本就能正常運作；過去只是缺少自動化測試驗證，才一直未寫入官方文件。現在 CI 會在 Ubuntu 系統中建立拋棄式 `HOME` 目錄安裝掛鉤，並傳入真實的 statusLine（終端機底部的即時狀態列）酬載進行驗證。⟦這好比一件出廠就具備防水機能的風衣，過去因說明書未印認證標章讓人不敢在雨天穿出門；直到品管中心在標準測試台噴灑真實水柱，確認它確實防水。⟧
body.en: Linux users looking to track Claude Code usage and metrics through usage previously had to guess whether the integration was supported because it was missing from documentation. In reality, the integration hook relies entirely on the Python standard library, and `usage setup` never placed an operating system check on the Claude path for macOS or Windows, meaning it already functioned on Linux without issue. It simply lacked test coverage and went undocumented. CI now installs the hook against a throwaway `HOME` directory on Ubuntu and feeds it a genuine statusLine payload to verify behavior. ⟦It is like a jacket manufactured with waterproof fabric that lacked a certified badge in the user manual, leaving customers hesitant to wear it in the rain until the quality-control lab blasted it with actual water jets on a test rig and verified that it was waterproof.⟧

items.original: **The Claude Code status line is now verified on Linux.** The hook is stdlib-only and `usage setup` never gated the Claude path on macOS or Windows, so it already worked there — nothing tested it, so it went undocumented. CI now installs the hook against a throwaway `HOME` on Ubuntu and feeds it a real statusLine payload.

title.zh-TW: 命令列套件登陸 PyPI，免裝桌面版即可在終端機直接試用
title.en: CLI package lands on PyPI for instant terminal access without desktop apps

body.zh-TW: 套件已以 `usage-cli` 之名發布至 PyPI，輸入 `uvx usage-cli` 不用先安裝任何東西，uv 會自行準備 Python 3.13 執行環境，讓 Linux 與 Windows 使用者不必下載 macOS 應用程式，就能體驗 `usage status --json`、儀表板與報表。執行 `uv tool install usage-cli` 則可常駐指令；因 `usage` 名稱在 2016 年已被註冊，套件名稱為 `usage-cli`，但安裝後 `usage` 與 `usage-cli` 指令皆可使用。此途徑僅提供命令列工具，選單列與系統匣應用程式仍維持在 Release 下載。⟦這如同工具出租店提供免押金快借服務，想用扳手不必搬整組工具箱回家，報代號就能直接開工；若順手再登記留用。⟧
body.en: `uvx usage-cli` runs without installing anything; uv prepares Python 3.13 on its own so Linux and Windows users can try `usage status --json`, the dashboard, and reports without downloading the macOS app. The CLI is published to PyPI as `usage-cli`. Running `uv tool install usage-cli` keeps the command around; because the name `usage` was claimed on PyPI in 2016, the distribution is `usage-cli`, but both `usage` and `usage-cli` are installed as commands. This path ships the CLI only — menu bar and system tray apps remain unchanged and come from release downloads. ⟦It is like a tool rental counter offering instant on-site borrowing without a deposit, where you can pick up a wrench by its inventory code without purchasing an entire heavy toolbox, and later choose to register and keep that specific wrench in your workshop.⟧

The distribution name is `usage-cli` because `usage` was already taken on PyPI in 2016; both `usage` and `usage-cli` are installed as commands.
