title.zh-TW: 依工作目錄精準歸帳，Antigravity 用量不再全數掛在單一專案
title.en: Antigravity usage is attributed to actual project directories instead of a static label

body.zh-TW: ⟦像公務採購報帳時，若所有發票都一律蓋上總公司大印，月底的部門支出排行便完全看不出各專案到底花了多少經費；唯有依據出差工單上的工作地點逐筆歸帳，才能精準呈現各專案的真實花費。⟧ Antigravity（agy）的用量現在會準確歸屬至你實際作業的專案中。過去每筆 agy 記錄都固定寫入 `"Antigravity"` 專案名稱，導致專案用量排行無法看出 token（AI 計費的文字單位）到底花在哪個資料夾。現在記錄會從各工作階段所執行的 shell 指令中自動解析工作目錄，只有在找不到任何指令紀錄時，才會以備援方式退回使用 `"Antigravity"` 名稱。
body.en: ⟦It is like expense reimbursement at a company where stamping every invoice with a generic corporate seal leaves department expense rankings unable to show how much each project spent, until invoices are attributed to the exact work site from travel logs to reflect accurate project costs.⟧ Antigravity (agy) token consumption is now accurately attributed to the project you were actually working in. Previously, every agy entry recorded a static `"Antigravity"` project name, which prevented the project usage ranking from showing which folder the tokens were spent in. Entries now resolve the working directory from the recorded shell commands in each session, falling back to `"Antigravity"` only when no command is found.

items.original: **Antigravity (agy) usage is now attributed to the project you were actually working in.** Every agy entry previously recorded a fixed `"Antigravity"` project name, so the project usage ranking couldn't show which folder the tokens were spent in. Entries now resolve the working directory from the session's recorded shell commands, falling back to `"Antigravity"` only when none is found.

entries: **The "mask project names" option now applies to the entire shared file.** An exported HTML report previously still carried the unmasked dataset alongside the masked one, so masking hid the names on screen without removing them from the file. The unmasked copy is now dropped from the export. If you shared a masked report from an earlier version, treat those files as unmasked.

**The donut legend and project-naming insights are covered by the mask as well.** Both previously kept showing real project names; insights now read `Project N`, matching the numbering already used by the project table.

**Local files are created with owner-only permissions.** Attachments, exported reports and logs under `~/.usage/`, `~/.usage-reports/` and `~/Library/Logs/usage/` were created with permissions that allowed other local accounts on the same machine to read them. New files are now `0600` and their directories `0700`. Attachment import no longer copies the source file's permissions along with the file.
**The quarantine directory is created with an explicit mode.** Files moved into it already kept owner-only permissions; the directory itself did not.

**An oversized line in a JSONL history file no longer exhausts memory.** Lines are read against a 64 MiB ceiling, set from a measured 23 MB real-world maximum, and skipped cleanly when they exceed it. Deeply nested JSON that raises `RecursionError` is treated as an invalid line.

title.zh-TW: 遮蔽專案名稱全面生效，圖表與匯出檔案不洩密
title.en: Masking project names covers the full exported file, charts, and insights

body.zh-TW: 「遮蔽專案名稱」現在會套用至整份匯出 usage 報表，分享時不再只是把名稱藏在畫面上。過去匯出的 HTML 報表雖然在畫面上隱藏了專案名稱，檔案內部卻仍夾帶未遮蔽的資料集，等於只在螢幕遮住卻沒從檔案拿掉；現在未遮蔽的副本已自匯出檔完全移除。過去圓餅圖圖例與專案名稱深入分析都仍顯示真實專案名稱；現在兩者也一併納入遮蔽，分析文字改為 `Project N`，對齊專案表格既有的編號。⟦這像拿黑筆塗黑公文上的機密名稱，以前只塗了複寫紙表面、底層仍夾著原稿；現在則在寄出前把原始底稿徹底抽除。⟧若你曾分享過舊版產生的遮蔽報表，請將那些檔案視為未遮蔽處理。
body.en: The "mask project names" option now applies to the entire exported usage report, rather than merely hiding names on screen when you share it. Previously, an exported HTML report still carried the unmasked dataset alongside the masked one, hiding project names on screen without actually removing them from the file; that unmasked copy is now completely dropped from exports. Previously, both the donut legend and project-naming insights still showed real project names; both are now covered by the mask, with insights displaying `Project N` to match the numbering in the project table. ⟦It is like redacting confidential names on a document: earlier releases only blacked out the top carbon copy while leaving the original underneath, but the source sheet is now completely removed before delivery.⟧ If you shared a masked report generated by an earlier version, treat those files as unmasked.

items.original:
**The "mask project names" option now applies to the entire shared file.** An exported HTML report previously still carried the unmasked dataset alongside the masked one, so masking hid the names on screen without removing them from the file. The unmasked copy is now dropped from the export. If you shared a masked report from an earlier version, treat those files as unmasked.
**The donut legend and project-naming insights are covered by the mask as well.** Both previously kept showing real project names; insights now read `Project N`, matching the numbering already used by the project table.

title.zh-TW: 本機檔案限擁有者，隔離目錄明確設定存取模式
title.en: Local files are owner-only; the quarantine directory gets an explicit access mode

body.zh-TW: ⟦在共用辦公室存放私人物品，不只要把置物箱上鎖，放箱子的儲藏室大門也得加鎖，同棟樓的其他帳號才翻看不到內容。⟧ usage 現在為本機建立的檔案與目錄全面套用僅限擁有者的存取權限。以往存放在 `~/.usage/`、`~/.usage-reports/` 與 `~/Library/Logs/usage/` 底下的附件、匯出報表與紀錄檔，權限曾允許同部電腦的其他本機帳號讀取；現在新建立的檔案權限一律設為 `0600`，所屬目錄則設為 `0700`。匯入附件時也不再複製來源檔案原有的權限。此外，過去移入隔離目錄的檔案雖保有擁有者權限，但目錄本身並未限制；現在該隔離目錄在建立時也會設定明確的存取模式。
body.en: ⟦When storing personal items in a shared building, locking individual storage bins is not enough; the storage room door itself must be secured so other tenants in the building cannot browse the contents.⟧ usage now creates local files and directories with owner-only access permissions. Attachments, exported reports, and logs under `~/.usage/`, `~/.usage-reports/`, and `~/Library/Logs/usage/` were previously created with permissions that let other local accounts on the same machine read them; new files are now `0600` and their directories `0700`. Importing attachments also stops copying the source file's existing permissions. Additionally, while files moved into the quarantine directory already kept owner-only permissions, the quarantine directory itself now receives an explicit access mode upon creation.

items.original:
**Local files are created with owner-only permissions.** Attachments, exported reports and logs under `~/.usage/`, `~/.usage-reports/` and `~/Library/Logs/usage/` were created with permissions that allowed other local accounts on the same machine to read them. New files are now `0600` and their directories `0700`. Attachment import no longer copies the source file's permissions along with the file.
**The quarantine directory is created with an explicit mode.** Files moved into it already kept owner-only permissions; the directory itself did not.

title.zh-TW: 超長行設上限，深層巢狀改列無效行
title.en: Oversized JSONL lines are capped; deep nesting is treated as invalid

body.zh-TW: JSONL（每行各放一筆 JSON 資料的檔案格式）歷史檔案中的異常大行，不再會耗盡記憶體、拖垮整個讀取流程。usage 現在以 64 MiB 為上限來讀取每行資料，這個數值是根據實測真實環境中 23 MB 的最大記錄所設定；一旦單行資料超過此上限，程式會直接略過它並繼續運作。遇到層層巢狀過深而引發遞迴錯誤（`RecursionError`）的 JSON 內容，也會直接當成無效行處理。⟦這像包裹分揀線入口設了兩道檢查：尺寸過大的貨物，以及包裝層數深到難以檢查的貨物，都直接撥到旁道，讓其他包裹繼續前進。⟧這能防止超過 64 MiB 或因巢狀過深引發 RecursionError 的歷史資料中斷讀取流程。
body.en: An oversized line in a JSONL (a file format with one JSON record per line) history file will no longer exhaust memory or derail reading. Lines are now read against a 64 MiB ceiling, which was set from a measured real-world maximum of 23 MB; whenever a line exceeds this threshold, it is skipped so processing can continue. Deeply nested JSON structures that raise a recursion error (`RecursionError`) are likewise treated as invalid lines. ⟦It is like a parcel sorting line with two screening checks: items that are too large or wrapped in layers too deep to inspect are sent directly down a side lane, while the rest keeps moving.⟧ This ensures history files containing oversized lines or deeply nested JSON that raises RecursionError cannot derail your usage history.

items.original: **An oversized line in a JSONL history file no longer exhausts memory.** Lines are read against a 64 MiB ceiling, set from a measured 23 MB real-world maximum, and skipped cleanly when they exceed it. Deeply nested JSON that raises `RecursionError` is treated as an invalid line.

entries: **`usage status` no longer prints floating-point noise in percentages.** Session and weekly percentages were interpolated straight into the string, so a value like 42.30000000000001 could appear instead of 42.3. Both are now formatted to one decimal place.

**The Windows tray tooltip shows the same numbers as the panel, and no longer omits Antigravity.** It displayed *remaining* percent (100 minus used) while every panel shows *used* percent; the tooltip now matches, and adds its own Antigravity line when that card isn't hidden. The Claude line was also reformatted to match Codex and Antigravity's single-line "Session · Weekly" layout.

**Windows update notifications no longer show raw Markdown.** The GitHub Release body's `##`, `**`, and `` ` `` markers rendered literally in the update dialog; macOS fixed this in 0.29.28 but the fix never reached Windows. Both platforms now share the same formatter.

**The public website's mobile navigation and shareable anchors are fixed.** Below 640px the navigation disappeared entirely — a labeled Sections menu now expands in its place. Switching language no longer overwrites a shared anchor like `#install` with `#<lang>`, so links copied before a language switch keep working. Footer text now meets AA contrast, images lazy-load, and tap targets are at least 24px (44px in the main mobile nav).
**The website's theme count was corrected from 12 to 13** — Catppuccin, shipped in 0.29.23, wasn't being counted — across all five languages.

**The social preview image reflects Windows support and reuses the site's own visuals.** It used to say "macOS Menu Bar App"; the new 1200×630 image pairs the brand and title with an actual panel screenshot (Claude, Codex, Antigravity) in the site's own colors, and dropped from 573KB to 96KB.
**README status-line screenshots are now recorded animations**, one per language instead of borrowed from English, made legible at README width.

**Status-line setup is now its own README section** instead of a subsection buried under Windows Support, so macOS users don't skip it, with terminology filled in for both platforms and Traditional Chinese.

title.zh-TW: usage status 消除百分比雜訊，統一保留一位小數
title.en: usage status removes floating-point noise from percentage outputs

body.zh-TW: 在終端機執行 `usage status` 查詢額度時，工作階段（session，單次使用的時間區段）與每週百分比數值不再出現多餘的小數雜訊。過去程式將數值直接拼進字串，導致畫面上可能出現如 42.30000000000001 這類冗長的小數。⟦這就像電子磅秤把原本因感應過敏而跳出的一長串零碎小數抹平，在螢幕上整齊收攏到小數點後一位。⟧現在這兩項百分比都統一格式化為一位小數（例如 42.3），讓輸出的資訊乾淨俐落。
body.en: Running `usage status` to inspect your quotas will no longer spit out messy floating-point noise in session and weekly percentages. The tool previously interpolated raw numerical values directly into output strings, producing cluttered readouts like 42.30000000000001 instead of a clean 42.3. ⟦It is like a digital scale rounding off jittery multi-digit fractions to show a single steady decimal on its display.⟧ Both session and weekly metrics are now strictly formatted to one decimal place, keeping terminal output predictable and tidy.

items.original: **`usage status` no longer prints floating-point noise in percentages.** Session and weekly percentages were interpolated straight into the string, so a value like 42.30000000000001 could appear instead of 42.3. Both are now formatted to one decimal place.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣提示對齊面板數值，納入 Antigravity
title.en: Windows tray tooltip aligns with panel values and includes Antigravity

body.zh-TW: 把游標移到 Windows 系統匣（tray，工作列右側的常駐圖示區）圖示上方時，浮動提示文字顯示的數值現在與面板完全一致，而且不再漏掉 Antigravity。過去提示文字顯示的是「剩餘」百分比（以 100 減去已用量），而各個面板顯示的都是「已使用」百分比，兩邊數字對不起來。⟦這如同把公告欄的各項用量改用同一個已使用標準，補上漏列的 Antigravity，並把 Claude 條目整理成和其餘項目相同的一行格式。⟧現在提示文字統一改為已使用百分比，並在 Antigravity 卡片未隱藏時補上專屬一行；Claude 的顯示行也同步重構為與 Codex 和 Antigravity 一致的單行「工作階段 · 每週」排版。
body.en: Hovering over the Windows system tray icon now reveals tooltip figures that perfectly match what you see inside the main panel, while no longer skipping Antigravity. The tooltip previously showed the *remaining* percentage (calculated as 100 minus used) while every panel displays the *used* percentage, creating unnecessary confusion. ⟦It is like giving every line on a noticeboard one used-amount standard, restoring the missing Antigravity line, and setting the Claude entry in the same one-line format as the rest.⟧ The tooltip now reports used percentages across the board, adds an Antigravity row whenever that card is visible, and reformats the Claude entry to match Codex and Antigravity's single-line "Session · Weekly" layout.

items.original: **The Windows tray tooltip shows the same numbers as the panel, and no longer omits Antigravity.** It displayed *remaining* percent (100 minus used) while every panel shows *used* percent; the tooltip now matches, and adds its own Antigravity line when that card isn't hidden. The Claude line was also reformatted to match Codex and Antigravity's single-line "Session · Weekly" layout.

title.zh-TW: Windows 更新通知去除原始 Markdown 標記
title.en: Windows update notifications strip raw Markdown markers

body.zh-TW: 當 Windows 跳出新版本更新通知時，說明視窗不再直接印出未解析的 Markdown（以特殊符號標示粗體或標題的排版語法）原始標記。先前來自 GitHub Release 內文的 `##` 標題、`**` 粗體與 `` ` `` 程式碼符號，在更新對話框中都會被原樣渲染出來。這項問題在 macOS 平台已於 0.29.28 版解決，但修復一直未同步至 Windows 平台；現在兩個系統已共用同一套格式化處理器。⟦這好比印刷廠在樣品書送達各分店前先將排版標記擦拭乾淨，讓讀者看見精緻排版而非編輯痕跡。⟧
body.en: Update dialogs on Windows will no longer greet you with unformatted Markdown markup when a new version drops. Release descriptions pulled from GitHub previously rendered literal `##`, `**`, and `` ` `` tokens directly inside the notification window. While macOS resolved this display glitch in version 0.29.28, the corresponding fix had not made its way to Windows until now. Both platforms now route release text through the shared formatter. ⟦It is like a printing press stripping proofreading marks before handing books to readers across every branch store.⟧

items.original: **Windows update notifications no longer show raw Markdown.** The GitHub Release body's `##`, `**`, and `` ` `` markers rendered literally in the update dialog; macOS fixed this in 0.29.28 but the fix never reached Windows. Both platforms now share the same formatter.

title.zh-TW: 官網修復行動版導覽與分享錨點
title.en: Website fixes mobile navigation and shareable anchors

body.zh-TW: 用手機瀏覽 usage 官方網站時，窄螢幕不會再失去導覽方向。在螢幕寬度低於 640px 時，原本整條消失的導覽列現在改由標示 Sections 的展開選單替代。⟦好比登山步道的窄入口設有可展開路線牌，改走其他語言路線時，原本標記的位置仍保留下來。⟧切換語言也不再把 `#install` 等分享錨點改寫為 `#<lang>`，因此在切換前複製的連結仍能開啟原先位置。
body.en: On the public website, a narrow mobile screen will no longer leave you without a way to navigate. Below 640px, the navigation bar that previously disappeared entirely is replaced by a labeled, expandable Sections menu. ⟦It is like a narrow trailhead gaining an expandable route board that keeps your marked location when you switch to another language route.⟧ Switching languages also no longer rewrites shared anchors such as `#install` to `#<lang>`, so links copied before a language switch still open at their original location.

items.original: **The public website's mobile navigation and shareable anchors are fixed.** Below 640px the navigation disappeared entirely — a labeled Sections menu now expands in its place. Switching language no longer overwrites a shared anchor like `#install` with `#<lang>`, so links copied before a language switch keep working. Footer text now meets AA contrast, images lazy-load, and tap targets are at least 24px (44px in the main mobile nav).

title.zh-TW: 官網補強頁尾可讀性、圖片載入與點擊操作
title.en: Website improves footer readability, image loading, and tap targets

body.zh-TW: 網站在手機上顯示時，容易被忽略的可讀性與操作細節也一併補齊。頁尾文字現在符合 AA 級對比要求，前景與背景的差異足以辨識；圖片改為需要顯示時才讀取。⟦這像候車資訊換成人人看得清楚的字，月台畫面接近時才亮起，按鈕與連結的可點擊區域也留出足夠空間。⟧各個點擊目標至少為 24px，行動版主導覽則為 44px，手指操作更不容易按偏。
body.en: On mobile, the public website now also covers readability and interaction details that are easy to overlook. Footer text meets AA contrast requirements, making foreground and background easier to distinguish, while images lazy-load only when needed. ⟦It is like making station information readable to everyone, lighting up platform displays only as you approach, and leaving enough room for the clickable areas of buttons and links.⟧ Every tap target measures at least 24px, with the primary mobile navigation reaching 44px to make finger input less error-prone.

items.original: **The public website's mobile navigation and shareable anchors are fixed.** Below 640px the navigation disappeared entirely — a labeled Sections menu now expands in its place. Switching language no longer overwrites a shared anchor like `#install` with `#<lang>`, so links copied before a language switch keep working. Footer text now meets AA contrast, images lazy-load, and tap targets are at least 24px (44px in the main mobile nav).

title.zh-TW: 官網主題總數校正為 13 款，補齊 Catppuccin 計數
title.en: Website theme count updated from 12 to 13 to include Catppuccin

body.zh-TW: 瀏覽官方網站的主題清單時，頁面上標示的主題總數已在全部五種語言版本中統一由 12 款修正為 13 款。先前在 0.29.23 版推出的 Catppuccin 主題配色一直未被計入網站的統計數字中，這次更新在所有語系頁面中如實補上了這項遺漏。⟦這像展示櫃明明陳列了 13 款特色商品，外頭目錄清單卻少算了一款，如今目錄將漏掉的款式如實補上，讓各語系型錄的標示與架上款式完全一致。⟧現在造訪官網不同語言版本，所見的主題統計都能正確反映當前完整的 13 種配色。
body.en: The theme counter across all five language versions of the public website has been updated from 12 to 13. The Catppuccin color scheme introduced in version 0.29.23 had been left out of the site's tally, causing the displayed figure to lag behind reality. ⟦This is like a showroom featuring 13 distinct models while the printed catalog mistakenly tallies 12 until an update fixes the count.⟧ Every localized version of the website now accurately showcases the full lineup of 13 themes.

items.original: **The website's theme count was corrected from 12 to 13** — Catppuccin, shipped in 0.29.23, wasn't being counted — across all five languages.

title.zh-TW: 社群預覽圖反映 Windows 支援，體積縮小更輕量
title.en: Social preview image reflects Windows support and shrinks in size

body.zh-TW: 在社群平台分享官方網站連結時，縮圖卡片（social preview image，社群預覽圖片）已全面翻新。過去圖片標題寫著「macOS Menu Bar App」，現在全新的 1200×630 圖片將品牌與標題結合網站原生配色的實際面板截圖（涵蓋 Claude、Codex 與 Antigravity），清楚展現對 Windows 的支援。此外，圖片檔案大小也從原本的 573KB 大幅縮減至 96KB，讓分享預覽圖檔案更輕量。⟦像車站指示牌原本只標示 macOS，現加入 Windows、放上實際服務面板，並換成更輕薄的材質。⟧
body.en: Sharing website links on social platforms now generates an updated preview card that reflects Windows availability alongside macOS. The old image labeled the project strictly as a "macOS Menu Bar App", whereas the new 1200×630 visual pairs the brand and title with an authentic panel screenshot (featuring Claude, Codex, and Antigravity) rendered in the site's distinct color palette. File size dropped dramatically from 573KB down to 96KB, with the smaller preview file size. ⟦It is like a station sign that previously listed only macOS, now adding Windows and an authentic service-panel image on lighter material.⟧

items.original: **The social preview image reflects Windows support and reuses the site's own visuals.** It used to say "macOS Menu Bar App"; the new 1200×630 image pairs the brand and title with an actual panel screenshot (Claude, Codex, Antigravity) in the site's own colors, and dropped from 573KB to 96KB.

title.zh-TW: README 狀態列截圖升級為多語言動態展示
title.en: README status-line screenshots upgraded to localized animations

body.zh-TW: 查閱 README 說明文件時，狀態列（status line，顯示在終端機底部的即時資訊列）展示畫面已升級為動態錄製的動畫。過去非英文語系都是借用英文版的靜態截圖，現在每一種語言版本都配備了專屬的錄製動圖。⟦如同健身教室不再讓所有學員看同一張英文姿勢照片，而是依各語言播放專屬的動態示範。⟧所有動圖都針對 README 的版面寬度進行了最佳化調整，確保文字在各語言環境下都能清晰易讀。
body.en: Viewing the status-line previews in the README now presents fully recorded animations tailored to each language. Non-English translations previously borrowed static screenshots from the English README. ⟦It is like a fitness class no longer showing every learner the same English posture photo, but playing a dedicated moving demonstration for each language.⟧ Every supported language now features its own animated recording, scaled to stay sharp and legible within the standard README reading width.

items.original: **README status-line screenshots are now recorded animations**, one per language instead of borrowed from English, made legible at README width.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列設定升格為 README 獨立章節，補齊平台術語
title.en: Status-line setup becomes a dedicated README section with platform terms

body.zh-TW: 想在終端機配置狀態列的讀者，現在能在 README 中直接找到專屬的設定章節。過去這段教學作為子章節被埋在 Windows Support（Windows 支援）底下，導致 macOS 使用者容易直接錯過；現在它被獨立成頂層章節，並完整補齊了兩大平台與繁體中文的專業術語對照。⟦彷彿將熱門服務台從特定附錄搬到大廳正中央，並補齊多系統與繁體中文標籤，讓所有訪客一進門就能找到指引。⟧無論你在哪種作業系統上使用 usage，都能順暢依照母語術語完成狀態列設定。
body.en: Finding setup instructions for terminal status-lines in the README is now immediate and straightforward. The guide was formerly tucked away as a sub-topic under Windows Support, causing macOS users to overlook it entirely. It now commands its own dedicated section, complete with terminology aligned for both platforms and Traditional Chinese. ⟦As if moving a popular information desk from a remote corner annex to the main lobby so visitors on every path spot it right away.⟧ Users across operating systems can now easily locate relevant setup steps and terminology.

items.original: **Status-line setup is now its own README section** instead of a subsection buried under Windows Support, so macOS users don't skip it, with terminology filled in for both platforms and Traditional Chinese.

entries: **Cards trace a warning light around their border at 90%.** When a Session or weekly row crosses 90%, a red arc travels around that card's edge once every 2.6 seconds, on the Claude, Codex, and Antigravity cards alike. The Default panel carries it today; other panels are unchanged.
**Progress tracks now mark the 80% threshold.** A tick sits where the bar turns red, so how much headroom is left reads at a glance instead of only from the percentage text.

**The rate label now falls back after you stop working.** Burn rate divided by the span between the first and last usage entry, which left idle time out of the denominator — a ten-minute burst followed by a forty-minute break stayed pinned at "Heavy" until those entries aged out of the one-hour window. It now divides by the time elapsed since the first entry, so the rate decays while you are away. Thresholds and the cache-read exclusion are unchanged.
**Numeric readouts line up.** Project token counts, costs, and percentages use tabular figures, so the columns stop shifting as the digits change.
**Keyboard focus is visible on the Default panel**, and its buttons now animate between hover states instead of snapping. Both respect the system's reduced-motion setting.

title.zh-TW: 超過九成亮起外框紅光，Default 面板警戒更直觀
title.en: Card borders trace warning lights at 90% in Default panel

body.zh-TW: Default 面板的卡片外框會亮起紅色動態警示，標出超過 90% 的工作階段（session，單次對話或任務的連續使用期間）或每週用量。⟦如同精密儀器在警戒線邊界亮起環形跑馬燈，紅光沿著邊緣繞行，提醒操作者留意殘量。⟧一條紅色弧線每 2.6 秒會繞著卡片邊緣跑動一圈，在 Claude、Codex 與 Antigravity 卡片上皆有一致的視覺效果。目前這項警戒光效果由 Default 面板提供，其餘面板則維持不變。
body.en: The Default panel now traces a red active warning light around the border of any session or weekly row above 90%. ⟦It is like a precision instrument activating a perimeter warning beacon at critical capacity, running a red glow along the edge to alert the operator.⟧ A red arc travels around the card's edge once every 2.6 seconds, appearing consistently across Claude, Codex, and Antigravity cards. The Default panel carries this warning light today, while other panels remain unchanged.

items.original: **Cards trace a warning light around their border at 90%.** When a Session or weekly row crosses 90%, a red arc travels around that card's edge once every 2.6 seconds, on the Claude, Codex, and Antigravity cards alike. The Default panel carries it today; other panels are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 進度條標出八成門檻刻度，剩餘額度一眼看清
title.en: Progress tracks mark the 80% threshold for at-a-glance headroom

body.zh-TW: 上限前還剩多少額度，現在能從進度條一眼看出。進度軌道在 80% 門檻處新增了刻度標記，位置正好落在進度條轉為紅色的交界點。這讓你能一眼看出達到上限前還剩下多少可用餘裕（headroom，額度耗盡前的剩餘緩衝空間），不必再依賴純文字數字進行推算。⟦這好比在透明量筒的八成高度標上一道分界刻度，液面一逼近紅線，不必細讀數字刻度也能立刻掌握剩餘容量。⟧
body.en: Remaining headroom is now visible at a glance instead of requiring you to read percentage text. Progress tracks now display a tick mark at the 80% threshold, positioned precisely where the bar turns red. This allows you to assess how much headroom (the buffer remaining before hitting limits) is left at a glance instead of reading raw percentage text. ⟦It is like marking a boundary line at the eighty percent level on a measuring cylinder, letting you gauge remaining capacity the moment fluid nears the line without inspecting numbers.⟧

items.original: **Progress tracks now mark the 80% threshold.** A tick sits where the bar turns red, so how much headroom is left reads at a glance instead of only from the percentage text.

title.zh-TW: 休息時消耗速率自動回落，計入閒置時間更貼近真實
title.en: Burn rate decays after stopping work as idle time enters the denominator

body.zh-TW: 密集使用 10 分鐘後休息 40 分鐘，消耗速率標籤會開始回落，不再一直釘在「Heavy」。過去計算速率時，只除以第一筆到最後一筆紀錄之間的間隔，分母漏掉了閒置時間；這導致密集使用 10 分鐘後休息 40 分鐘，標籤仍會被釘在「Heavy」狀態，直到滿 1 小時視窗過期。現在分母改以第一筆紀錄起算經過的總時間計算，離開時速率就會逐漸衰減。各級門檻與快取讀取（cache-read，讀取暫存資料）排除規則皆維持不變。⟦這如同計算長途旅行的平均時速，把停靠休息站的空檔也算入時間分母，車子熄火後儀表板均速便會自然往下降。⟧
body.en: A ten-minute burst followed by a forty-minute break no longer leaves the rate label pinned at "Heavy". Previously, burn rate was calculated by dividing only by the span between the first and last usage entry, excluding idle time from the denominator; a ten-minute burst followed by a forty-minute break stayed pinned at "Heavy" until those entries aged out of the one-hour window. The rate now divides by the total time elapsed since the first entry, allowing it to decay while you are away. Threshold levels and the cache-read exclusion remain unchanged. ⟦It is like calculating trip speed by including time spent parked at a rest stop in the denominator, so average speed steadily drops while the engine is off.⟧

items.original: **The rate label now falls back after you stop working.** Burn rate divided by the span between the first and last usage entry, which left idle time out of the denominator — a ten-minute burst followed by a forty-minute break stayed pinned at "Heavy" until those entries aged out of the one-hour window. It now divides by the time elapsed since the first entry, so the rate decays while you are away. Thresholds and the cache-read exclusion are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 專案讀數改用等寬數字，排版欄位不再左右晃動
title.en: Tabular figures align project readouts and stop column shifts

body.zh-TW: 數字跳動時，專案用量清單的欄位不再左右晃動或錯位了。⟦這有如機械翻牌式時刻表，每個數字格子寬度完全相同，任一欄位跳動都不會推擠到鄰近文字。⟧專案 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計數、花費金額與百分比全面改用等寬數字，每個數字字元佔據相同寬度。當數值隨用量即時跳動時，縱向欄位不再左右晃動或錯位，版面閱讀體驗更加穩定。
body.en: As digits change, columns in project usage lists no longer shift side to side. ⟦It is like a mechanical flip-board schedule where every digit occupies an identical slot width, preventing changes in one column from shoving neighboring text.⟧ Project token (the unit for AI processing and billing) counts, costs, and percentages now use tabular figures with uniform widths. As digits change with live activity, columns stop shifting or jittering horizontally, creating a steady visual layout.

items.original: **Numeric readouts line up.** Project token counts, costs, and percentages use tabular figures, so the columns stop shifting as the digits change.

title.zh-TW: Default 面板看清鍵盤焦點，按鈕平滑過渡並遵循動態偏好
title.en: Default panel shows keyboard focus and animates hover states smoothly

body.zh-TW: Default 面板會清楚亮出鍵盤焦點（focus，鍵盤目前選中並可接收按鍵指令的介面位置）。面板上的按鈕在滑鼠懸停（hover）狀態之間，也改以平滑動畫過渡，不再生硬地瞬間切換。這兩項視覺改進都會自動遵循系統的「減少動態效果」設定，若使用者偏好靜態介面，系統會關閉動態過渡。⟦宛如舞台上的聚光燈與調光燈具，鍵盤移動時焦點清晰可辨，游標滑過時按鈕柔和漸變，遇到調暗需求時也能維持靜止。⟧
body.en: The Default panel now clearly shows keyboard focus (the interface element currently selected to receive keystrokes). Buttons on the panel also animate smoothly between hover states rather than snapping abruptly. Both visual improvements respect the system's reduced-motion setting, falling back to static states if the user prefers reduced motion. ⟦It is like stage spotlights paired with dimmer switches: the focus is immediately clear as you step through, buttons glow smoothly as the cursor passes, and transitions remain static whenever calm lighting is requested.⟧

items.original: **Keyboard focus is visible on the Default panel**, and its buttons now animate between hover states instead of snapping. Both respect the system's reduced-motion setting.

entries: **usage has a new icon: an ink-brush cat.** The menu bar glyph and the app icon both use it.

**The Matrix and Cloud Observation panels let their backgrounds through.** Matrix cards are more translucent, so the falling glyphs read as a moving backdrop instead of a barely visible texture. Cloud Observation's sky is deeper and its cards are lighter, so the drifting clouds pass behind the quota rows rather than washing the whole panel white.

**Origami panel reset times are readable again.** The reset line sat on the dark blue folded corner in the same blue as the paper, leaving almost no contrast. It now uses a darker weight with a faint halo, so it reads on any part of the fold — and the second row on the Claude card is no longer clipped by the card's bottom edge.
**Update notifications no longer show raw Markdown.** Release notes rendered in the update dialog kept their `**` and `` ` `` markers.

title.zh-TW: 墨刷貓成為 usage 的新圖示
title.en: An ink-brush cat becomes usage's new icon

body.zh-TW: 想在選單列一眼認出 usage 時，墨刷貓也會出現在應用程式圖示上，讓你能沿著同一個標記找到它。這是 usage 的新圖示，選單列的符號和應用程式圖示都改用它。⟦像店家把門口招牌與名片換成同一枚手繪印記：兩個入口雖在不同地方，認得的都是同一家店。⟧不只應用程式圖示，選單列的符號也採用這隻貓；無論從哪一處看到 usage，使用的都是同一個新標記，兩處設計保持一致。
body.en: Spot usage at a glance in the menu bar, then find the same ink-brush cat again on its app icon. It is usage's new icon, used both for the menu-bar glyph and the app icon. ⟦It is like a shop giving its front sign and business card the same hand-drawn mark: the entrances differ, but both point to the same shop.⟧ The cat is not limited to the app icon; the menu-bar glyph uses it too, so both places carry the same new mark.

items.original: **usage has a new icon: an ink-brush cat.** The menu bar glyph and the app icon both use it.

title.zh-TW: Matrix 與 Cloud Observation 讓背景穿過卡片
title.en: Matrix and Cloud Observation let their backdrops show through

body.zh-TW: 卡片幾乎遮住背景時，Matrix 落下的字元只像難以看清的紋理，Cloud Observation 的雲也容易把面板洗成白色。⟦這像在玻璃舞台前掛上半透明布幕：後面的動態仍看得見，前方的內容則留在自己的位置。⟧Matrix 的卡片變得更透明，讓落下的字元讀起來像在移動的背景，不再只是難以看見的紋理。Cloud Observation 的天空更深、卡片更淺，飄動的雲會從額度列後方通過，而不會把整個面板洗成白色。
body.en: When cards almost hide the backdrop, Matrix's falling glyphs are only a hard-to-see texture and Cloud Observation's clouds can wash the panel white. ⟦It is like hanging a translucent curtain in front of a glass stage: movement behind it remains visible while the material in front stays in place.⟧ Matrix cards are more translucent, making the falling glyphs read as a moving backdrop rather than a barely visible texture. Cloud Observation has a deeper sky and lighter cards, so drifting clouds pass behind the quota rows instead of washing the whole panel white.

items.original: **The Matrix and Cloud Observation panels let their backgrounds through.** Matrix cards are more translucent, so the falling glyphs read as a moving backdrop instead of a barely visible texture. Cloud Observation's sky is deeper and its cards are lighter, so the drifting clouds pass behind the quota rows rather than washing the whole panel white.

title.zh-TW: Origami 的重設時間重新看得清
title.en: Origami reset times are readable again

body.zh-TW: 想看 Origami 何時重設，卻得在深藍折角上找同色文字時，原本幾乎都辨認不出來。以前深藍折角上的同色文字幾乎融進紙面，幾乎沒有對比，難以辨認。⟦像在深色摺紙上寫字，筆畫太接近紙色便看不出來；換成較深的筆觸，再加一圈淡淡光暈，字就能跨過每道摺線被讀到。⟧現在重設那一行改用較深的字重和淡淡光暈，無論落在折頁哪一處都看得清楚。
body.en: Trying to see when Origami resets meant hunting for same-blue text on a dark-blue folded corner, where it was almost impossible to make out. The same-blue text on a dark-blue folded corner used to nearly disappear into the paper. ⟦It was like writing on dark origami with ink too close to the paper's color; a darker stroke and a faint halo let the words cross every fold and remain readable.⟧ The reset line now has a darker weight and faint halo, so it can be read on any part of the fold.

items.original: **Origami panel reset times are readable again.** The reset line sat on the dark blue folded corner in the same blue as the paper, leaving almost no contrast. It now uses a darker weight with a faint halo, so it reads on any part of the fold — and the second row on the Claude card is no longer clipped by the card's bottom edge.

title.zh-TW: Claude 卡片第二行不再被底部裁掉
title.en: The second row on the Claude card stays clear of the bottom edge.

body.zh-TW: Claude 卡片裡的內容排到第二行時，最後一截曾在閱讀時被卡片底部遮住而看不見。原本顯示到第二行的內容，會在卡片下緣被截斷，讀到一半就少了一截。⟦像把紙條塞進有透明窗的名牌套：窗框不該蓋住最後一行，內容應完整落在可見範圍內。⟧現在卡片底部不會再壓住第二行，讓顯示在第二行的文字都能從頭到尾完整看清楚，不再有任何部分在底部被裁掉。
body.en: When content on a Claude card reached the second row, its last part used to vanish behind the card's bottom edge. Previously, content reaching that row could be cut off at the lower boundary, leaving part of the line out of sight. ⟦It is like sliding a label into a badge holder with a clear window: the frame should not cover the last line, and the whole message belongs inside the visible area.⟧ The bottom of the card no longer covers the second row, so its text can be read from beginning to end.

items.original: **Origami panel reset times are readable again.** The reset line sat on the dark blue folded corner in the same blue as the paper, leaving almost no contrast. It now uses a darker weight with a faint halo, so it reads on any part of the fold — and the second row on the Claude card is no longer clipped by the card's bottom edge.

title.zh-TW: 更新通知不再露出 Markdown 格式記號
title.en: Update notifications stop exposing raw Markdown markers

body.zh-TW: 打開更新通知想看版本說明，卻先遇到 `**` 和 `` ` `` 這些格式記號。Markdown（用符號標示粗體或程式碼的文字格式）原本應先被轉成可讀文字，但更新對話框裡的 release notes 曾把它們直接顯示出來。⟦這像餐廳把廚房的備料標籤連同菜一起端上桌；現在端出的版本說明只留下讀者要看的內容。⟧你在更新對話框讀 release notes 時，不必再把那些格式符號當成正文的一部分。
body.en: You open an update notification to read the release notes, only to meet raw `**` and `` ` `` markers first. Markdown is a text format that uses symbols for such things as bold text and code, but the update dialog had been displaying those symbols literally. ⟦It was like serving a dish with the kitchen's prep labels still attached; the release notes now present the content meant for the reader.⟧ You no longer need to treat those formatting symbols as part of the release notes in the update dialog.

items.original: **Update notifications no longer show raw Markdown.** Release notes rendered in the update dialog kept their `**` and `` ` `` markers.

entries: **`usage status` prints your quota for other tools to read.** Until now the only way to get quota out of usage was to import its internals from Python. `usage status` gives a one-line summary, `usage status --json` gives a versioned JSON payload, and both read the same local files as the menu bar — no network call. The [development docs](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) include ready-made Starship and tmux snippets.

**Releases now ship build provenance and an SBOM.** Every macOS and Windows artifact carries a signed SLSA build-provenance attestation, verifiable with `gh attestation verify <file> --repo aqua5230/usage`, and the macOS release includes a CycloneDX software bill of materials listing every bundled dependency.

**The offline price table now says how old it is.** When the upstream price list can't be reached, usage falls back to a built-in table; that table now records the date it was last checked against upstream and logs a warning when it is used, so a silently outdated price can be spotted instead of quietly skewing your cost totals.

**Installing usage as a Python package no longer leaves modules behind.** The packaging allowlist covered 39 of the 74 top-level modules, so an installed copy crashed with `ModuleNotFoundError`. The list is complete now and a test keeps it that way.

title.zh-TW: 用指令快速查額度，終端機與狀態列隨調隨用
title.en: Check quota directly via CLI for external terminal tools

body.zh-TW: 想在 Starship 提示字元或 tmux 狀態列隨時盯著 AI 剩餘額度，過去就像非得請水電工拆開儀表箱才能讀取數據，必須寫 Python 程式硬挖 usage 的內部模組。現在正面直接裝上了液晶小螢幕：新指令 `usage status` 會直接印出一行摘要，加上 `--json` 參數還能輸出帶版號的 JSON 資料。兩者跟選單列讀取同一份本機檔案，完全不發送額外網路請求，看一眼就知道剩餘額度而不用聯網查詢；官方開發文件還附上了現成的設定範例，方便你直接貼進設定檔。
body.en: If you want your Starship prompt or tmux status bar to show remaining AI quota, you no longer need to write custom Python scripts importing usage's internal modules. The new `usage status` command prints a concise one-line summary, and `--json` outputs a versioned JSON payload. Both read the same local files as the menu bar item, requiring zero network calls. Ready-made snippets in the development documentation make setup immediate. It is like a utility meter on a house: instead of calling a technician to disassemble the mechanical counter inside, a digital readout on the front now lets any display read current consumption without contacting the utility company.

items.original: **`usage status` prints your quota for other tools to read.** Until now the only way to get quota out of usage was to import its internals from Python. `usage status` gives a one-line summary, `usage status --json` gives a versioned JSON payload, and both read the same local files as the menu bar — no network call. The [development docs](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) include ready-made Starship and tmux snippets.

title.zh-TW: 附帶組建來源證明與物料清單，安裝檔來源透明可驗證
title.en: Releases include build provenance and SBOM for verified security

body.zh-TW: 下載安裝檔時，現在你可以確切核實檔案是否真的由官方原始碼編譯而成。每個 macOS 與 Windows 發行檔案現在都附帶經過數位簽署的 SLSA 組建來源證明，只要執行 `gh attestation verify <file> --repo aqua5230/usage` 指令就能核對檔案產銷履歷；macOS 版本還額外附上 CycloneDX 格式的軟體物料清單（SBOM，詳細列出所有內建相依套件的名冊）。這種透明度好比購買進口食品，包裝上貼有可掃描產銷履歷的防偽溯源標籤以證明未遭調包，背面更印有完整成分配料表，讓每項零件與函式庫的來源都一清二楚。
body.en: When downloading release artifacts, you can now mathematically verify that your binaries were built directly from official source code. Every macOS and Windows release artifact now ships with a signed SLSA build-provenance attestation, verifiable in your terminal using the `gh attestation verify <file> --repo aqua5230/usage` command. In addition, the macOS release includes a CycloneDX software bill of materials (SBOM) detailing every bundled dependency. It is like buying packaged organic food: the box carries a certified supply-chain tracking seal proving the product was never swapped in transit, alongside a complete ingredient list that reveals every sub-component inside.

items.original: **Releases now ship build provenance and an SBOM.** Every macOS and Windows artifact carries a signed SLSA build-provenance attestation, verifiable with `gh attestation verify <file> --repo aqua5230/usage`, and the macOS release includes a CycloneDX software bill of materials listing every bundled dependency.

title.zh-TW: 離線價目表標註查核日期，啟用備援時主動發出警示
title.en: Offline price table tracks its check date and warns on fallback

body.zh-TW: 網路斷線或無法連上最新價目表時，計算模型花費不再容易被過期費率誤導。當 usage 無法抓取線上最新價格時，會自動切換為內建的離線價目表作為備援；這份內建表格現在記錄了上次與官方核對的日期，並在啟用時主動於日誌留下警告訊息，讓你能一眼看出目前使用的是舊資料，而不是悄悄算錯累積費用。這好比銀行櫃檯的電子匯率看板斷線時，行員改拿出抽屜裡的紙本費率表，以前紙上沒寫列印日期容易算錯，現在紙面蓋有「最後核對日期」的大章並在單據記下備用註記，避免帳目在不知不覺中出現落差。
body.en: When your network is down or upstream price lists cannot be reached, model cost calculations will no longer silently drift on outdated rates. When usage cannot fetch live pricing, it falls back to a built-in pricing table. That built-in table now records the exact date it was last synced against upstream and writes a warning to the log whenever it is engaged, making stale pricing immediately visible before it skews your cost totals. It is like an exchange counter whose electronic rate board goes dark: the teller pulls a printed rate sheet from the drawer, but the sheet now displays an inspection date stamp and a written notation is logged on the slip, ensuring no one calculates totals under the mistaken impression that prices are current.

items.original: **The offline price table now says how old it is.** When the upstream price list can't be reached, usage falls back to a built-in table; that table now records the date it was last checked against upstream and logs a warning when it is used, so a silently outdated price can be spotted instead of quietly skewing your cost totals.

title.zh-TW: Python 套件補齊所有模組，安裝不再因缺檔而報錯崩潰
title.en: Python package includes all modules to stop ModuleNotFoundError crashes

body.zh-TW: 透過 Python 套件管理工具安裝 usage，過去就像買到了裝箱清單只勾了一半零件的組裝家具材料包。先前打包設定的模組白名單只收錄了 74 個頂層模組中的 39 個，害使用者安裝後執行時，常因找不到其餘模組而跳出 `ModuleNotFoundError` 錯誤當機；現在打包清單已完整補齊全部 74 個模組，並新增了自動化測試來防止未來漏掉檔案。這如同材料包出廠清單已補齊所有配件，且出廠前一律經過自動掃描確認，買回家不再組裝到一半才發現缺了螺絲與木板。
body.en: Developers who install usage as a Python package will no longer hit instant crashes caused by missing files. Previously, the packaging allowlist included only 39 of the 74 top-level modules, causing installed copies to crash immediately with a `ModuleNotFoundError`. The packaging list now includes all 74 modules, and an automated regression test ensures no files are forgotten in future releases. It is like buying a boxed furniture kit whose packing checklist only listed half the necessary parts, leaving customers stranded mid-assembly without key screws or panels; the factory checklist now includes every single component, with a scanner verifying each box before shipment.

items.original: **Installing usage as a Python package no longer leaves modules behind.** The packaging allowlist covered 39 of the 74 top-level modules, so an installed copy crashed with `ModuleNotFoundError`. The list is complete now and a test keeps it that way.

entries: **Windows now keeps usage current when Claude Code or Codex files change.** A native file watcher refreshes the tray percentage, panel, quota notifications, and Window Keeper shortly after the underlying files change instead of leaving them up to five minutes behind; overlapping refresh requests are merged and run once more when the current refresh finishes, so clicking Refresh Now or opening the panel no longer loses the request during a background refresh.

**Windows now runs the same daily quota-waste check, service-outage banner, and automatic update check as macOS.** The daily diagnosis snapshot is scheduled after the tray starts, the panel receives Claude and Codex service status, and background update checks respect the existing daily cache, dismissal cooldown, and skipped-version choice; manual checks still run immediately.

**Windows quota alerts can stay in Action Center and open the panel.** Notifications now use an interactive Windows toast with an action button; if Windows' toast support is unavailable, usage falls back to the previous tray balloon without interrupting refreshes.
**Windows supports the Antigravity status line.** Turning on the existing status-line switch now installs and maintains Antigravity's quota display on Windows too, including the packaged executable.

**Windows shows remaining quota on the panel's taskbar button.** Its progress bar uses the same severity colors as the tray icon and disappears when the panel is closed, so the tray app does not gain an unwanted extra taskbar entry.

**Windows builds now have usage's paw icon and stay sharp on high-DPI displays.** The executable carries the app icon instead of PyInstaller's default, and Per-Monitor-v2 DPI awareness prevents Windows from bitmap-stretching the panel on high-resolution or mixed-scale monitors.

**Windows moved everyday controls into the panel menu and leaves the tray menu for recovery.** Right-clicking the tray icon now exposes Reset Panel Position and Quit, while panel switching, refresh, launch at login, notification settings, update checks, and the other controls are available from the panel's own menu; both surfaces are generated from the same menu definition so they no longer drift apart.

**Windows places and resizes the panel correctly on scaled and multi-monitor setups.** Positioning now consistently uses the logical coordinates expected by WebView2 and sends all geometry changes through its UI thread, avoiding a panel on the wrong display, beyond a screen edge, or changed from the wrong thread.

**Antigravity status-line setup on Windows no longer silently installs a command that cannot run.** It selects an unquoted, Windows-safe Python path for `cmd.exe`, rejects unsupported paths with a clear action to take, and handles special path characters safely; macOS's Claude and Antigravity command paths are unchanged.

**Usage forecasts no longer overreact to one sudden token jump.** On macOS and Windows, the forecast now weights each recent interval by its duration, so a short polling interval containing one large Claude update no longer predicts that quota will run out implausibly soon.

**Claude and Codex outage banners now recover and suppress alerts correctly on macOS and Windows.** Codex API status is read from the complete component list instead of a truncated summary, and alert suppression again fetches incident state only when an affected component needs it; this restores a regression for Claude and makes Codex's previously ineffective suppression work for the first time.

title.zh-TW: Windows 檔案變更即時更新，重疊重整不漏接
title.en: Windows updates usage in real time on file changes without dropping refresh requests

body.zh-TW: 你在 Windows 上剛讓 Claude Code 或 Codex 跑完大量工作，想立刻確認最新額度，以前系統匣（工作列右下角的小圖示區）的數字可能慢半拍、落後長達五分鐘。現在新增的原生檔案監聽器會在底層檔案一變動時，立刻更新系統匣百分比、面板、額度通知與 Window Keeper。如果你在背景重新整理時手動點擊重整或打開面板，重疊的請求會自動合併，並在當前進度跑完後立即再補刷一次，不再遺失任何操作。這如同大樓的包裹收發台，快遞一送件就立刻廣播通知住戶，不再等固定巡邏；若清點包裹時又有人按鈴催件，管理員會先記下來並在點完後馬上再查一次。
body.en: When you finish a heavy run with Claude Code or Codex on Windows and want to check your quota, the tray readings used to lag behind by up to five minutes. A native file watcher now updates the tray percentage, panel, quota notifications, and Window Keeper right after underlying files change. If you click Refresh Now or open the panel while a background refresh is already underway, overlapping requests are merged and executed once more as soon as the active refresh completes, ensuring no request is lost. It is like an apartment mail desk that broadcasts an arrival notice the moment a courier delivers a parcel rather than waiting for scheduled rounds, and notes down any resident checking in during an active inventory to re-check right after.

items.original: **Windows now keeps usage current when Claude Code or Codex files change.** A native file watcher refreshes the tray percentage, panel, quota notifications, and Window Keeper shortly after the underlying files change instead of leaving them up to five minutes behind; overlapping refresh requests are merged and run once more when the current refresh finishes, so clicking Refresh Now or opening the panel no longer loses the request during a background refresh.

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援 Antigravity 狀態列，安裝路徑更穩固
title.en: Windows supports Antigravity status line with safe executable paths

body.zh-TW: 習慣在 Windows 終端機使用 Antigravity 開發的人，現在只要打開狀態列（status line，顯示在終端機最底下的資訊欄）開關，終端機底端就能同步顯示即時額度，即使使用打包後的獨立執行檔也能正常維護。過去安裝時可能會悄悄寫入無法執行的指令，現在會主動為 `cmd.exe` 挑選不帶引號的安全 Python 路徑、妥善處理特殊路徑字元，遇到不支援的路徑更會給出明確的處理提示；macOS 上原有的設定則維持不變。這好比水電師傅替工廠機台配線，自備符合新規格的專用接頭，遇到特殊牆面做好絕緣包覆，遇到不相容的插座更會當場附上接線指引，確保通電後指示燈穩定運作。
body.en: Developers running Antigravity on Windows can now turn on the existing status line (the readout displayed at the bottom of a terminal) switch to install and maintain live quota stats, even when using the packaged standalone binary. The setup process previously risked silently writing unrunnable commands, but now selects an unquoted, safe Python path for `cmd.exe`, handles special characters securely, and provides clear action steps if an unsupported path is encountered, leaving macOS paths unaffected. It is like an electrician wiring industrial machinery with custom connectors suited for the specific panel, insulating cables around awkward corners, and leaving clear diagrams if a socket is incompatible, ensuring the status light turns on reliably.

items.original:
**Windows supports the Antigravity status line.** Turning on the existing status-line switch now installs and maintains Antigravity's quota display on Windows too, including the packaged executable.
**Antigravity status-line setup on Windows no longer silently installs a command that cannot run.** It selects an unquoted, Windows-safe Python path for `cmd.exe`, rejects unsupported paths with a clear action to take, and handles special path characters safely; macOS's Claude and Antigravity command paths are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 補齊每日診斷與更新檢查，通知與工作列掌握度更高
title.en: Windows gains daily diagnostic checks, Action Center toast alerts, and taskbar progress

body.zh-TW: 你在 Windows 上使用 usage 管理多個 AI 工具時，日常的健康檢查與提醒變得像 macOS 一樣全面且貼心。系統匣啟動後會排程每日額度浪費診斷、面板可接收 Claude 與 Codex 服務狀態，背景自動更新也遵循每日快取（cache，把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）與冷卻設定，但手動檢查仍會立即執行。額度警示改用帶有操作按鈕的互動式快訊，可保留在重要訊息中心直接點擊打開面板，不支援時則在不中斷重新整理的情況下自動切換為備援氣泡；面板開啟時，工作列按鈕還會顯示同色系的額度進度條，面板關閉即消失。這好比診所秘書每天定時彙整健康報告並留意門診公告，提醒信附有掛號按鈕且收在待辦匣，門口燈號更會隨進度變色並在離開時自動熄滅。
body.en: Managing AI tools on Windows now offers the same comprehensive health checks and alerts as macOS. The app schedules a daily quota-waste diagnosis after startup, feeds Claude and Codex service statuses into the panel, and respects daily cache (saving fetched results temporarily for direct reuse) cooldowns during background update checks, while manual checks still run immediately. Quota alerts now use interactive Windows toasts with action buttons that stay in the Action Center to open the panel, falling back gracefully to tray balloons without interrupting refreshes if unsupported. When the panel is open, its taskbar button displays a color-coded progress bar that vanishes on close without cluttering your bar. It is like a clinic receptionist compiling daily health summaries, sending actionable reminders directly to your inbox, and displaying a color-coded queue light that turns off when you leave.

items.original:
**Windows now runs the same daily quota-waste check, service-outage banner, and automatic update check as macOS.** The daily diagnosis snapshot is scheduled after the tray starts, the panel receives Claude and Codex service status, and background update checks respect the existing daily cache, dismissal cooldown, and skipped-version choice; manual checks still run immediately.
**Windows quota alerts can stay in Action Center and open the panel.** Notifications now use an interactive Windows toast with an action button; if Windows' toast support is unavailable, usage falls back to the previous tray balloon without interrupting refreshes.
**Windows shows remaining quota on the panel's taskbar button.** Its progress bar uses the same severity colors as the tray icon and disappears when the panel is closed, so the tray app does not gain an unwanted extra taskbar entry.

title.zh-TW: Windows 介面清晰防模糊，多螢幕排版與選單更清晰
title.en: Windows interface stays sharp on high-DPI setups with polished menus and positioning

body.zh-TW: 桌上接了高解析度螢幕或多台不同縮放比例顯示器的 Windows 使用者，現在打開面板不再遇到字體模糊或視窗飄出螢幕外的困擾。獨立執行檔換上了專屬貓爪圖示，並具備 Per-Monitor-v2 高解析度感知能力，避免面板被點陣圖粗暴拉伸；視窗定位統一採用 WebView2 邏輯座標並經由主執行緒調整，徹底解決面板出現在錯誤螢幕或跨出邊界的問題。同時選單結構也重新整理，右鍵點擊系統匣僅保留重設位置與結束等救援選項，面板切換、重新整理、開機自動啟動與通知設定等控制項全移至面板專屬選單，且兩處共用定義不再脫節。這如同畫廊重新布展，每幅畫作依展廳標準精準縮放，由專人依精確標尺掛在正確展牆，並將大門總開關與展台操作盤分開管理。
body.en: Windows users with high-DPI displays or mixed multi-monitor setups will no longer encounter blurry text or off-screen panels. The executable now sports the custom paw icon and enables Per-Monitor-v2 DPI awareness to prevent ugly bitmap stretching; panel placement consistently applies logical coordinates via WebView2 on the UI thread, eliminating misplacement across monitors or edges. Furthermore, menu layouts have been cleaned up: right-clicking the tray icon keeps only emergency recovery options like Reset Panel Position and Quit, while panel switching, refresh, launch at login, notification settings, and update checks are available from the panel's own menu, with both surfaces sharing the same definition. It is like an art gallery scaling paintings cleanly to every gallery wall, hanging frames precisely with accurate rulers, and separating main circuit breakers from individual podium switches.

items.original:
**Windows builds now have usage's paw icon and stay sharp on high-DPI displays.** The executable carries the app icon instead of PyInstaller's default, and Per-Monitor-v2 DPI awareness prevents Windows from bitmap-stretching the panel on high-resolution or mixed-scale monitors.
**Windows moved everyday controls into the panel menu and leaves the tray menu for recovery.** Right-clicking the tray icon now exposes Reset Panel Position and Quit, while panel switching, refresh, launch at login, notification settings, update checks, and the other controls are available from the panel's own menu; both surfaces are generated from the same menu definition so they no longer drift apart.
**Windows places and resizes the panel correctly on scaled and multi-monitor setups.** Positioning now consistently uses the logical coordinates expected by WebView2 and sends all geometry changes through its UI thread, avoiding a panel on the wrong display, beyond a screen edge, or changed from the wrong thread.

title.zh-TW: 用量預測依時間加權，短暫尖峰不再觸發見底警報
title.en: Quota forecasts weight intervals by duration to ignore brief token spikes

body.zh-TW: 當你一口氣讓 Claude 讀入一份厚重檔案，看著預測面板可能曾被「額度即將在短時間內用光」的警報嚇了一跳。現在 macOS 與 Windows 上的預測演算法已改良，會依據近期每個輪詢區間的實際持續時間進行加權計算；就算某個短短數秒的區間內剛好碰上大量 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）更新，系統也不會再把瞬間爆發誤當成長期常態，進而做出額度即將耗盡的不合理預測。這如同家用水錶評估水費，如果洗手剛好開了五秒大水，計算機現在會把這五秒與平時一整天的靜止時間一起平均加權，知道這只是短暫用水，不會再發出誇張的缺水預報。
body.en: When feeding Claude a massive document, you might have been startled by a forecast warning that your quota would dry up in minutes. On both macOS and Windows, the forecasting algorithm now weights each recent polling interval by its actual duration. A short interval carrying a heavy token (units of AI text processing and billing) jump from a single Claude update is no longer extrapolated as continuous consumption, preventing implausibly pessimistic depletion estimates. It is like estimating a home water bill: opening the faucet full blast for five seconds is weighted alongside hours of inactivity, recognizing a brief surge rather than predicting the reservoir will run dry by nightfall.

items.original: **Usage forecasts no longer overreact to one sudden token jump.** On macOS and Windows, the forecast now weights each recent interval by its duration, so a short polling interval containing one large Claude update no longer predicts that quota will run out implausibly soon.

title.zh-TW: 服務中斷橫幅準確復原，停機警示抑制回歸正常
title.en: Outage banners restore correctly and suppress noisy alerts during downtime

body.zh-TW: 遇到 AI 服務端短暫故障時，你既想及時看到故障橫幅，又不希望在已知停機期間被不斷跳出的錯誤警報轟炸。macOS 與 Windows 上的狀態監控現在已修正：讀取 Codex API 狀態時改採完整的元件清單，不再讀取容易遺漏細節的截斷摘要；而警示抑制機制只會在受影響的元件確實需要時，才去抓取事故狀態，修復了 Claude 之前的退化問題，並讓 Codex 的通知抑制功能首次正式生效。這好比機場航班調度看板，地勤人員改查閱完整的全航線班表，確認只有受天候影響的特定航班延誤時才精準靜音重複警報，既不漏報班機狀態，也不會在已知檢修期間連續發出廣播吵醒候機旅客。
body.en: When an AI upstream hiccups, you want to see the status banner immediately without getting bombarded by repetitive error popups during a known outage. Status monitoring across macOS and Windows has been overhauled: Codex API health is now parsed from the complete component list rather than a truncated summary, and alert suppression only fetches incident details when an affected component truly requires it. This fixes a recent regression for Claude and brings effective alert suppression to Codex for the first time. It is like an airport flight status board where ground staff cross-reference the full master flight schedule, muting repetitive alarm bells specifically for flights already marked as delayed by bad weather without spamming the public address system during scheduled maintenance.

items.original: **Claude and Codex outage banners now recover and suppress alerts correctly on macOS and Windows.** Codex API status is read from the complete component list instead of a truncated summary, and alert suppression again fetches incident state only when an affected component needs it; this restores a regression for Claude and makes Codex's previously ineffective suppression work for the first time.

entries: **Codex's status line now shows the Git branch and the session's token count.** The segment set usage writes into `~/.codex/config.toml` grew from five entries to seven, adding `git-branch` and `used-tokens`, so a session reads `usage · main · 5h 39% left · weekly 50% left · Context 95% left · 12.3K used · gpt-5.6-sol high`. Codex's status line accepts only its own built-in segments — there is no command hook like Claude Code's, which is why the wording, the colors and the ` · ` separator are Codex's own and why a progress bar or a reset countdown cannot be rendered on that side. The `5h` segment is omitted until Codex holds a rate-limit snapshot that actually contains a five-hour window.

**Upgrading the segments no longer files usage's own older set as your original status line.** `_setup_codex()` backed up whatever it found before overwriting, which was correct for a status line you configured yourself but wrong for one an earlier version of usage installed: changing the segment set would have written the previous usage-installed list into `~/.codex/usage-backup.json`, and a later removal would have "restored" that instead of your real configuration — silently overwriting the only copy of it. Segment sets that usage has shipped are now recognized as its own and upgraded in place, leaving any existing backup untouched.

**Removing the Codex status line works on installs still holding an older segment set.** The removal path required an exact match against the current segments, so anyone who had not re-run setup was told the status line was not usage's and nothing happened. Every set usage has shipped is now accepted; the restore sequence itself is unchanged, including writing the recovered configuration before deleting the backup.

**The new segments apply without pressing anything.** Startup self-healing upgrades a status line that still holds a set from an earlier version of usage. It only ever matches those sets — a status line you configured yourself, and one already on the current set, are both left alone.

**Tests can no longer reach the real `~/.codex/config.toml`.** The self-healing path above reads that file, and no test overrode the path constant, so a full test run on a developer's machine rewrote their own Codex configuration and made an unrelated assertion about the self-heal log depend on the state of that machine. An autouse fixture now points the Codex configuration and both backup paths at a temporary directory, matching how the log directory is already isolated.

title.zh-TW: Codex 狀態列看得到分支與已用 token
title.en: Codex status line now shows branch and token use

body.zh-TW: 你在終端機裡連續做了幾輪工作，想知道自己在哪個 Git 分支、這個工作階段（session，一次開啟到結束的工作過程）已用了多少 token（AI 處理文字的計量單位）？Codex 的狀態列（終端機最底下那行摘要）現在多了 `git-branch` 和 `used-tokens`，設定檔裡的區段也由五個增為七個。它像車上的儀表板：分支和已用 token 會同列顯示，但表板零件只能選 Codex 內建項目；不能接像 Claude Code 那樣的指令掛鉤，所以文字、顏色與 ` · ` 分隔符號都由 Codex 決定，也不能加進度條或重設倒數。`5h` 則要等 Codex 真的拿到含五小時視窗的限流快照才會出現。
body.en: After several rounds in your terminal, you may want to know both your Git branch and how many tokens this session has used. Codex's status line now adds `git-branch` and `used-tokens`, taking the segment list in its config from five to seven. Think of it as a car dashboard: those readings can sit together, but only Codex's built-in gauges fit. Unlike Claude Code, it has no command hook, so Codex controls wording, colors, and the ` · ` separator; it cannot show a progress bar or reset countdown. The `5h` reading stays hidden until Codex has a rate-limit snapshot that contains a five-hour window.

Codex's status line accepts only its own built-in segments — there is no command hook like Claude Code's, which is why the wording, the colors and the ` · ` separator are Codex's own and why a progress bar or a reset countdown cannot be rendered on that side. The `5h` segment is omitted until Codex holds a rate-limit snapshot that actually contains a five-hour window.

title.zh-TW: 更新或移除狀態列，不會誤蓋你的原始設定
title.en: Status-line upgrades and removal preserve your original setup

body.zh-TW: 你以前用 usage 裝過 Codex 狀態列，後來想換新版或移除它，原本自己設的狀態列不該被舊版 usage 的清單冒充。現在 usage 認得自己歷來發過的區段組合，遇到舊組合會原地升級，不會把它另存成你的原始設定，也不會碰既有備份。移除時同樣接受所有舊組合；回復設定仍是先寫回找回的內容，再刪備份。啟動時還會檢查舊組合並自動更新，但只比對 usage 發過的組合，使用者自訂狀態列與已是新版的設定都不動。像寄物櫃管理員看得懂哪張標籤是店家舊款，換新標籤時不會把舊標籤誤收成你的私人物品。
body.en: If you installed a Codex status line with usage before, then upgrade or remove it, an older usage list should not masquerade as the status line you originally configured. Usage now recognizes every segment set it has shipped. It upgrades an older set in place instead of backing it up as yours, and leaves an existing backup alone. Removal accepts those older sets too; restoring still writes recovered settings before deleting the backup. At startup, usage also upgrades old sets automatically, but matches only sets it shipped, leaving both your custom line and a current set untouched. It is like a locker attendant who recognizes an old store label and replaces it without mistaking it for your personal property.

**Upgrading the segments no longer files usage's own older set as your original status line.** `_setup_codex()` backed up whatever it found before overwriting, which was correct for a status line you configured yourself but wrong for one an earlier version of usage installed: changing the segment set would have written the previous usage-installed list into `~/.codex/usage-backup.json`, and a later removal would have "restored" that instead of your real configuration — silently overwriting the only copy of it. Segment sets that usage has shipped are now recognized as its own and upgraded in place, leaving any existing backup untouched.
**Removing the Codex status line works on installs still holding an older segment set.** The removal path required an exact match against the current segments, so anyone who had not re-run setup was told the status line was not usage's and nothing happened. Every set usage has shipped is now accepted; the restore sequence itself is unchanged, including writing the recovered configuration before deleting the backup.
**The new segments apply without pressing anything.** Startup self-healing upgrades a status line that still holds a set from an earlier version of usage. It only ever matches those sets — a status line you configured yourself, and one already on the current set, are both left alone.

title.zh-TW: 測試不會再改到開發者真正的 Codex 設定
title.en: Tests no longer touch a developer's real Codex settings

body.zh-TW: 開發者跑完整套測試時，原本不該拿自己的 `~/.codex/config.toml` 當測試材料。先前啟動時的自我修復會讀這個真實設定檔，但測試沒有把路徑換掉；因此測試可能改寫開發者的 Codex 設定，連驗證自我修復日誌的結果也會隨那台電腦的狀態改變。現在自動套用的 fixture（每個測試先準備好的共用環境）會把 Codex 設定檔與兩個備份路徑全指向暫存資料夾，和原本已隔離的日誌資料夾一致。這像舞台彩排不再借用真實控制室的開關：演員怎麼測，都只影響臨時布景。
body.en: When a developer runs the full test suite, their own `~/.codex/config.toml` should never become test material. Startup self-healing read that real file, but tests did not override its path. A test run could therefore rewrite a developer's Codex configuration, while an unrelated assertion about the self-heal log also depended on that machine's state. An autouse fixture (shared setup applied before every test) now points the Codex config and both backup paths to a temporary directory, matching the already-isolated log directory. It is like a stage rehearsal no longer borrowing switches from the real control room: every experiment affects only temporary scenery.

items.original: **Tests can no longer reach the real `~/.codex/config.toml`.** The self-healing path above reads that file, and no test overrode the path constant, so a full test run on a developer's machine rewrote their own Codex configuration and made an unrelated assertion about the self-heal log depend on the state of that machine. An autouse fixture now points the Codex configuration and both backup paths at a temporary directory, matching how the log directory is already isolated.

entries: **The status line switch now covers the Antigravity CLI too.** The panel's single switch has always installed Claude Code's status line; it now mirrors the same quota display onto Antigravity when its CLI is installed. The hook is copied to `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/` and runs under macOS's built-in `/usr/bin/python3`, so it stays stdlib-only and independent of the app's virtual environment. A status line you configured yourself is backed up to a sidecar file first and restored when the switch is turned off; the deployed script is deliberately left behind, because deleting it races with any CLI that is starting and would leave that session showing a status line error for its whole lifetime. A machine without the Antigravity CLI is untouched — no directory and no file is created, and the switch keeps working for Claude Code exactly as before.

**Startup self-healing keeps the Antigravity status line current.** Installing it only on the switch's rising edge would have hidden the feature from everyone whose switch was already on, and would have frozen the deployed script at whatever version first installed it. Self-heal now reinstalls it when it is missing and re-copies it when its bytes differ from the bundled source, both gated on the switch being on — so turning the switch off keeps it off. The Antigravity branch is isolated from the rest of self-heal and only records a log entry when the install actually succeeds.

**A short burst no longer classifies you as a heavy user.** Burn-rate classification divided tokens by an elapsed span as small as one minute, so a single message's cache-creation tokens could produce a rate high enough for Heavy on their own. The minimum span is now five minutes, matching the forecast floor `burn_rate.py` already used.

**`pip` and `uv` installs ship the Antigravity hook.** `usage_statusline_agy` was missing from `py-modules`, so a non-bundle install could not resolve the script and the switch silently did nothing for Antigravity.

**Non-macOS platforms no longer touch Antigravity's settings.** The Windows tray shares the same toggle, and `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json` expands there too, so a Windows user with the CLI would have had `/usr/bin/python3` written into their configuration. The sync is now a no-op off macOS.
The menu's two toggles are grouped together without the separator that used to sit between them; both are plain on/off switches, so the divider implied a distinction that does not exist.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 也有額度狀態列，開關會自己補齊
title.en: Antigravity gets the quota status line, and its switch keeps it current

body.zh-TW: 你若同時用 Claude Code 和 Antigravity CLI，面板的狀態列（status line，顯示在終端機最底下）開關，現在也會把額度顯示裝到後者；未裝 Antigravity 不建資料夾或檔案。macOS 把掛鉤（hook，事件觸發的小程式）放進 `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/`，由內建 `/usr/bin/python3` 執行，因此不依賴 App 的虛擬環境。像在兩台車上加同款儀表板：原來那台會先備份，關掉開關時再還原。新腳本會留著，免得正在啟動的 CLI 撞上刪檔，整個工作階段都出錯。已開啟者會在啟動時補裝遺失檔案、更新不同版本腳本；關掉就不會再裝。用 `pip` 或 `uv` 安裝也會帶上此掛鉤，Windows 系統匣等非 macOS 平台不碰 Antigravity 設定，避免寫入 `/usr/bin/python3`。
body.en: If you use both Claude Code and the Antigravity CLI, the panel's existing status line (the readout at the bottom of a terminal) switch now puts the same quota display on Antigravity too. Machines without Antigravity remain untouched: no folder or file is created. On macOS it places a hook (a small program triggered by an event) in `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/` and runs it with built-in `/usr/bin/python3`, independent of the app's virtual environment. Think of fitting matching dashboards to two cars: your existing dashboard is backed up first and restored when you turn the switch off. The new script stays behind so a CLI already starting does not collide with its deletion and show an error for its whole session. Startup replaces a missing or outdated script only while the switch is on. `pip` and `uv` installs now include it; non-macOS platforms leave Antigravity settings alone, avoiding `/usr/bin/python3` on Windows.

The hook is copied to `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/` and runs under macOS's built-in `/usr/bin/python3`, so it stays stdlib-only and independent of the app's virtual environment. A status line you configured yourself is backed up to a sidecar file first and restored when the switch is turned off; the deployed script is deliberately left behind, because deleting it races with any CLI that is starting and would leave that session showing a status line error for its whole lifetime. A machine without the Antigravity CLI is untouched — no directory and no file is created, and the switch keeps working for Claude Code exactly as before.
**Startup self-healing keeps the Antigravity status line current.** Installing it only on the switch's rising edge would have hidden the feature from everyone whose switch was already on, and would have frozen the deployed script at whatever version first installed it. Self-heal now reinstalls it when it is missing and re-copies it when its bytes differ from the bundled source, both gated on the switch being on — so turning the switch off keeps it off. The Antigravity branch is isolated from the rest of self-heal and only records a log entry when the install actually succeeds.
**`pip` and `uv` installs ship the Antigravity hook.** `usage_statusline_agy` was missing from `py-modules`, so a non-bundle install could not resolve the script and the switch silently did nothing for Antigravity.

The sync is now a no-op off macOS.

title.zh-TW: 短暫高用量不再被判成 Heavy
title.en: A brief burst no longer marks you Heavy

body.zh-TW: 剛送出一則內容很多的訊息，狀態卻立刻把你標成 Heavy，現在不會這麼快下結論。先前 burn rate（用量燃燒率，把 token 除以經過時間算出的速度）最短拿一分鐘來算；單則訊息的快取（cache，把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）建立 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）就可能把數字推得很高。現在最短觀察時間改成五分鐘，跟 `burn_rate.py` 原本用來預估的下限一致。這像用車速表判斷你是否超速：不能只看起步那一下的猛踩，得看一小段路。它不是把用量藏起來，而是少讓短暫尖峰替你貼上重度使用者標籤。
body.en: After you send one especially large message, the status display will no longer rush to label you Heavy. Burn rate (the pace calculated by dividing tokens, units of AI text processing and billing, by elapsed time) used to use a span as short as one minute. Cache creation from one message could therefore push the rate high on its own. The shortest span is now five minutes, matching the forecasting floor already used by `burn_rate.py`. It is like judging speed from a car's gauge: you cannot call someone a speeder from one hard press at the starting line; you need a short stretch of road. Usage is not hidden; a brief spike is simply less likely to attach a heavy-user label.

items.original: **A short burst no longer classifies you as a heavy user.** Burn-rate classification divided tokens by an elapsed span as small as one minute, so a single message's cache-creation tokens could produce a rate high enough for Heavy on their own. The minimum span is now five minutes, matching the forecast floor `burn_rate.py` already used.

title.zh-TW: 兩個選單開關並排，少一條多餘分隔線
title.en: Two menu toggles now sit together without a misleading divider

body.zh-TW: 打開選單想調整兩個開關時，現在它們會排在同一組，中間那條分隔線拿掉了。兩者原本都是單純的開／關選項，線條卻像在菜單上把同類配菜切成兩區，讓人以為它們有不同身分或用途。畫面沒有增加新控制項，也沒有改掉任何一個開關能做的事；只是讓排列跟實際關係一致。你看到兩個並列開關，就知道它們同樣是可獨立啟用或停用的選項，不必猜那條線暗示了什麼差別。
body.en: When you open the menu to adjust its two toggles, they now appear as one group, with the separator between them removed. Both were always simple on/off controls, but the line was like splitting matching side dishes into separate sections of a menu: it suggested they had different roles. No new control has appeared, and neither toggle does anything different. The layout now matches their actual relationship. Seeing two switches side by side tells you they are both options you can turn on or off independently, without making you guess what distinction the divider was meant to signal.

items.original: The menu's two toggles are grouped together without the separator that used to sit between them; both are plain on/off switches, so the divider implied a distinction that does not exist.

entries: **A Catppuccin panel theme.** Same blueprint layout (drafting grid, ruler-tick progress bars, drafting-paper corner marks) recolored with the official [Catppuccin](https://github.com/catppuccin/catppuccin) palette — Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha, switchable from four swatches at the bottom of the panel. The choice is saved to preferences (not `localStorage`, which WebKit blocks under the panel's null-origin load) and applies on both macOS and the Windows tray.

title.zh-TW: 面板換上 Catppuccin 四色主題，格線設計照舊
title.en: Catppuccin brings four color themes to the panel without changing its blueprint look

body.zh-TW: 眼前的面板想換個色調，現在可以選 Catppuccin 的四套官方配色。草稿紙般的藍圖格線、尺刻度進度條和角落記號仍在，只是換上 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato 或 Mocha；在面板底部按四個色票就能選。這像同一張製圖桌換四種墨水，尺線與格紙不動，整張圖卻能依喜好改色。選擇會存進偏好設定（記住你選項的地方），而非 localStorage（瀏覽器暫存網站資料的地方）；面板在 WebKit 以 null origin 載入時，後者會被擋住。macOS 與 Windows 系統匣的面板都會套用這個選擇。
body.en: Want the panel in a different mood? It now offers Catppuccin's four official palettes. The drafting-paper grid, ruler-tick progress bars, and corner marks stay put; choose Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, or Mocha from four swatches along the panel's bottom edge. It is like using four inks on one drafting table: the rulers and paper do not move, but the drawing takes on your chosen color. Your pick is saved in preferences, rather than localStorage (browser storage for website data), because WebKit blocks localStorage when the panel loads with a null origin. The choice appears in both the macOS and Windows tray panels.

items.original: **A Catppuccin panel theme.** Same blueprint layout (drafting grid, ruler-tick progress bars, drafting-paper corner marks) recolored with the official [Catppuccin](https://github.com/catppuccin/catppuccin) palette — Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha, switchable from four swatches at the bottom of the panel. The choice is saved to preferences (not `localStorage`, which WebKit blocks under the panel's null-origin load) and applies on both macOS and the Windows tray.

entries: **Two new panel themes: Stained Glass and Origami.** Stained Glass renders the quota cards behind irregular polygon color fields with leaded dividers and a slow light sweep; Origami folds the same layout into monochrome triangle facets that unfold once on load instead of looping like the other panels. Both are available on macOS and in the Windows tray, reuse Classic's measured panel height since their DOM structure is identical, and are picked from "Switch Panel". A regression test now asserts the Windows panel list and height table stay in sync with the macOS panel registry — nothing previously caught a new panel being added to one and not the other.

**The contribution heatmap has a snake easter egg.** Triple-click the heatmap title within 1.5 seconds and a snake eats its way across the grid along a serpentine path, then the grid restores itself automatically. The path starts at the first week with data so an all-empty year doesn't spin uselessly, it's skipped when `prefers-reduced-motion` is set, and it's stopped and reset before any HTML/CSV/PNG export so an export can never catch the grid mid-bite.

**Eight panels were silently missing the Codex stale/quota/history warnings, and five had no Install Hook button.** Extracting nine panels to a shared `panel_core.js` (see Changed) surfaced how far the independently-copied logic had drifted — averaging 200+ lines apiece — and with the drift came real feature gaps nobody had audited for: depending on which panel happened to be open, a card that should show a Codex staleness banner, a quota bar, or a history-load error sometimes just didn't. Win95's stale-state clearing also had a small bug. All nine now go through the same binding logic, so a gap in one is a gap in none.

**Nine card panels now share one core script instead of nine divergent copies.** `classic`, `matrix`, `win95`, `newspaper`, `cloud_observation`, `aquarium`, `prism_arcade`, `black_hole`, and `lepidoptera` all inject the same `panel_core.js` through the existing placeholder mechanism; only the genuinely panel-specific pieces stay behind — progress-bar material, project-row layout, the theme-switch button treatment, and decorative animation. A regression test now blocks a future panel from being built by copy-pasting the whole script again.

**The public website picked up nine polish passes** — spotlight cursor tracking, scroll-triggered fade-ins, spring-eased hover states, and full keyboard navigation among them — drawn from patterns in Framer Motion, GSAP, Aceternity, Radix, and Magic UI and reimplemented in plain CSS/vanilla JS so nothing new was added as a dependency.

World Cup 2026's panel description no longer claims the Antigravity card and drag-to-reorder exist there — it's the one panel without either. The theme gallery gained screenshots for Classic, Cloud Observation, Prism Arcade, and Lepidoptera; every README got a quick-jump section list; and DEVELOPMENT's panel-card description now mentions Antigravity. The website nav also swapped its emoji brand mark for a hand-drawn SVG paw print, added the official GitHub icon next to the repository link, corrected wording in the five-language resume explainer (the CLI does keep a record — it just doesn't reattach automatically), and dropped four outdated feature cards along with their translation keys.

entries: **Codex data was unreadable for anyone with a custom `CODEX_HOME`.** Every path into Codex's local data (`codex_loader.py`, `adapters/codex.py`, `session_hooks.py`, `setup_hook.py`, `fsevents_watch.py`, `menubar_state.py`, `analyzer/subscription.py`) was hardcoded to `~/.codex/...`, so anyone who set the `CODEX_HOME` environment variable — multiple accounts, containerized setups — got an empty Codex section with no explanation. title.zh-TW: 自訂 Codex 資料夾不再變成空白頁
title.en: Custom Codex data folders no longer look empty

body.zh-TW: 你把 Codex 資料放到另一個地方時，usage 原本可能把它當成不存在，畫面只留空白的 Codex 區塊，還不告訴你原因。問題出在 `CODEX_HOME` 環境變數（程式啟動前交給它的隱藏設定）：它本來能指定 Codex 資料夾，適合多個帳號或容器化設定，但 usage 裡讀取資料的七個入口仍死盯著預設的 `~/.codex/`。像搬家後把新住址寫在信封上，七位送件員卻全往舊址跑。現在它們先交給同一個 `codex_paths.codex_home()` 幫手確認地址；有 `CODEX_HOME` 就照它找，沒設才回到 `~/.codex/`。因此自訂資料夾的使用者能重新看到 Codex 資料。
body.en: If you keep Codex data somewhere other than its default folder, usage could previously treat it as nonexistent: the Codex section appeared empty, with no explanation. The culprit was the `CODEX_HOME` environment variable, a hidden setting supplied before a program starts. It can point to a Codex data folder for multiple accounts or containerized setups, but seven places in usage that read the data were still hardcoded to `~/.codex/`. It was like moving house, updating your address, and having seven delivery drivers continue to visit the old one. They now all ask the same `codex_paths.codex_home()` helper for directions: use `CODEX_HOME` when set, otherwise fall back to `~/.codex/`. Your custom-folder data can show up again.
