title.zh-TW: 整理底層管線，除錯也不再讓電腦做白工
title.en: Internal pipelines polished, saving your computer from doing double duty

body.zh-TW: 產出報告的速度變得更快，因為系統改掉了背後的愚蠢計算方式。在計算報告的花費時，系統以前很糊塗，會先把所有數字加總一次，然後又在小圈圈裡一筆一筆重新算，如果你的資料量很大，它等於是在做雙倍的白工；現在改為只在小圈圈裡算一次，速度順暢多了。另外，報告裡「複製指令」按鈕的程式碼也被清理過了，不再疊床架屋寫兩份一樣的複製邏輯；而報告裡用來估算的台幣匯率，也標上了清楚的內部註解，說明這只是個固定的預估值、不是即時連網抓的匯率。就像餐廳的結帳櫃檯，以前算帳時會先把所有菜單全拿出來用計算機按一次，然後又翻開點菜單一筆一筆再加一次，客人排隊排到天荒地老；現在收銀員變聰明了，一邊點菜一邊就算好總金額。而且點餐機裡的程式碼也整理過了，上面還貼了張便條紙提醒新來的員工「這裡的匯率是寫死的參考值，不要傻傻去對當天的新聞」。
body.en: Your reports now generate faster because the system dropped some silly internal calculation habits. When calculating your report costs, the system used to be deeply confused: it would sum up all the numbers once, and then redundantly re-calculate everything piece by piece inside a loop. If you had massive amounts of data, it was effectively doing double the work for nothing; it now smartly accumulates the total in a single pass, saving processing time. We also cleaned up the clipboard code for the "copy command" buttons in the report so it no longer relies on two duplicated chunks of logic, and we added a clear internal note to the hard-coded TWD exchange rate explaining it's just a static display estimate rather than a live network fetch. It's like a restaurant checkout counter: the cashier used to punch every single receipt into the calculator once, and then painstakingly re-add every itemized dish again while the line grew out the door; now they simply tally the total in one smooth motion. The cash register's software is much cleaner now, too, sporting a sticky note that reminds the new hires, "The exchange rate here is just an estimate, don't try matching it against the morning news."

items.original:
**Double-counted report cost**: `build_report_data` summed cost once over all entries and then recomputed it per entry inside the loop — effectively doubling the work on large datasets. Now accumulated once inside the loop.
**Duplicated clipboard code in the report's "copy command" button**: the tip-copy button now reuses the shared `copyText()` helper instead of re-implementing the legacy-browser fallback.
**Hard-coded TWD rate**: the USD→TWD estimate in the report is now a named `_USD_TO_TWD` constant with a note that it is a display estimate, not a live FX rate.

entries: **"Hide Codex Section" menu toggle**: the menubar gained a "Hide Codex Section" option that collapses the Codex card across all 9 HTML panels and shrinks popover height per-panel. The preference persists via `NSUserDefaults` so it survives restarts. i18n keys added for all 5 locales. (PR #19, thanks @RayCHWong for the first-time contribution)

**`HTMLPanel.codex_card_height` is now a required keyword-only argument with no default**: previously the parameter had a `192.0` default, so a new panel that forgot to set its height in `panels/__init__.py` would silently fall back to the default — the Codex card would render at a height that doesn't match the rest of the panel without raising any error. Now declared as `*, codex_card_height: float` (keyword-only, no default), so any missing call site raises `TypeError` at import. All 9 existing panels already pass it by keyword and are unaffected; added `test_html_panel_requires_explicit_codex_card_height` to lock the contract.

title.zh-TW: 新增「隱藏 Codex 區塊」開關，不用 Codex 也能讓面板保持清爽
title.en: Hide the Codex section for a cleaner panel if you don't use it

body.zh-TW: 你現在可以在選單列裡找到一個「隱藏 Codex 區塊」的新選項。如果你平常只用 Claude 而不用 Codex，只要打開這個選項，所有 9 款 HTML 面板裡的 Codex 卡片就會全部收起來，彈出視窗（popover）的高度也會自動跟著縮減，幫你省下寶貴的螢幕空間。這個設定會被系統記住，重新開機也不用重調。對於想要自己新增面板的開發者，我們也加強了防呆機制——現在在程式碼裡強制規定必須明確指定 Codex 卡片的高度，如果忘了寫，系統在載入時就會立刻報錯提醒，而不是像以前一樣默默套用預設高度而導致版面錯位。這就像是買便當不吃配菜可以勾選「不要配菜」來換取更小的餐盒；同時廚房的點餐系統也加了防呆，沒填包裝盒尺寸的訂單直接退回，再也不會出現大便當裝小菜的尷尬情況。
body.en: You can now find a new "Hide Codex Section" toggle in the menubar. If you only use Claude and not Codex, checking this option will instantly collapse the Codex cards across all 9 HTML panels and automatically shrink the popover windows to match, saving you valuable screen real estate. This preference is saved automatically, so it stays exactly as you left it even after a restart. For developers building new custom panels, we've also added a strict safeguard—the codebase now explicitly requires you to specify the Codex card height. If you forget, it will immediately throw an error at load time instead of silently falling back to a default height that misaligns your layout. It's like ordering a bento box and ticking "no side dishes" so they give you a more compact box; meanwhile, the kitchen's ordering system was upgraded to reject tickets with missing box sizes, preventing tiny sides from awkwardly floating in a massive container.

entries: **Statusline progress bar visual refresh**: progress bar characters switched from `█░` to `■□` (filled / hollow squares), and the color palette moved from standard ANSI green/yellow/red (32/33/31) to 256-color teal/orange/dark-red (42/214/160) for stronger contrast around the 50% threshold — safe / warning / danger states are now distinguishable at a glance. Changes confined to `usage_statusline.py` (`progress_bar()` and `color_by_pct()`); HTML reports and the TUI progress bars are unaffected.
**Traditional Chinese default panel screenshot refreshed**: `docs/繁體中文面板.png` updated to reflect the latest UI (new "Report / Terminal" toggle, per-project cost display, footer attribution).

title.zh-TW: 狀態列進度條換上新裝，一眼看懂額度緊不緊
title.en: Statusline progress bar gets a visual refresh for at-a-glance readability

body.zh-TW: 終端機狀態列上的進度條現在變得更醒目了。以前的進度條是用普通的 ANSI 綠、黃、紅，現在換成了對比更強的 256 色青綠、暖橘和暗紅，而且格子符號也換成了更清晰的「■□」（實心／空心方塊）。現在你只要瞄一眼，就能立刻分辨目前的額度用量是處於安全、警告還是危險狀態。這就像是把原本黯淡的紅綠燈換成了高亮度的 LED 號誌，大老遠就能看清要不要踩煞車。另外，我們也順便把說明文件裡的繁體中文面板截圖換成了包含近期介面改動的最新版本。
body.en: The progress bar on the terminal statusline is now much easier to read. We've switched the characters to clearer solid and hollow squares ("■□"), and moved from standard ANSI colors to a high-contrast 256-color palette (teal, orange, and dark red). Now, you can instantly tell if your usage is in a safe, warning, or danger state with just a quick glance. It's like upgrading a dim traffic light to ultra-bright LEDs—you know exactly when to hit the brakes from a mile away. We've also updated the Traditional Chinese panel screenshot in the documentation to reflect the latest UI changes.

items.original:
**Statusline progress bar visual refresh**: progress bar characters switched from `█░` to `■□` (filled / hollow squares), and the color palette moved from standard ANSI green/yellow/red (32/33/31) to 256-color teal/orange/dark-red (42/214/160) for stronger contrast around the 50% threshold — safe / warning / danger states are now distinguishable at a glance. Changes confined to `usage_statusline.py` (`progress_bar()` and `color_by_pct()`); HTML reports and the TUI progress bars are unaffected.
**Traditional Chinese default panel screenshot refreshed**: `docs/繁體中文面板.png` updated to reflect the latest UI (new "Report / Terminal" toggle, per-project cost display, footer attribution).

entries: **Codex usage panel no longer falls back to `--` after a burst of short sessions**: `codex_loader.load_rate_limits()` only scanned the 5 most recent jsonl files via `_recent_jsonl_files()` to find rate_limits. Codex CLI (observed on 0.134.0) writes `payload.rate_limits == null` for short or interrupted sessions (a quick `codex exec` run, Ctrl-C, etc.); when the latest 5 sessions all fall into that bucket, the genuinely-valid prior session gets evicted from the lookup window and the entire Codex block in the popover / TUI renders as `--`. The scan window is widened from 5 to 30 (covers a typical 1–2 day usage range); the first non-null result still early-returns, and the `primary.used_percent` / `secondary.used_percent` parsing path is unchanged. The new Codex CLI 0.134.0 schema fields (`limit_id`, `limit_name`, `credits`, `plan_type`, `rate_limit_reached_type`) are deliberately not parsed — UI doesn't use them. Three new tests cover the "5 null then 6th valid", "all 30 null returns None", and "pick most recent valid" scenarios.

**Dashed Claude Code project names now decode correctly**: `history_loader._project_from_path` previously replaced every `-` in the encoded directory name with `/`, so `Desktop-claude-tutorial-video` would become `/Desktop/claude/tutorial/video` — a non-existent path. `resolve_project_name`'s fallback then took the last segment, mis-labeling the project as `"video"` instead of `"claude-tutorial-video"`. The decoder now tries the all-slash candidate first; on miss, it DFS-walks the segments, joining adjacent ones with `-` and preferring whichever variant actually exists on disk. When nothing matches, the encoded name (minus the leading `-`) is kept as-is so dashes round-trip (`plain-project` stays `plain-project`). For most users, the JSONL `cwd` field already overrides the project name, so this primarily fixes older entries that lack `cwd`.

**TUI language detection routed through `usage_lang.detect_lang`**: `tui.py` had its own detector that only returned `zh-TW` or `en` (treating simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean as English), and ignored `USAGE_LANG` / `TT_LANG` / `LANG` entirely. The menubar already used `usage_lang.detect_lang()`, so the same machine could show Japanese in the menubar and English in the TUI. The TUI now shares the same detector — all five languages render consistently.

**LRU cap on history / codex loader caches**: `_file_cache` and `_jsonl_cache` were unbounded module-level dicts. As `~/.claude/projects/` and `~/.codex/sessions/` accumulated more jsonl files over time, the menubar's resident memory grew without bound — parsed `UsageEntry` lists never got released. Both caches are now `OrderedDict`s with a 512-entry ceiling: cache hits `move_to_end` to mark MRU, inserts on a full cache `popitem(last=False)` the oldest. The mtime/size invalidation logic and codex_loader's `entry.model` rebind on cache hit are unchanged.

**Significantly expanded test coverage**: previously undercovered modules `setup_app` / `ui/tables` / `usage_cli` now have direct unit tests; the suite grew from 234 to 363 tests. No production code was changed.

title.zh-TW: 解決 Codex 區塊破圖與專案名稱解析錯誤
title.en: Fixed blank Codex panels and mangled project names

body.zh-TW: 你的 Codex 面板現在不會因為幾次中斷的對話就整塊變成空白了。以前如果你連續跑了幾個極短的對話（例如剛跑就按 Ctrl-C 取消），系統往前找資料時會被這幾個「空包彈」洗版，找不到額度資料就直接罷工顯示「--」；現在它會往回翻找更久的紀錄，確實把你該有的配額顯示出來。此外，以前專案資料夾名稱裡如果有連字號（例如 `my-awesome-project`），系統會自作聰明把它切碎，讓你認不出自己的專案；現在它學會了正確拼湊連字號，你的專案終於能用原本的名字見人了。就像你去超商查點數，以前店員只要看到你最近五筆消費都是 0 元，就會直接告訴你查不到資料，而且還會把你的名字念錯；現在他會往前多翻幾頁找出你真正的餘額，而且終於把你的名字念對了。
body.en: Your Codex panel will no longer mysteriously go blank just because you had a few brief sessions. Previously, if you ran several quick commands that were interrupted (like pressing Ctrl-C), the system would only check the last 5 logs. Since those short "dud" sessions lacked quota data, the system gave up and displayed "--"; it now looks much further back to find your actual rate limits and model info. Additionally, if your project folder name contained hyphens (like `my-awesome-project`), the system used to mangle it into an unrecognizable path; it now correctly decodes hyphens, displaying your project's true name. It's like checking your loyalty points: the cashier used to see five $0 transactions and claim you had no account while mispronouncing your name; now they flip back further to find your actual point balance and finally call you by the right name.

title.zh-TW: 終端介面語系同步，背景常駐不再狂吃記憶體
title.en: Terminal language syncs automatically, and background memory bloat is fixed

body.zh-TW: 現在你用終端機打開用量表時，它的語言會跟選單列完全一致。以前終端機有自己的小脾氣，只認得繁體中文跟英文，如果你用日文或韓文介面，它還是會硬塞英文給你；現在它們終於說同一種語言了。同時，我們解決了常駐程式越跑越吃資源的問題。以前系統會把你看過的所有歷史紀錄都永遠塞在記憶體裡，對話越多，它佔用的記憶體就越肥；現在我們幫它裝了個「只能記 512 筆」的腦袋，塞滿了就會自動忘掉最舊的。就像圖書館以前把所有借回來的書都堆在櫃檯不還回去，導致櫃檯被塞爆；現在櫃檯規定只能放 512 本書，有新的書進來，就會把最舊的書乖乖放回書架上。
body.en: When you open your usage tables in the terminal, the language now perfectly matches your menu bar. Previously, the terminal interface was a bit stubborn—it only understood Traditional Chinese and English, and would force English on you even if you had Japanese or Korean selected in the main app. Now, both interfaces speak the exact same language. At the same time, we've fixed a major resource leak in the background app. The system used to hoard every single chat history log you ever loaded in its memory forever, causing its memory footprint to endlessly balloon over time. We've now installed a strict "512-item limit" to its brain, automatically clearing out the oldest data when full. It's like a library front desk that used to pile up every returned book forever until the desk collapsed under the weight; now, the desk holds a strict limit of 512 books, automatically shelving the oldest ones when a new one arrives.

items.original:
**TUI language detection routed through `usage_lang.detect_lang`**: `tui.py` had its own detector that only returned `zh-TW` or `en` (treating simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean as English), and ignored `USAGE_LANG` / `TT_LANG` / `LANG` entirely. As `~/.claude/projects/` and `~/.codex/sessions/` accumulated more jsonl files over time, the menubar's resident memory grew without bound — parsed `UsageEntry` lists never got released. entries: **Stale update badge clears immediately after upgrading**: `usage_statusline.py:_read_update_hint` only compared the cached `current_version` against `latest_version` without consulting the actual running version. The menubar app's 24h dismiss cooldown returned early before refreshing the cache, so a user already on v0.11.13 would keep seeing "v0.11.5 available" until cooldown expired. `_check_update_in_background` now refreshes `current_version` in the cache on startup (even during cooldown), and if the running version has caught up to `latest_version`, both fields are leveled so the badge disappears immediately.

**Codex usage bucketed by token_count deltas (@ericweichun, #11)**: `analyzer/reporter.py`'s fast path previously parsed Codex `.jsonl` files to extract a cumulative snapshot keyed by session-start timestamp, which diverged from the popover (which uses `codex_loader.load_entries` with per-event delta logic). The reporter now shares the same loader, so today/week/month reports match the popover exactly. Added a reporter-layer test exercising a cross-day cumulative Codex session to verify only the current-day delta is counted.

**All-Time reports tied to the project range selector (@ericweichun, #15)**: v0.11.6's analyze-bridge refactor left out the All-Time period, so clicking All-Time showed 720h cached data instead of true all-time. The bridge now maps `projectRange === "all"` through `_analysis_period_from_project_range("all") → "all"`, and project history loads with `hours_back=0` for true all-time data. All 9 panels gained a `projectRange === "all"` branch; `project_range_all` i18n keys added across all 5 locales.

**Manual refresh button queues while busy (@ericweichun, #12)**: previously, pressing refresh while one was already running silently dropped the second request. Now a single follow-up is queued, and the completion `finally` block runs in order: `codex_model = result.get("codex_model", "unknown")`, web language injection, clear the busy flag, then drain one queued refresh.

**Setup guidance made agent-neutral (@ericweichun, #16)**: the setup button previously gated on `~/.claude/` existence, hiding it from Codex-only users. The check is now "any status-line target available" (`~/.claude/` or `~/.codex/config.toml`); the existing `setup_hook.setup()` flow already auto-detects which agent to configure. Both README variants (zh-TW + en) reworded to agent-neutral phrasing; ja/ko `hook_not_installed` translations filled in.

title.zh-TW: 更新完不再被假標籤糾纏，重整與安裝按鈕更聽話
title.en: Fake update badges vanish instantly, and buttons behave much better

body.zh-TW: 現在你只要一升級完新版本，畫面底下的「可更新」標籤就會瞬間消失。以前系統因為有 24 小時的冷卻期，就算你已經是最新版了，它還是會看著舊的筆記本死抓著標籤不放，讓你以為自己沒升級成功。另外，當你急著多按幾次「手動重整」按鈕時，系統不會再把你第二次的點擊直接丟進水裡，而是會乖乖排隊等上一輪忙完再幫你重整一次。對於只裝 Codex 的使用者，安裝連線程式的按鈕現在也會正確出現了，不再因為你沒裝 Claude 就把你當邊緣人。就像你剛繳完卡費，網銀首頁的「催繳通知」立刻就消失，不用等到隔天；而你連按兩次電梯按鈕，電梯也確實知道你在急，不會假裝沒看見。
body.en: The moment you upgrade to a new version, the "update available" badge at the bottom of your screen will vanish instantly. Previously, due to a 24-hour cooldown period, the system would stubbornly look at its outdated notes and keep flashing the badge even when you were already fully up-to-date, tricking you into thinking the update failed. Also, if you impatiently click the manual refresh button while the system is already busy updating, it will now politely queue your request to run right after, instead of just tossing your click into the void. And for Codex-only users, the button to install the connection program now correctly shows up, rather than ignoring you just because you don't use Claude. It's like paying off your credit card and seeing the "payment overdue" warning disappear instantly instead of the next morning; and when you double-press the elevator button, the elevator acknowledges your urgency instead of ignoring the second press.

title.zh-TW: 分析報告不再鬧雙包，全時期與當日數據精準對齊
title.en: Analysis reports sync perfectly, aligning all-time data and daily usage across the board

body.zh-TW: 你的分析報告和面板上的數字現在完全統一了。以前系統看 Codex 的對話紀錄時，分析報告跟主面板是各算各的，有時會發生你明明同一天講的話，報告卻把它算到前一天去；現在它們共用同一套計算規則（把累積數字切成每一筆小變動去算），今天講的絕對只算在今天。而且，當你把專案時間範圍切換成「全期（All Time）」時，報告現在真的會把所有紀錄都挖出來算給你聽，不會像以前一樣只偷懶抓最近 30 天的資料敷衍你。這就像公司裡的財務部跟業務部以前各拿一本帳本，月底對帳永遠對不上，現在他們終於看同一個系統裡的同一份資料，不管你要查今天還是查公司創立以來的總帳，數字都分毫不差。
body.en: The numbers in your analysis reports and your main dashboard are now in perfect harmony. Previously, when interpreting Codex session history, the report and the dashboard used two separate methods to calculate tokens. This sometimes meant usage from a conversation you had today was wrongly attributed to yesterday; they now share the exact same logic (bucketed by exact event deltas), guaranteeing today's usage stays perfectly confined to today. Furthermore, when you switch the project range to "All Time," the report actually digs up your entire history to give you the true total, instead of lazily grabbing just the last 30 days and calling it a day. It's like the sales and finance departments finally ditching their separate spreadsheets to use the same central accounting system—whether you're checking today's revenue or the all-time gross since the company was founded, the numbers finally match up flawlessly.

items.original:
**Codex usage bucketed by token_count deltas (@ericweichun, #11)**: `analyzer/reporter.py`'s fast path previously parsed Codex `.jsonl` files to extract a cumulative snapshot keyed by session-start timestamp, which diverged from the popover (which uses `codex_loader.load_entries` with per-event delta logic). The reporter now shares the same loader, so today/week/month reports match the popover exactly. Added a reporter-layer test exercising a cross-day cumulative Codex session to verify only the current-day delta is counted.
**All-Time reports tied to the project range selector (@ericweichun, #15)**: v0.11.6's analyze-bridge refactor left out the All-Time period, so clicking All-Time showed 720h cached data instead of true all-time. The bridge now maps `projectRange === "all"` through `_analysis_period_from_project_range("all") → "all"`, and project history loads with `hours_back=0` for true all-time data. All 9 panels gained a `projectRange === "all"` branch; `project_range_all` i18n keys added across all 5 locales.

entries: **Removed Codex model footer from popover**: the "· model: gpt-5.5" suffix added in v0.11.6 (`menubar.py:868-870`) misled users into thinking the model was being used *right now*, when in fact it reflects the model of the most recent Codex session with rate_limits data — possibly hours old. Without a timestamp context, this information is noise that can't be acted on. TUI model displays (`ui/tables.py:818,857`) are kept since they live inside different contexts (active session block / idle panel). The `model_label` i18n key and `CodexRateLimits.model` field are preserved; only the popover footer concatenation is removed.

title.zh-TW: 拿掉底部容易誤導的模型標示，還給畫面清爽
title.en: Removed misleading model labels from the footer to keep things clean

body.zh-TW: 你打開面板時，最下面不再顯示 Codex 模型的名稱了。這是因為之前顯示的其實是「上次有留紀錄時」用的模型，可能是好幾個小時前的事了，卻很容易讓人誤以為「現在這一秒」正在用它。因為這個資訊看了也只會讓人混淆，我們決定把它拿掉，讓畫面更乾淨。就像你去銀行抽號碼牌，如果螢幕上一直掛著「上一位客人的辦理項目」，你只會覺得一頭霧水；現在直接把它擦掉，清清爽爽。
body.en: When you open the popover panel, you'll no longer see the Codex model name at the very bottom. This is because the label was actually showing the model used during "your last recorded session"—which could have been hours ago—leading people to mistakenly believe it was actively being used right that second. Since this out-of-context information was more confusing than helpful, we simply removed it to clean up the interface. It's like waiting at the bank: if the digital display kept showing the transaction type of the customer from three hours ago, you'd just be confused; now the board is wiped clean to avoid misunderstandings.

entries: **Hook self-heal: broken installs fix themselves, silently**: every startup now runs `setup_hook.self_heal()`, which silently repairs three clearly-safe scenarios: (1) first-run (`is_setup()==False` and no `statusLine` key in settings) → invokes `setup()`; (2) hook script version is out of date (`needs_update()==True`) → `update_hook()`; (3) settings points to a missing hook file with state `us-direct`/`us-forwarder` → re-runs `_copy_hook_script()` + `_copy_forwarder_script()`. When state is `external`/`legacy-tt`, all three skip (no silent override of third-party tools). Each action appends to `settings["usage"]["selfHealLog"]` (FIFO, 20 entries). Failures are swallowed; stderr is printed only when `USAGE_DEBUG=1`.

**Coexistence prompt consolidated**: when an external statusLine tool is detected, usage shows a single NSAlert with two buttons ("Enable Coexistence Mode" / "Keep Current Setup"). Either button sets `settings["usage"]["forwarderModePromptDismissed"]=True` and the prompt never appears again. Replaces the previous three-button repair dialog in `main.py:health_check()`; the "remind me later (24h cooldown)" path is removed. Users who previously chose "Do Not Ask Again" on the old dialog will be re-prompted once (one click resolves it).

**`--doctor` hidden CLI flag**: `python3 main.py --doctor` prints a plain-text diagnostic report (English-only for easier GitHub issue searches) covering hook state, version, script file status, status file mtime, external hook detection (recognizes `ccusage` / `lord-kali` keywords), forwarder prompt ack state, last 5 self-heal log entries, and Codex sessions scan count. Hidden from `--help` via `argparse.SUPPRESS` so it doesn't distract typical users. New `doctor.py` renderer module.

**Weekly burn warning no longer over-reacts to short bursts**: previously the weekly warning extrapolated from the most recent 10-minute sample window, so a single large prompt could trigger a scary "8 hours until empty" warning that vanished once the user took a break. The weekly warning now uses a 30-minute sample window with a 30-minute minimum span, requiring sustained high usage for at least half an hour before triggering. Session warnings keep the 10-minute window (session resets are frequent, can't be too strict). `burn_rate.ROLLING_WINDOW_SECONDS` was raised from 15 to 60 minutes so the longer window has enough history.

**Burn warning text now says "at current pace"**: all 5 languages' burn warning strings now explicitly include "按目前速度 / At current pace / 現在のペース / 현재 속도", making it clear that this is a momentary extrapolation rather than a stable prediction.

title.zh-TW: 系統學會自己修復連線，與其他工具和平共存不擾人
title.en: The system repairs its own connections and peacefully coexists with other tools

body.zh-TW: 以前如果 Claude 的連線程式（hook，負責把用量傳出來的小程式）不小心被刪掉或過期了，你得自己打指令重裝。現在每次開啟 usage，它都會默默幫你檢查；如果是單純的檔案不見或版本太舊，它會一秒內自己修好，你完全不會發現。如果你同時有安裝別人的連線工具，它也不會偷偷蓋掉別人的設定，只會跳一次簡單的視窗問你要不要「共存」，點過一次以後就永遠不會再煩你。就像家裡的水管工，以前管子稍微鬆了還要你打電話叫他來，現在他會定期巡邏默默鎖緊；如果看到有別的師傅在施工，他也會禮貌地問一聲要不要配合，而且只問一次。
body.en: Previously, if Claude's connection hook (the small script that relays your usage data) was accidentally deleted or became outdated, you had to manually run setup commands to fix it. Now, every time usage starts, it quietly checks its own health; if it spots a missing file or an old version, it instantly repairs itself without you ever noticing. If you happen to be running third-party connection tools alongside it, it won't aggressively overwrite their settings. Instead, it asks exactly once if you want to enable "coexistence" mode, and then never bothers you about it again. It's like a plumber who used to require a phone call every time a pipe came loose, but now does silent maintenance rounds; and if he sees another contractor working, he politely asks how to coordinate—and only asks once.

title.zh-TW: 隱藏診斷指令上線，額度用盡警告不再一驚一乍
title.en: Hidden doctor command available, and burn warnings stop crying wolf

body.zh-TW: 現在如果遇到疑難雜症，你可以用一個隱藏的 `--doctor` 指令來印出英文診斷報告，方便上網抓藥。更棒的是，介面上的「每週額度燃燒警告」變穩重了。以前只要你連續十分鐘狂問問題，系統就會嚇得推算出「剩下 8 小時就會把整週額度用光」的誇張數字；現在它會觀察整整半小時，確定你真的是持續高用量才會發出警告，而且五種語言的警告文字都會明確加上「按目前速度」的免責聲明。就像車子的油表預測，以前你只是踩了一腳油門超車，它就警告你油只夠開三公里；現在它會看你這半小時的平均車速再來估計，還會老實告訴你「這是用你現在猛踩油門的速度算的」。
body.en: If you ever run into tricky issues, you can now use a hidden `--doctor` command to print a full English diagnostic report, making it much easier to search for solutions online. Even better, the weekly burn-rate warning on your dashboard has stopped being so dramatic. Previously, if you blasted through prompts for just 10 minutes, the system would panic and project that you'd drain your entire week's quota in 8 hours. It now observes you for a full 30 minutes to confirm you're actually sustaining a high burn rate before sounding the alarm, and the warning text across all five languages now explicitly adds an "at current pace" disclaimer. It's like your car's range estimator: instead of flashing an empty tank warning just because you floored the gas pedal to pass a truck, it now watches your average speed over the last half hour, honestly noting "this is based on how heavy your foot is right now."

entries: **"Launch at login" toggle now takes effect immediately, no reboot needed**: `login_item.enable()` / `disable()` now invoke `launchctl bootstrap gui/<uid> <plist>` / `launchctl bootout gui/<uid>/<label>` in addition to writing/removing `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.lollapalooza.usage.plist`, so launchd learns about the change right away. Previously only the plist file was touched, so the toggle did nothing until the next reboot, and disabling left a KeepAlive orphan process behind. `launchctl` "already bootstrapped" (exit 17) and "not bootstrapped" (exit 113) are treated as success; other failures log a warning without affecting the plist operation (signatures stay `() -> None`).

title.zh-TW: 「開機自動啟動」開關立刻生效，不用等到下次重開機
title.en: The "Launch at login" toggle now takes effect instantly without a reboot

body.zh-TW: 以前你在選單裡點了「開機自動啟動」的開關，系統只會默默記在筆記本裡，你得等到下一次重開機，電腦才會真的照做；要是你把它關掉，背景還會留下一支不會停的舊程式。現在只要你一點開關，系統就會馬上拍拍電腦的肩膀跟它說「現在就開始」或「馬上停下來」，不用再等重開機了。就像你跟大樓管理員說明天開始不要送報紙了，以前他只會寫在明天的交接本上，今天還是照送；現在他會立刻用對講機跟派報生說停送。
body.en: When you toggled "Launch at login" from the menu, the system previously just jotted it down in a config file and waited for your next reboot to actually do anything about it; and turning it off left a zombie background process running. Now, the moment you flip the switch, the system instantly taps macOS on the shoulder to say "start doing this now" or "stop right now", with zero reboots required. It's like telling the building manager to cancel your newspaper delivery: they used to just write it in tomorrow's log while still delivering today's paper, but now they immediately radio the delivery person to stop.

items.original: **"Launch at login" toggle now takes effect immediately, no reboot needed**: `login_item.enable()` / `disable()` now invoke `launchctl bootstrap gui/<uid> <plist>` / `launchctl bootout gui/<uid>/<label>` in addition to writing/removing `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.lollapalooza.usage.plist`, so launchd learns about the change right away. Previously only the plist file was touched, so the toggle did nothing until the next reboot, and disabling left a KeepAlive orphan process behind. `launchctl` "already bootstrapped" (exit 17) and "not bootstrapped" (exit 113) are treated as success; other failures log a warning without affecting the plist operation (signatures stay `() -> None`).

entries: **TUI session table no longer crashes on `cost_usd=None`**: widened `ui/tables.py:_fmt_cost` to `float | None` so entries written without a cost (a known path on the Codex side) now render as `--`, matching the popover-side behavior in `panels/web_panel.py`. Previously the `>=` comparison raised `TypeError` and broke the whole table.

**Update check now handles pre-release versions**: `update_checker._parse_version` now strips pre-release / build suffixes via regex, so `0.11.0-beta.1` / `0.11.0+build.5` no longer return `None` and no longer make `compare_versions` raise. Beta testers receive update prompts correctly. No new package dependencies were added.

**Pricing falls back to a stale cache when offline**: the fallback order in `pricing.py` is now fresh cache → network fetch → stale cache → hardcoded fallback. Previously a >7-day-old cache combined with no network dropped straight to the hardcoded prices, skewing cost estimates; the real (if stale) historical cache is now preferred.

title.zh-TW: 離線估價更準確，測試版更新不再漏接，終端介面不崩潰
title.en: Accurate offline estimates, fixed beta updates, and crash-free terminal UI

body.zh-TW: 現在帶筆電出門沒網路時，系統估算花費會直接拿你上週剛抓過的價目表來算，不會再傻傻退回最古老的出廠價，讓成本估算大失真。如果你是愛用測試版的勇者，系統現在也看得懂「beta」這類後綴版號，有新版會正確跳出更新提示，不再報錯裝死。另外，用終端機查看對話紀錄時，就算有些紀錄沒有標示花費金額，畫面現在只會顯示「--」，不會再導致整個表格直接崩潰壞掉。就像出國沒網路時，你會拿出幾天前存的舊匯率表來換算，而不是硬用十年前的書本價格；而且就算清單裡某幾項商品沒貼標籤，結帳機台也不會整台當機了。
body.en: When you're working offline without internet, the system now smartly estimates your costs using the real price list you fetched last week, instead of wildly falling back to ancient factory-default prices and skewing your budget. If you're an early adopter running beta versions, the update checker now understands version numbers ending in "beta", delivering update prompts correctly instead of throwing an error and playing dead. Also, when viewing your session history in the terminal, if a specific entry happens to lack cost data, it now gracefully displays "--" rather than crashing the entire table. It's like traveling abroad without data: you use the exchange rate you saved a few days ago instead of blindly relying on a ten-year-old guidebook; and if a couple of items on your grocery receipt are missing price tags, the whole cash register doesn't explode.

entries: **git worktree entries collapse into the main project**: running Claude Code or Codex inside a worktree (a duplicate working tree of the same repo) no longer splits `usage` and `usage-fix-bug` into two separate rows in the HTML report and TUI ranking. They are now grouped under the main worktree's directory name. A new `project_resolver.py` module (stdlib only, 3-second timeout, falls back to the previous basename behavior when git is unavailable) is shared by `history_loader.py` and `codex_loader.py`. Seeing historical totals merge on first upgrade is the intended behavior.

title.zh-TW: 同一個專案的平行副本，用量不再被拆得七零八落
title.en: Parallel working copies of the same project no longer fracture your usage stats

body.zh-TW: 當你用工作樹（worktree，讓同一個專案多開幾份平行副本的 Git 功能）來修 bug 或開發新功能時，系統終於懂得把帳算在一起了。以前它會把你主資料夾跟副本資料夾的用量拆成兩個獨立專案，導致你的用量排行榜看起來很亂；現在它會自動把這些副本的用量，全部算在主專案頭上。升級後如果你看到某些專案的數字突然變大、名次合體，這是正常的。就像你拿了幾張附卡給家人刷，以前帳單會分開好幾份寄來讓你眼花，現在全部彙整到主卡帳單裡，一眼就能看出總共花了多少。
body.en: When you use worktrees (a Git feature that lets you check out multiple parallel copies of the same project) to fix bugs or build features, the system finally knows how to consolidate the bill. Previously, it would split the usage from your main folder and your copies into separate projects, cluttering your leaderboards; it now intelligently groups all that usage under the main project's name. If you notice some project totals suddenly merging and growing upon upgrading, this is completely expected. It's like handing out supplementary credit cards to your family: instead of receiving a confusing pile of separate statements, everything is now cleanly rolled up into one master bill, making it immediately clear how much was spent in total.

entries: **Pricing cache moved under `~/.usage/`**: the LiteLLM pricing cache now lives at `~/.usage/pricing_cache.json` instead of `~/.claude/pricing_cache.json`, following the principle that usage-owned state belongs in its own directory. The legacy path stays as a read-only fallback for seamless migration. Thanks @ericweichun.

**Explicit `usage report --help` and unknown-option handling**: previously the CLI silently ignored unknown report options and `--help` still triggered agent detection. Now `--help` returns the help text immediately and unknown options error out cleanly. Thanks @ericweichun.

title.zh-TW: 設定檔搬家不留痕跡，終端機指令不再裝聾作啞
title.en: Configs move homes seamlessly, and terminal commands stop playing deaf

body.zh-TW: 你平常不用管的計費快取（cache，暫存資料的地方）現在搬到了專屬的資料夾裡，而且系統會自己讀舊檔案當備用，你完全不用重設。另外，在終端機打 `usage report` 指令時，如果打錯字，以前系統會假裝沒看到直接跑預設畫面，現在它會明確報錯教你怎麼打；查說明文件（`--help`）的速度也變快了。就像你把家裡的工具箱換了個抽屜放，要用的時候自動拿到手；而平常那個問錯問題就沉默的助理，現在終於會主動說「不好意思，你指的是這個嗎？」了。
body.en: The billing cache (where temporary data is stored) has smoothly moved to its own dedicated folder. The system will still read your old file as a backup, so you don't have to lift a finger to migrate. Also, when you make a typo running the `usage report` command in the terminal, instead of silently ignoring you and running the default report, the system now stops and tells you what went wrong. Looking up the help manual (`--help`) is also noticeably faster. It's like moving your toolbox to a new drawer and having your tools automatically show up in your hand when needed; and that assistant who used to stare blankly when asked the wrong question finally speaks up to say, "Sorry, did you mean this instead?"

**Codex today / week / month reports now use tail scanning**: users with many sessions no longer wait for a full history scan when opening reports. Today reports drop from roughly 7 seconds to the 0.03-second range, with week / month benefiting from the same path.

title.zh-TW: 底部清楚標示 Codex 模型，日韓介面也不會一片空白
title.en: The popover footer clearly displays the Codex model, and Japanese/Korean UIs are no longer blank

body.zh-TW: 你現在可以直接在介面底部看到目前正在使用的 Codex 模型。以前如果剛好沒有模型資料，畫面會空一塊讓你以為壞掉了，現在它會老實印出「unknown」。同時，日文與韓文介面的模型標籤也補齊了，切換語系一樣看得到。就像去餐廳點無菜單料理，以前主廚不說話你會以為沒菜了，現在菜單底部會確實寫上今日食材或是「主廚特製」，而且各國語言的菜單都印得清清楚楚。
body.en: You can now see exactly which Codex model is currently active right at the bottom of the interface. Previously, if no model data was available, the space was left completely blank, making you wonder if the app broke; it now honestly prints "unknown". Additionally, the missing Japanese and Korean model labels have been filled in, so you get the same clear info regardless of language. Like a mysterious chef's tasting menu—instead of leaving the dish name blank and making you guess if the kitchen closed, the menu now explicitly says "Chef's Secret" or prints the actual ingredients, fully translated for every guest.

title.zh-TW: 分析報告時間範圍跟著專案走，累積再多對話也秒開
title.en: Analysis reports sync with your project range and open instantly regardless of history size

body.zh-TW: 你現在按出分析報告時，它的時間區間會自動對齊你正在看的專案範圍（Project Usage），切換 1d 就看今天、7d 就看本週，不用另外找按鈕設定。對於重度使用者來說，現在按出今日報告的時間從 7 秒大幅縮短到只要 0.03 秒。因為系統學會了「從尾巴往前掃描」，不再傻傻從盤古開天闢地第一筆對話開始讀。就像去圖書館查昨天的報紙，以前館員會從十年前的舊報紙一路翻到今天，現在他直接從最新的一疊拿給你，而且你說要找體育版，他拿出來的就直接是體育版。
body.en: When you generate an analysis report, its time period now automatically matches the project range (Project Usage) you're currently viewing—selecting 1d shows today, 7d shows this week, without needing a separate toggle. For heavy users, generating today's report has plummeted from a sluggish 7 seconds down to lightning-fast 0.03 seconds. The system now smartly scans backwards from the newest entries instead of mindlessly reading your entire history from the dawn of time. Like asking a librarian for yesterday's newspaper—instead of flipping through a decade of archives from page one, they now grab right from the top of the freshest pile, already opened to the section you requested.

items.original:
**Analysis report period follows the Project Usage range**: the Report button now switches output periods with the current project range, mapping 1d to today, 7d to week, and 30d to month. No new UI was added; it uses the existing range control.
**Codex today / week / month reports now use tail scanning**: users with many sessions no longer wait for a full history scan when opening reports. Today reports drop from roughly 7 seconds to the 0.03-second range, with week / month benefiting from the same path.

entries: **Terminal toggle button now changes background when enabled**: previously only the `✓` check mark indicated that the statusLine hook was active; now the button background tints with each panel's accent color too, so the on/off state is obvious at a glance.
**Friendlier button labels for non-developers**: "Analyze" → "Report", "CLI" → "Terminal" (with per-language translations: 終端 / ターミナル / 터미널 / 终端). All five languages updated together.

**All buttons now have hover feedback**: previously only "Refresh Now" reacted to mouse hover; "Quit", "Switch Panel", "Today", "Report", "Terminal" looked disabled. Hover now produces visual feedback at a graded intensity (primary > secondary > switch).

**Classic panel large visual refinement**: pushed towards a "macOS system tool" feel — card corners 18→8, tightened spacing, progress bars gained inset track shadow and outer glow, projects list got a relative-share comparison bar (top-3 ranks emphasized), footer status became chip pills, brand-color accent stripe added on the left, brand icons gained background tint and glow.

**Six themed panels adopt the same UX trio** (matrix / win95 / newspaper / aquarium / cloud_observation / prism_arcade / black_hole): comparison bars, Terminal active-state coloring, button hover. Each panel's own theme art is preserved in full (Matrix green / Win95 pixel / newspaper print / aquarium ripple / cloud / prism rainbow / black-hole orange).
**Landing page panel gallery expanded from 6 to 9 themes**: added aquarium / prism_arcade / black_hole; classic now uses its own screenshot instead of borrowing `popover.png`.
**Refreshed all 9 panel screenshots (zh-TW & en)** in the README and on https://aqua5230.github.io/usage/.

**Analysis reports now follow the menu bar popover language**: clicking Report (formerly Analyze) now passes the menu bar's current language into HTML report generation instead of redetecting from environment variables only, avoiding English fallback when LaunchAgent does not set `LANG`.

**Visible popovers are repositioned when switching panels**: changing the active theme/panel while the popover is open now closes the old popover, rebuilds the content and size, then shows it again to avoid transient indentation or sizing glitches.

**Codex project usage and analysis reports now share one counting path**: when the same Codex session appears in multiple JSONL files, usage keeps the newer cumulative token entry; analysis reports now reuse `codex_loader.load_entries()`, and Project Usage includes Codex sessions so the app and report do not disagree for the same local data. Project Usage's Today range now matches the footer's local calendar day, and the footer no longer reloads Codex when the caller already supplied Codex entries.

**Project Usage header truncation fixed across all 9 panels**: classic & matrix were patched by @ericweichun (#9); this release completes the remaining six (win95 / newspaper / aquarium / cloud_observation / prism_arcade / black_hole). All now use a 2-row grid (icon + title on top, three buttons evenly distributed below) so English "Project Usage" and longer Japanese/Korean titles no longer clip.

**macOS now opens analysis reports with `/usr/bin/open`**: previously `webbrowser.open()` constructed a `file://` URI, which some browsers refused for paths containing spaces or CJK characters. Switching to `/usr/bin/open` with the resolved path is more reliable. Thanks to @ericweichun (#9).
**Matrix panel footer clipping**: the ASCII border + raindrop background made the content taller than the default 812 panel height, clipping the "Refresh Now / Quit" buttons. Raised to 880.
**win95 / newspaper "Resets in X" text was glued to the card edge**: bumped win95 panel height 768 → 800, newspaper → 850, and added padding-bottom to the Claude/Codex card's `.row:last-child`.

**Four grid panels (aquarium / cloud_observation / prism_arcade / black_hole) — Projects row layout rebuilt**: the original row-as-mini-card design (border + radius + background) fundamentally fought with the new column-spanning comparison bar (the bar always glued to the row card's bottom border; padding / margin / grid-template-rows tweaks all failed). Switched to flat rows with border-top dividers (same as classic), preserving each panel's theme color on the rank chip and background. Also removed the comparison bar from these four panels (grid + row-card + spanning bar is fundamentally conflicting; ROI too low). The other four panels (classic / matrix / win95 / newspaper) keep their comparison bars.

title.zh-TW: 按鈕改名又會回應了，報告語言與開啟也修順
title.en: Buttons get friendlier names and real feedback, and reports open in the right language

body.zh-TW: 面板上的按鈕變得更好懂、也更會回應你了。首先是名字改直白：「分析」改成「報告」、「CLI」（命令列介面的縮寫，工程師才懂的詞）改成「終端」，五種語言同步更新，不再只有工程師看得懂。再來，以前只有「立即更新」這顆按鈕滑鼠移上去會變色，其他像是「結束」「更換面板」「今日」「報告」「終端」全部沒反應、看起來像壞掉的；現在每顆按鈕移上去都有視覺回饋。而「終端」這顆開關（用來開關狀態列 hook 的——狀態列 hook 是一種讓程式在終端機提示列上常駐顯示一小段資訊的設定）以前只有一個小勾勾表示開著，現在按鈕底色也會跟著變，一眼分得出開還是關。另外兩個跟「報告」有關的問題也修好了：按「報告」產生的 HTML 報告，現在會跟著選單列目前的語言，不會再因為系統環境沒設好就退回英文；而開啟報告時，如果路徑裡有空白或中文字（以前會讓某些瀏覽器打不開），現在改用系統的 open 指令更穩定。就像一個店面把原本只有店員才看得懂的編號標籤，換成客人也懂的名字，每個按鈕按下去也都會亮一下告訴你「有反應喔」，而且不管你的資料夾取什麼名字都能順利結帳。
body.en: The buttons on the panel are friendlier and more responsive now. First, the names got plainer: "Analyze" became "Report", and "CLI" (an abbreviation for command-line interface, jargon only engineers understand) became "Terminal", updated across all five languages so it's no longer just engineers who can read them. Second, previously only the "Refresh Now" button changed color when you hovered; the others — "Quit", "Switch Panel", "Today", "Report", "Terminal" — gave no reaction and looked broken; now every button gives visual feedback on hover. And the "Terminal" toggle (which turns the status-line hook on and off — a status-line hook is a small setup that pins a program's info in your terminal's prompt line) used to show only a tiny check mark when on, but now its background tints too, so you can tell at a glance whether it's on or off. Two report-related bugs are also fixed: the HTML report generated by clicking "Report" now follows the menu bar's current language instead of falling back to English when the system environment isn't set up; and when opening the report, paths with spaces or CJK characters (which used to break some browsers) now work reliably via the system's open command. It's like a shop swapping clerk-only numeric labels for names customers actually understand, with every button lighting up to say "I heard you" when pressed, and checkout working no matter what you named your folders.

title.zh-TW: 面板視覺全面翻新，標題不再斷、數字不再對不上
title.en: Panels get a full visual refresh — titles stop clipping and numbers stop disagreeing

body.zh-TW: 你的面板畫面整個整理過，看起來更像一套 macOS 系統工具，也修掉一堆排版與數字的小毛病。預設的 classic 面板大幅翻新：卡片圓角變小、間距收緊、進度條多了凹陷與光暈、專案排行榜多了相對佔比的比例條（前 3 名強調）、底部狀態改成圓角標籤、左邊加上品牌色細條。其他七款主題面板（駭客任務、視窗 95、報紙、水族箱、雲圖、稜鏡街機、黑洞）都跟進終端開啟變色與按鈕 hover（滑鼠移上去的變色反應）效果；不過比例條只有駭客任務、視窗 95、報紙這三款跟 classic 一樣保留，水族箱、雲圖、稜鏡街機、黑洞這四款因為版面結構衝突而拆掉。各面板仍保留原本的主題視覺（綠字、像素、油墨等）。同時修掉一堆惱人的排版問題：九款面板的「專案用量」標題以前常被三顆按鈕擠到斷行（尤其英文和日韓較長的字串），現在改成兩列版型不再被裁掉；駭客任務面板的底部按鈕、視窗 95 與報紙面板的「重置倒數」文字以前會被邊框切掉，現在都調高了；切換面板時彈窗也不再出現短暫的排版錯亂。另外，同一份 Codex 對話紀錄以前在面板和報告裡可能算出不一樣的數字，現在兩邊走同一套算法，app 和報告不再對不上。官網與說明文件的展示截圖也一併補齊到九款面板。就像一間老店面重新裝潢：招牌字不再被遮、櫃子不再塞到溢出來，而且各分店統一用同一套陳列方式，客人不管走進哪一家都看得順眼。
body.en: Your panel has been cleaned up top to bottom — it reads more like a proper macOS system tool, and a pile of layout and number glitches got fixed. The default classic panel got a major refresh: smaller card corners, tighter spacing, progress bars with inset shadows and glow, a relative-share comparison bar on the project rankings (emphasizing the top 3), footer status turned into rounded chips, and a brand-color stripe down the left side. Seven other themed panels (Matrix, Windows 95, newspaper, aquarium, cloud, prism arcade, black hole) all picked up the Terminal active-state coloring and button hover effects; the comparison bars, though, are kept only on Matrix, Windows 95, and newspaper (same as classic) — aquarium, cloud, prism arcade, and black hole had theirs removed over a layout conflict. Each panel still keeps its original theme art (green text, pixels, ink, and so on). A batch of annoying layout bugs are fixed too: the "Project Usage" title across all nine panels used to get squeezed into a broken line by the three buttons (especially the longer English, Japanese, and Korean strings), now rebuilt into a two-row layout that no longer clips; the Matrix panel's bottom buttons and the Windows 95 / newspaper panels' "resets in" text used to get cut off by the frame, now raised to fit; switching panels no longer causes a brief layout glitch in the popover. And the same Codex session used to be counted differently in the panel versus the report — now both sides share one counting path, so the app and the report no longer disagree. The website and documentation gallery screenshots were also refreshed to cover all nine panels. It's like an old shop getting renovated: the sign isn't blocked anymore, the shelves don't overflow, and every branch uses the same display so customers see a tidy store no matter which one they walk into.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列學會提點更新，排版與顏色更直覺
title.en: The status line gains update hints and more intuitive colors

body.zh-TW: 終端機裡的狀態列（statusLine，在輸入框上方顯示額度的區塊）變得更懂你在看什麼了。如果你用的是有裝選單列 App 的電腦，只要背景檢查到有新版本，狀態列的最後面就會輕輕亮起一個青色的「可更新」小字，不用刻意打開選單也能收到通知。同時，狀態列的排版也經過一番梳理：脈絡視窗（context window）的容量上限，從原本擠在標題的括號裡，搬到了進度條尾端跟百分比排在一起，讀起來更順口；「快速模式」的標籤改成只有開啟時才亮起，不再用一個奇怪的「/nofast」來佔畫面；而且，百分比數字的顏色現在會直接跟著進度條一起變色（黃、綠、紅），加上原本太暗的剩餘時間也調亮了，就算在黑底的終端機裡也清清楚楚。就像車子的儀表板，只有開遠光燈時圖示才會亮，油量數字的顏色會跟著油表指針一起變紅，還會在你該保養的時候默默亮起保養燈，再也不用瞇著眼睛在暗處找數字了。
body.en: The terminal status line (the block above your input showing quotas) has gotten much better at communicating. If you're running the menu bar app in the background and it discovers a new update, the status line will softly append a cyan "available" badge at the very end of the row, keeping you informed without making you click anything. We also streamlined the entire layout: the context window capacity has moved out of its awkward title parenthesis to sit right next to the percentage at the tail end of the bar, making it read naturally. The "fast mode" indicator now behaves like an actual indicator — it only lights up when the mode is on, ditching the confusing "/nofast" clutter when it's off. Furthermore, the percentage numbers now perfectly match the bar's warning color (yellow, green, or red), and the remaining time texts are no longer frustratingly dimmed out on dark backgrounds. It's like a modernized car dashboard: the high-beam icon only glows when they're actually on, the fuel number turns red along with the needle, and a small maintenance light quietly turns on when it's time, so you never have to squint in the dark to decipher your gauges again.

entries: **Read-only CLI commands silently mutated user settings**: `usage daily` / `report` / `sessions` / `dashboard` and other read commands unconditionally called `setup()` or `update_hook()`, potentially writing to `~/.claude/settings.json` or `~/.codex/config.toml` on every invocation. Fix: only `setup` / `unsetup` mutate user settings; other commands now show a one-line "Hook not installed. Run: usage setup" hint when the hook isn't installed.

**Opus 4.6 / 4.7 cost was underestimated 3× on offline cold start**: `pricing.py`'s fallback table listed Opus as `5e-6 / 25e-6` (input / output per token), but the published Anthropic rate is `15e-6 / 75e-6`. Affected scenario: no pricing cache *and* LiteLLM live fetch fails. Users with network access or a cached price table are unaffected.

**`adapters/codex.py` sqlite connection leak**: `_load_thread_models()` wrapped the work in `try / except`, but `conn.close()` ran *after* `execute().fetchall()` — any exception in between left the connection dangling. Now uses `contextlib.closing()` to guarantee release.

**Mid-write crash could leave `~/.codex/config.toml` truncated**: `setup_hook.py`'s `_setup_codex` / `_unsetup_codex` used plain `write_text()`, so a crash or kill during setup could corrupt Codex config. Now uses `mkstemp + os.replace` atomic write, sharing a single module-private helper with Claude settings.

**`analyzer/cost.py` removed**: it was a weakened duplicate of `pricing.py` — bidirectional substring model matching (prone to misclassification), no cache TTL, and an SSL-cert-verification-disabled fallback when fetching the price table (a security concern for cost data). `analyzer/{aggregator,blocks,reporter}` now import `pricing.calculate_cost` directly; the latter accepts a `typing.Protocol` so both `history_loader.UsageEntry` and `adapters.types.UsageEntry` work. Net 76 lines of duplicate cost-calc code removed.

title.zh-TW: 唯讀指令不再亂動設定，離線時成本估算更精準
title.en: Read-only commands stop mutating settings, and offline costs are accurate

body.zh-TW: 這次修補了幾個背後運作的安全隱患。以前當你在終端機下達像 `usage report` 這種理應「只看資料不改東西」的唯讀指令時，系統卻會自作主張地在背後偷偷覆寫你的 Claude 或 Codex 設定檔，甚至如果執行到一半被強制關閉，還可能把你的設定檔截斷弄壞。現在它學乖了，唯讀指令絕對不會碰你的設定檔，而需要修改檔案的安裝流程也改成「原子寫入（atomic write）」——確保整份檔案寫完才替換，中途當機也不會留下半殘的廢檔。此外，針對在沒有網路又沒有價格快取的「離線冷啟動」情況，我們修正了內建的備用價格表，原本它把最新模型 Opus 4.6 的價格低估了 3 倍，現在斷網時也能幫你算出正確的花費。就像去圖書館借書，以前只是用電腦查個書目，系統卻會偷偷跑去改你的借閱密碼，而且遇到停電還可能把你的卡片消磁；現在它安守本分只查資料，並且不管圖書館有沒有連上網，查到的逾期罰金都保證正確無誤。
body.en: We've patched several quiet hazards in how the system operates under the hood. Previously, when you ran terminal commands like `usage report` that were supposed to simply read data, the system would aggressively overwrite your Claude or Codex config files behind your back, and if the app was killed mid-write, it could completely ruin your configuration file. The app now behaves itself: read-only commands absolutely will not touch your settings, and the actual installation flows now use "atomic writes" — guaranteeing the entire file is safely written before swapping it in, leaving no broken files even if it crashes mid-way. Additionally, for "offline cold starts" (when you have no internet and no cached price table), we fixed the built-in fallback prices where the cost of the newest Opus 4.6 model was drastically underestimated by 3×. Now your cost estimates are accurate even completely offline. It's like using a library catalog computer: it used to secretly reset your PIN just because you searched for a book, and a power outage could erase your card; now it sticks to reading only, and tells you exactly the right late fees even when the library's internet is down.

items.original:
**Read-only CLI commands silently mutated user settings**: `usage daily` / `report` / `sessions` / `dashboard` and other read commands unconditionally called `setup()` or `update_hook()`, potentially writing to `~/.claude/settings.json` or `~/.codex/config.toml` on every invocation. Fix: only `setup` / `unsetup` mutate user settings; other commands now show a one-line "Hook not installed. Run: usage setup" hint when the hook isn't installed.
**Opus 4.6 / 4.7 cost was underestimated 3× on offline cold start**: `pricing.py`'s fallback table listed Opus as `5e-6 / 25e-6` (input / output per token), but the published Anthropic rate is `15e-6 / 75e-6`. Affected scenario: no pricing cache *and* LiteLLM live fetch fails. Users with network access or a cached price table are unaffected.
**`adapters/codex.py` sqlite connection leak**: `_load_thread_models()` wrapped the work in `try / except`, but `conn.close()` ran *after* `execute().fetchall()` — any exception in between left the connection dangling. Now uses `contextlib.closing()` to guarantee release.
**Mid-write crash could leave `~/.codex/config.toml` truncated**: `setup_hook.py`'s `_setup_codex` / `_unsetup_codex` used plain `write_text()`, so a crash or kill during setup could corrupt Codex config. Now uses `mkstemp + os.replace` atomic write, sharing a single module-private helper with Claude settings.
**`analyzer/cost.py` removed**: it was a weakened duplicate of `pricing.py` — bidirectional substring model matching (prone to misclassification), no cache TTL, and an SSL-cert-verification-disabled fallback when fetching the price table (a security concern for cost data). `analyzer/{aggregator,blocks,reporter}` now import `pricing.calculate_cost` directly; the latter accepts a `typing.Protocol` so both `history_loader.UsageEntry` and `adapters.types.UsageEntry` work. Net 76 lines of duplicate cost-calc code removed.

entries: **`usage_cli.py` crashed on every first run** (thanks @will30-blockchain — [#7](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/7)): `setup(auto=True)` passed a non-existent keyword argument to `setup_hook.setup()`, causing a `TypeError` on any fresh install or after `unsetup`. Users who already had the hook installed were unaffected. Fix: drop the stale `auto=True` kwarg.

**Incremental JSONL parsing**: `history_loader` and `codex_loader` now maintain module-level mtime+size caches and skip re-parsing files whose content hasn't changed, significantly reducing per-refresh disk I/O.

**Parallel hook forwarding**: `usage_statusline_forwarder` now dispatches all hooks concurrently via `ThreadPoolExecutor`; a single slow or timing-out hook no longer stalls the others. Worst-case latency drops from `n × 5s` to `5s`.
**Multi-session write protection**: `usage_statusline.py`'s `save()` now acquires `fcntl.LOCK_EX` before writing, preventing concurrent Claude Code sessions from clobbering each other's data.

**Python path resolution**: `setup_hook` now uses `_find_system_python()` when building hook commands — preferring the bundled `.app` Python, then `/usr/bin/python3`, avoiding the broken Xcode stub that `shutil.which("python3")` can resolve to after an Xcode update.

**FSEvents-driven UI refresh**: `menubar` now uses a CoreServices `FSEventStream` (via ctypes) to watch `~/.claude/`. Changes to `usage-status.json` trigger `_refresh()` immediately, cutting update latency from up to 60 seconds to milliseconds. `NSTimer` is demoted to a 300-second fallback; silently degrades to timer-only mode if CoreServices is unavailable.

title.zh-TW: 選單列反應快如閃電，背後運作更省力
title.en: Lightning-fast menu bar updates with drastically reduced disk work

body.zh-TW: 這次更新讓選單列上的數字更新變得瞬間到位。以前系統是靠一個呆呆的計時器，每隔一分鐘才去查一次你的用量有沒有變，所以常常會慢半拍；現在它學會了直接監聽作業系統的檔案變動事件（FSEvents），你一燒掉額度，畫面在幾毫秒內就會立刻跳動。不僅反應變快，背後讀資料也變得更省力：現在它只會去解析真正有變動的歷史紀錄，不再每次都把沒變的舊檔案重讀一遍，大幅減輕你硬碟的負擔。另外，如果你同時開了好幾個終端機視窗在跑 Claude，現在存檔時會自動排隊鎖上檔案（檔案鎖），不會再發生兩邊同時寫入把用量互相覆蓋的慘劇。這就像是餐廳的出菜系統，以前服務生每隔一分鐘才慢吞吞地進廚房看菜好了沒，現在廚房一出菜就會按鈴，服務生馬上把菜端走，而且大家端菜時絕不會再撞在一起把盤子摔碎了。
body.en: The numbers on your menu bar will now update instantaneously. Previously, the system relied on a dumb timer that polled your usage once a minute, often lagging far behind reality. Now, it directly listens to your operating system's file events (FSEvents), so the moment you burn through some quota, the on-screen numbers twitch in milliseconds. Not only is it faster, but reading data behind the scenes is much lighter too: it now incrementally parses only the history files that have actually changed, saving your hard drive from redundantly reading identical old files over and over. Additionally, if you run multiple Claude Code sessions in different terminal windows, the system now uses file locks to make them line up politely when saving data, completely preventing them from clobbering each other's usage totals. It's like a restaurant's kitchen flow: waiters used to slowly poke their heads into the kitchen every minute to check for food, but now the kitchen rings a bell the millisecond a dish is ready — and the waiters no longer crash into each other dropping plates on their way out.

entries: **[P0] Released `.app` crashes on launch on macOS Sequoia / arm64** (thanks @cmhcm — [#6](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/6)): all three prior releases (v0.10.0 / v0.10.1 / v0.11.0) are affected. Root cause: in py2app builds `i18n.py` is compiled into `lib/python313.zip` but `i18n.json` lives in `Contents/Resources/`. The old `Path(__file__).with_name("i18n.json")` resolved to a path *through* the zipfile and raised `NotADirectoryError` on first read. Fix: new `i18n.packaged_resource_path()` helper prefers the `RESOURCEPATH` env var that py2app injects at launch (pointing at `Contents/Resources/`) and falls back to the source-adjacent path. All four packaged-resource callsites updated (`i18n.py` / `tui.py` / `main.py` / `menubar.py`). Source-mode runs are unaffected.

**Packaging metadata completed**: `pyproject.toml` `py-modules` adds the previously-missing `burn_rate` / `update_checker` / `tips_loader` / `usage_lang` / `usage_statusline_forwarder`, and `packages.find` `include` adds `panels*`. Non-editable installs now ship the full code.

**`.app` license metadata aligned**: `setup_app.py` `NSHumanReadableCopyright` updated from the stale `MIT License` to `Copyright © 2025-2026 lollapalooza. Licensed under AGPL-3.0-only.`, matching what `pyproject.toml` declares.
**`pricing_cache.json` path unified**: `analyzer/cost.py` now caches to `~/.claude/pricing_cache.json` (was repo root), matching `pricing.py`. A stray 1.1 MB orphan cache at repo root was removed.

**Panel names go through i18n**: `panels/__init__.py` exposes an `i18n_key` per panel and i18n.json gains the missing keys across all 5 languages. The "Switch Panel" menu no longer mixes Chinese names into en / ja / ko UIs.
**Status-file error messages go through i18n**: `usage_client.py`'s "status file not found" and "no quota data yet" hints now route through `_t()`, all 5 languages covered.

**Analytics CLI read order matches the main app**: `adapters/rate_limits.py` previously only read `~/.claude/tt-status.json`; it now follows the same `usage-status.json` → `usag-status.json` → `tt-status.json` fallback chain as `usage_client.py`.

**README documents the v0.11.0 update check + GitHub Releases as a network exception**: README.md / README.en.md both gain a new "update check" bullet and list the GitHub Releases API as the second of two network exceptions (the first remains the LiteLLM pricing table).

title.zh-TW: 修復 macOS Sequoia 上的閃退死穴，選單語言不再混搭
title.en: Instant crashes on macOS Sequoia fixed, and menu languages are fully localized

body.zh-TW: 這次解決了一個致命錯誤。前幾個版本的 `.app` 檔在最新的 macOS Sequoia 系統上，只要一打開就會立刻閃退，因為它被包裝後的檔案結構給搞糊塗了，找不到用來顯示多國語言的字典檔；現在它已經學會正確摸黑找到對的資料夾，順利開機。同時，我們把翻譯補得更完整了——以前你在英文、日文或韓文的系統裡點開「更換面板」選單時，裡面還是會硬生生夾雜中文的面板名稱，或者在找不到檔案時拋出中文的錯誤提示；現在這些文字都會乖乖跟著你的系統語言切換。另外，我們也把散落在各處的快取檔案統整到 `~/.claude/` 底下，順手清掉了你硬碟裡 1.1 MB 的孤兒檔案。就像是買回來的進口家電原本會因為電壓不對直接燒斷保險絲，而且說明書還是各國語言亂湊的；現在插上插座就能正常運作，而且說明書保證整本都是你熟悉的語言。
body.en: We've squashed a fatal bug where the released `.app` would instantly crash on launch if you were running the latest macOS Sequoia. The app was getting completely confused by its own packaged file structure and couldn't find its translation dictionary; it has now learned the correct path through the dark to boot up smoothly. Meanwhile, we've filled in the missing translation gaps. Previously, if you used an English, Japanese, or Korean system, your "Switch Panel" menu would awkwardly feature Chinese panel names, and system errors would spit out Chinese text. Now, all these strings strictly respect your chosen system language. We also tidied up the pricing cache files, unifying them under the `~/.claude/` folder and sweeping away a 1.1 MB orphaned file from your hard drive. It's like buying an imported appliance that used to blow a fuse immediately due to the wrong voltage while packing a poorly translated, mixed-language manual; now you can plug it in safely, and the instruction book reads perfectly in your native tongue.

entries: **In-app update check (Stage 1)**: On launch, usage pings GitHub Releases for a newer version (rate-limited to once per 24h so you're not nagged every time you open the app). When a newer version is found, an NSAlert shows the version + release notes with three buttons: **Download**, **Later**, **Skip this version**. "Download" opens the Release page in your default browser — manually replace the old `.app` with the new one. (Stage 2 will bring Sparkle-style auto download + replace.)

**Two new entries in the "Switch panel" menu**:
- **Automatically Check for Updates** (toggleable): unchecking it disables the launch-time auto check entirely; the manual entry below still works.
- **Check for Updates Now**: manually triggers a check, bypassing the 24h cooldown and skip-version preference. If you're already up to date, an alert says so; on network error you see "Update check failed".

Preferences are stored in the existing `~/.claude/usage-preferences.json`, with three new keys: `auto_update_check` (default true), `update_dismissed_at` (Unix timestamp), `update_skipped_version` (skipped version string).

`setup_app.py` now bundles `pyproject.toml` and `update_checker` into the py2app build — so the packaged `.app` can fall back to reading `pyproject.toml` when `importlib.metadata` can't resolve the version.

title.zh-TW: App 學會自己檢查更新了，且不會煩死你
title.en: The app now checks for updates automatically without annoying you

body.zh-TW: 你現在不用再時不時跑去 GitHub 網頁看有沒有新版本了。App 啟動時會自動去檢查有沒有新版，如果發現更新，會直接跳出視窗告訴你新版本的改動內容，讓你點「Download」連過去下載。為了不打擾你，這個自動檢查一天最多只會跑一次；如果你覺得這個版本不重要，也可以點「跳過此版本」，它就不會再拿同一個版本煩你。當然，如果你想要手動控制，可以在「更換面板」選單裡關掉「自動檢查更新」，或者隨時點「立刻檢查更新」來強迫它查一次。就像你的汽車導航，現在懂自己在背景偷偷查圖資有沒有更新，有重大改變才問你要不要更新，而不是每次一發動就逼著你按確認。
body.en: You no longer have to manually check the GitHub repository for new releases. On launch, the app now automatically checks for new versions and pops up a dialog with the release notes and a one-click button to download it. To respect your focus, this auto-check runs at most once every 24 hours. If a particular update doesn't interest you, you can hit "Skip this version" and it won't bother you about that specific release again. You are in full control — you can toggle off "Automatically Check for Updates" in the Switch Panel menu, or manually trigger a "Check for Updates Now" whenever you want. It's like your car's GPS silently checking for new maps in the background and only asking if you want to upgrade when there's actually a major new route, instead of forcing you to click OK every time you start the engine.

entries: **Weekly burn-rate warning false positive**: Extrapolating the last 10 minutes of usage slope onto a 7-day weekly quota was too aggressive (e.g. 56% used → projected 5h50m to exhaustion → "Runs out in 5h50m (resets in 4d6h)" warning), since users don't sustain that rate 24/7. Fix: `_quota_row` gained a `warning_max_seconds` parameter, and the three weekly call sites pass a 24h ceiling — projections beyond 24 hours no longer trigger the warning. Session warnings are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: 每週額度的用完警告不再過度恐慌
title.en: Weekly quota burn-rate warnings are no longer overly dramatic

body.zh-TW: 現在系統預估「每週額度（weekly quota）」什麼時候會用完時，不會再隨便嚇你了。以前它會拿你最近 10 分鐘瘋狂輸出的速度，直接推算你接下來整週都會不眠不休地工作，然後在你額度其實還剩近一半時，就急著跳出「剩不到 6 小時就用完」的紅字警告。現在系統加上了 24 小時的預測上限，如果按照目前速度算出來還能撐超過一整天，它就不會跳警告來煩你；但針對單次對話（session）的額度警告則維持原樣。這就像手機電量預估，以前你只是剛好開了五分鐘的耗電遊戲，系統就斷言你手機半小時後會沒電並狂響警報，現在它學會考量你不會一直玩下去，不再過度反應。
body.en: The system will no longer cause unnecessary panic when predicting when your weekly quota will run out. Previously, it would take your furious typing speed over the last 10 minutes and extrapolate that you'd be working non-stop 24/7, prematurely flashing a red "runs out in 6 hours" warning even when your quota was only half empty. Now, the system enforces a 24-hour prediction ceiling — if your current pace indicates you'll survive for more than a full day, it won't bother you with a warning. Short-term session quota warnings remain unchanged. It's like your phone's battery estimator: it used to panic and scream that your phone would die in 30 minutes just because you launched a heavy game for five minutes, but now it understands you won't be playing forever and stops overreacting.

entries: **HTML report Share button**: A new Share button in the top-right opens a file-share modal with two actions — "Download .html" and "Copy file path" — so you can send the report via AirDrop / Mail / Slack / iMessage to a colleague or manager. Recipients open it in any browser on mobile or desktop.

**"Hide project names" toggle on download**: A checkbox inside the share modal (default ON, privacy-first) swaps every project name to `Project 1 / Project 2 / ...` before the HTML is serialized for download. The on-screen report is unaffected.

**HTML report sponsor section reworked**: Two Ko-fi badges now flank the brand slogan `No cloud. No tracking. Just yours.` (kept in English across all five UI languages). The slogan carries a subtle wobble animation to draw the eye, and the GitHub link (github.com/aqua5230/usage) appears below.

**statusLine second line removed**: The cumulative token totals / cache / cost line has been dropped to simplify visuals. Key info now lives on line 1 (5h / 7d / Context window) and line 3 (session duration, model).

**HTML report KPI card widths rebalanced**: tokens / cost are now wider; sessions / messages / active days narrower (grid ratio 1.5fr 1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr), preventing 9-digit token counts from wrapping.
HTML report footer line `usage · Local-first analytics · Data stays on device` — replaced by the GitHub link in the sponsor section.

title.zh-TW: 報告可點 Share 分享，還能自動把專案名稱打碼
title.en: Share your report in one click with built-in project name redaction

body.zh-TW: 現在你可以把分析報告輕鬆傳給主管或同事看了。報告右上角多了一顆分享按鈕，點開就能選擇「另存一份 .html」或「複製檔案路徑」，透過 AirDrop、信箱或通訊軟體傳送，對方用手機或電腦的瀏覽器都能直接打開看。而且，下載介面裡多了一個預設打勾的「隱藏專案名稱」選項，勾著下載的話，檔案裡的專案名字都會被自動替換成「Project 1、Project 2」這類代號，不用擔心機密外洩，而你螢幕上看的畫面仍然維持原樣。就像你拿提款機的明細給別人看，以前要自己拿黑筆塗掉帳號，現在列印時機器就自動幫你打好星號了。
body.en: You can now easily share your usage analysis with managers or colleagues. A new Share button in the top-right corner of the report lets you "Download .html" or "Copy file path" to send via AirDrop, email, or messaging apps, and recipients can open it in any browser on mobile or desktop. Plus, there's a privacy-first "Hide project names" checkbox in the download modal that's checked by default. When enabled, all project names in the downloaded file are automatically swapped to generic labels like "Project 1" or "Project 2" to prevent leaking sensitive information, while your on-screen view remains unchanged. It's like handing someone your bank receipt — you used to have to cross out the account number with a sharpie, but now the machine prints asterisks for you automatically.

items.original:
**HTML report Share button**: A new Share button in the top-right opens a file-share modal with two actions — "Download .html" and "Copy file path" — so you can send the report via AirDrop / Mail / Slack / iMessage to a colleague or manager. Recipients open it in any browser on mobile or desktop.
**"Hide project names" toggle on download**: A checkbox inside the share modal (default ON, privacy-first) swaps every project name to `Project 1 / Project 2 / ...` before the HTML is serialized for download. The on-screen report is unaffected.

title.zh-TW: 介面大掃除，終端機與報告畫面更俐落
title.en: Visual cleanup makes the terminal and reports much sleeker

body.zh-TW: 這次為終端機的狀態列（statusLine，在輸入框上方顯示額度的區塊）和分析報告做了視覺瘦身。狀態列移除了原本顯示累計問答、快取和花費的第二行，讓版面更清爽，只把最重要的限額和模型資訊留在第一跟第三行。報告畫面的上方指標卡片（KPI 卡）也調整了寬度比例，把 token 與成本的卡片拉寬，避免累積到上億的長數字被折到下一行；報告底部則重新設計了贊助區塊，用會微微晃動的品牌標語取代了原本死板的頁尾文字，並補上 GitHub 連結。就像把儀表板上平時用不到的繁雜指針拆掉，並把最重要的油量表放大，讓你開車時一眼就能看清重點。
body.en: We've put the terminal status line (the block above your input showing quotas) and the HTML report on a visual diet. The status line drops its second row that showed cumulative totals, cache, and costs, keeping the layout clean and focusing only on crucial limits and model info on the first and third lines. In the report, the top KPI cards have rebalanced widths — the tokens and cost cards are now wider so massive 9-digit numbers won't awkwardly wrap to the next line. We also reworked the sponsor section at the bottom, replacing the static footer text with a subtly wobbling brand slogan and adding a GitHub link. It's like removing the clutter of rarely-used gauges from your car's dashboard and enlarging the gas gauge so you can read what matters at a glance.

items.original:
**HTML report sponsor section reworked**: Two Ko-fi badges now flank the brand slogan `No cloud. No tracking. Just yours.` (kept in English across all five UI languages). The slogan carries a subtle wobble animation to draw the eye, and the GitHub link (github.com/aqua5230/usage) appears below.
**statusLine second line removed**: The cumulative token totals / cache / cost line has been dropped to simplify visuals. Key info now lives on line 1 (5h / 7d / Context window) and line 3 (session duration, model).
**HTML report KPI card widths rebalanced**: tokens / cost are now wider; sessions / messages / active days narrower (grid ratio 1.5fr 1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr), preventing 9-digit token counts from wrapping.
HTML report footer line `usage · Local-first analytics · Data stays on device` — replaced by the GitHub link in the sponsor section.

entries: **TUI polling never updated after first fetch**: a `continue` in `poll_usage` caused every timeout to jump back to the loop head, leaving the UI frozen at the initial state. Changed to `pass` so the polling path is actually reached.
**Inconsistent env var name**: `USAG_FORCE_GROUP` (v0.1.x legacy prefix) renamed to `USAGE_FORCE_GROUP` to match all other env vars in the project.

**Redundant filesystem scans per refresh**: `_refresh_in_background` was calling `history_loader.load_entries` four times per cycle (24h × 2, 168h × 1, 720h × 1). Now loads the 720h superset once and passes it down, eliminating the duplicate I/O.
`pricing.py` User-Agent updated from the stale `usage/0.2` to `usage/0.9`.
`--setup` no longer prints a "no migration needed" message on clean installs.

title.zh-TW: 終端機介面不再卡死，底層檔案掃描更省力
title.en: Terminal UI stops freezing, and underlying file scans are much more efficient

body.zh-TW: 之前在終端機裡看用量時，因為一個程式迴圈寫錯（不小心跳過了更新步驟），導致畫面永遠凍結在剛打開的那一秒，再也不會自動更新。現在這個迴圈修好了，畫面會乖乖定時刷新。同時，我們也優化了底層的檔案掃描：以前每次更新畫面，系統都會笨笨地把同一個歷史紀錄檔案重複讀 4 次來算不同時間區間的數字；現在它學聰明了，一次讀完最長的區間然後直接往下分派，大幅省下白費力氣的硬碟讀取。另外，舊版的環境變數和過時的內部代號也一併統一了。就像是顧門口的警衛以前一直忘記看手錶導致從來不換班，而且查房時還同一層樓爬上爬下巡了四遍，現在終於準時交接，而且知道從頂樓一次巡下來最省事。
body.en: Previously, when viewing your usage in the terminal, a buggy programming loop (which accidentally skipped the update step) caused the screen to freeze permanently at the exact second you opened it, never automatically refreshing again. This loop is now fixed, and the screen faithfully updates on time. Simultaneously, we've optimized the underlying file scans: before, every time the screen refreshed, the system foolishly read the exact same history file 4 times to calculate numbers for different time ranges; it's now smart enough to read the longest range once and pass the data down, drastically cutting down on wasted hard drive reads. Additionally, legacy environment variables and stale internal names have been unified. It's like a security guard who used to forget to check his watch and never changed shifts, while also climbing up and down the same floor four times during a patrol — now he hands over exactly on time and knows it's easiest to just patrol from the top floor down once.

items.original:
**TUI polling never updated after first fetch**: a `continue` in `poll_usage` caused every timeout to jump back to the loop head, leaving the UI frozen at the initial state. Changed to `pass` so the polling path is actually reached.
**Inconsistent env var name**: `USAG_FORCE_GROUP` (v0.1.x legacy prefix) renamed to `USAGE_FORCE_GROUP` to match all other env vars in the project.
**Redundant filesystem scans per refresh**: `_refresh_in_background` was calling `history_loader.load_entries` four times per cycle (24h × 2, 168h × 1, 720h × 1). Now loads the 720h superset once and passes it down, eliminating the duplicate I/O.
`pricing.py` User-Agent updated from the stale `usage/0.2` to `usage/0.9`.
`--setup` no longer prints a "no migration needed" message on clean installs.

entries: **New "World Cup 2026" panel**: FIFA broadcast HUD style. Top-down green pitch with grass stripes, white field markings (halfway line, centre circle, penalty boxes, corner arcs), dark broadcast scoreboard showing Claude / Codex Session percentages as large numerals (38 px), bidirectional duel bar (Claude ← centre line → Codex) replacing the standard progress bar. Canvas animation: a pentagon-pattern football rolling in the lower pitch area, 12 stick-figure players (6 per team) roaming their zones — the nearest player chases the ball at 0.8 px/frame and kicks it on contact (60-frame cooldown per team), directing it toward the opponent's goal. Bottom section shows a MATCH STATS standings board. Triggers a golden GOAL! celebration overlay when either side's usage hits ≥ 85 %.

title.zh-TW: 用量對決變成一場足球轉播，世界盃面板登場
title.en: The usage duel becomes a football broadcast — the World Cup panel is here

body.zh-TW: 你可以把用量監控畫面換成一場足球賽。新加的「世界盃 2026」面板把 Claude 和 Codex（兩套 AI 工具）的用量對決，做成 FIFA 電視轉播的樣子——綠色球場俯視圖配白色場線、深色計分板用大數字秀出兩邊各用了多少 session（一段對話的額度單位）百分比，中間一條雙向對戰條取代原本單向的進度條。畫面上還有一顆五邊形足球在下半場滾、兩隊各 6 個棒人球員在自己的區域跑位，離球最近的球員會追上去、碰到就踢，把球往對方的球門送（各隊踢完有 60 格的冷卻時間）。底部有積分榜；當任一邊用量衝到 85% 以上，還會跳出黃金「進球！」彩蛋慶祝。就像把原本枯燥的用量電表，換成一場會自己播的足球轉播，看著兩邊你來我往，快爆量的時候直接給你一記進球慶祝。
body.en: You can swap the usage monitor for a football match. The new "World Cup 2026" panel turns the usage duel between Claude and Codex (two AI tools) into a FIFA-style TV broadcast — a top-down green pitch with white field lines, a dark scoreboard showing each side's session (a quota unit measured per conversation) percentage in big numerals, and a bidirectional duel bar replacing the old one-way progress bar. A pentagon-pattern football rolls across the lower pitch while twelve stick-figure players (six per team) roam their zones; the nearest player chases the ball and kicks it toward the opponent's goal (each team has a 60-frame cooldown after a kick). A MATCH STATS standings board sits at the bottom, and when either side's usage hits 85% or more, a golden GOAL! celebration overlay pops up. It's like swapping a boring electricity meter for a sports channel that plays its own match, with back-and-forth action and a goal celebration right when you're about to max out.

Canvas animation: a pentagon-pattern football rolling in the lower pitch area, 12 stick-figure players (6 per team) roaming their zones — the nearest player chases the ball at 0.8 px/frame and kicks it on contact (60-frame cooldown per team), directing it toward the opponent's goal. entries: **New "Prism Arcade" panel**: deep purple-black background, Canvas conic rainbow halo rotating slowly, geometric prism shards (triangles/diamonds) drifting randomly, coloured light particles flickering, cards with holographic gradient borders (CSS background-clip technique), full-spectrum rainbow progress bars with sweep animation.

**New "Black Hole" panel**: pure-black space background, Canvas 2D star field (120 stars with twinkling), rotating accretion disk (orange-yellow-white gradient ellipse, Doppler brighter-left/darker-right), photon ring, event horizon with blue-purple glow, orange particles orbiting the ellipse, amber glass cards.

title.zh-TW: 新增稜鏡街機面板
title.en: New Prism Arcade panel added

body.zh-TW: 現在多了一款「稜鏡街機（Prism Arcade）」面板可以選了！它有著深紫黑色的背景，中央有一圈緩慢旋轉的彩虹光暈，搭配隨機漂移的幾何碎片（三角形與菱形）和閃爍的彩色光點粒子。卡片邊框採用了全息漸層效果，進度條更是全光譜的彩虹色並帶有掃光動畫，看起來非常酷炫。就像是在你的電腦桌面上擺了一台充滿復古霓虹燈效的經典大型機台。
body.en: You can now choose the new "Prism Arcade" panel! It features a deep purple-black background with a slowly rotating rainbow halo in the center, accompanied by randomly drifting geometric shards (triangles and diamonds) and flickering colored light particles. The cards sport holographic gradient borders, and the progress bars boast a full-spectrum rainbow sweep animation, making the whole thing look incredibly cool. It's like placing a classic arcade cabinet glowing with retro neon lights right on your computer desktop.

title.zh-TW: 新增黑洞視界面板，動畫背景更清晰、版面更服貼
title.en: Black Hole panel added, and animated backgrounds are now clearer and properly fitted

body.zh-TW: 現在多了一款「黑洞視界（Black Hole）」面板可以選了！它有著純黑的宇宙背景、120 顆閃爍的星星，中央是一個有著藍紫光暈的事件視界和旋轉的漸層吸積盤，搭配琥珀色的玻璃卡片，科幻感十足。同時，我們把水族箱、稜鏡街機與黑洞視界這三款動畫面板的卡片背景調得更透明，讓背後的動畫能更清楚地透出來；我們也修復了這些面板底部會莫名其妙留白的問題，現在內容會完美撐滿整個視窗高度了。就像是幫家裡的窗戶換了更透光的玻璃，而且原本裝歪、底部漏風的窗框也重新打上矽利康封滿了。
body.en: You can now choose the new "Black Hole" panel! It features a pure-black space background with 120 twinkling stars, centered around an event horizon with a blue-purple glow and a rotating gradient accretion disk, paired with amber glass cards for a deeply sci-fi feel. Simultaneously, we've reduced the background opacity of the cards in the Aquarium, Prism Arcade, and Black Hole animated panels, allowing the animations behind them to show through much more clearly. We also fixed an issue where these panels had inexplicable empty space at the bottom, so their content now perfectly stretches to fill the full window height. It's like replacing your home's windows with clearer glass, and finally caulking up the crooked frames that were leaving a drafty gap at the bottom.
